store_data.about_the_game:
Save the Fluffy Friends! 🐾

Evil hunters have raided the forest and locked 18 cute and fluffy animals in sturdy cages. The fate of these helpless creatures is now in your hands! Can you outsmart the poachers and restore freedom to every little furball?

Sharpen Your Memory and Save Lives

In front of you is a grid of face-down cards. To break the lock on a cage, you will need to show ultimate concentration:

  • Find the trios: flip the cards one by one and match 3 identical pictures in a row.

  • Remember the details: if the cards do not match, they flip back. Remember their positions to use them on your next turn!

  • Free the prisoners: as soon as the game board is completely cleared, one adorable animal is set free.

Game Features:

  • 🌟 18 unique levels with increasing difficulty that will challenge your focus.

  • 🦊 18 ultra-cute animals, each waiting for your help on their own level.

  • 🧠 Great brain training: the game perfectly develops visual memory and concentration for both adults and kids.

  • ⏱️ Smooth and addictive gameplay: a relaxing atmosphere where every correct move brings you closer to a good deed.

Become a true hero for the forest dwellers. Clear all the cards, unlock the cages, and give freedom back to your fluffy friends!

Additional Features:

  • 14 languages supported.

  • Screen brightness adjustments.

  • Detailed, bright, and colorful in-game graphics. The overall visual design creates a pleasant and cozy atmosphere.

  • The background music is non-distracting and helps you focus.

  • Each level starts with its own unique background track, and then the melodies play sequentially.

  • Music volume control and mute option available.

  • Levels can be selected and completed in any order you prefer.

  • You can leave the current level at any moment and choose another one.

  • Each level is completely unique due to the randomized card shuffling.

  • Once a level is cleared, the locked animal is freed and "comes to life" — our unique know-how!

  • 19 Steam achievements included.

  • Support for new levels via future DLCs.

Drawbacks:

  • Minor bugs or issues might occur, but they will certainly be fixed.

Upcoming Plans:

  • Adding Steam Trading Cards. However, this depends on player activity and positive reviews. I won't insist, but I truly hope you enjoy my game and share your feedback with others!

THIS GAME TRAINS YOUR VISUAL MEMORY.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your first patch of grass is free. Harvest it, earn a few coins, plant a little more, buy another upgrade—and watch your field come to life. Grass Cutting Game is a cute incremental farming game about harvesting by hand and raising Softlings with their own special talents. What starts with a single plant soon becomes a whole field of busy little helpers.

Four Softlings. One big harvest!

Those busy Sickle-tail Softlings have a big trick up their sleeves. Develop their abilities, unlock Dragon Flash and pick your spot. Watch four Softlings merge into one big yellow Softling for a sweeping harvest. Mature plants disappear in a burst of activity and coins pop up—a satisfying payoff for all those upgrades.

You draw the route. They cut the grass.

Connect the grass you want to harvest and let your Speed Softling dash along the route. Go across, up, down or diagonally, then turn a corner into the next row. Sweep through neat rows or link scattered patches into a route of your own.

Start by swinging the sickle yourself. Then enjoy watching your little helpers bustle back and forth. This is automation you build, one harvest at a time.

Make the first cut. Let them keep it going.

Did those chives just grow back the moment you cut them? An Assassin Softling sends a helper to take over, harvesting again and again for as long as that plant keeps triggering Instant Rebirth. Harvest a non-rainbow rose and the Witch Softling can collect all other roses of the same color that are already mature, using her magic pocket.

Different plants and different Softlings give your field its own rhythm. Upgrade another trait or unlock another companion, and a familiar patch of ground can turn into a new little spectacle.

Harvest now—or wait just a little longer?

Grass can split, chives can regrow, and roses can become colorful variants. Golden Wheat asks you to get the timing right: wait for its perfect stage for a richer harvest, but leave it too long and it will wither. Fence off plants you want to keep, let your Softlings work elsewhere, and save that harvest for yourself.

Keep unlocking mushrooms and Fungal Mats to bring acceleration, memory, echo and parasitic effects into your field. Group your crops, give your helpers their own areas to work in, and try new combinations. How much more can you get out of this little patch of land?

Spend your next coins on a more satisfying harvest.

Make each plant worth more. Improve the chance of splitting, instant regrowth or colorful variants. Or save up for the Softling you have had your eye on. As you work your way through the skill tree, each investment changes what happens in your field.

From a single patch of grass to rows of growing plants, busy Softlings and a Dragon Flash sweeping across the field—grow at your own pace, until “one more harvest” becomes “one more thing to unlock.”

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Mammalarium — your personal wildlife sanctuary built from golden autumn woodland, mossy fallen logs, and clear running streams. Discover, care for, and grow over 500 unique mammal species across nine richly themed habitats.

Bring Your Mammals to Your Desktop

With a single click, your mammals leave the habitat and roam freely across your real desktop — characterful, transparent companions padding over your windows while you work, study, or browse. They never get in the way: clicks pass right through them, and a tap of ESC sends them home. Your living collection, alive on your screen.

Collect Over 500 Unique Mammal Species

Build the ultimate mammal library across nine themed packs — Cats & Civets, Dogs & Bears, Rodents & Rabbits, Marsupials, Primates, Deer & Antelope, Hoofed Giants, Sea Mammals, and Ancient Oddities. Each species is assigned one of seven rarity tiers — from Common to Ancient. Unlock stunning visual variants: Normal, Painted, Golden, and Rainbow. From tiny shrews to great whales, complete your collection one species at a time.

Watch Babies Grow Into Magnificent Adults

Witness the wild come alive in real time. Tiny babies wobble into your habitat on unsteady legs. Watch them grow into magnificent adults — foxes trotting through fallen leaves, red pandas dozing along a branch, elephants raising dust at the waterhole. Release them for instant rewards, or keep them in your habitat for steady passive income. Every decision shapes your strategy.

Earn While You're Away

Your sanctuary keeps thriving in the background while you work, study, or browse the web. The automatic feeding system keeps your mammals happy and fed; when you return, gathered rewards are waiting. No pressure, no timers — just progress at your own pace.

Design Your Dream Habitats

Choose from logs, ferns, boulders, decorations, and day-night lighting cycles. Customize multiple habitats exactly the way you want. Build a golden autumn woodland, a red desert outback, or a misty cypress swamp — this is your sanctuary, your rules.

Compete on Global Leaderboards

Climb the rankings by total collection value or by the number of unique species you've discovered. See how your sanctuary measures up against mammal keepers worldwide.

store_data.about_the_game:
After the Child Falls Asleep

The lights go out. The house goes still. Then the floorboards begin to creak.

The toys are getting up.

You're the New One

Tonight is your first night in this room. Nobody welcomes you.

They close into a circle and push you toward the board. You are made to sit.

Something is fastened around your neck. A small, tidy click. You will not be getting up.

Lose, and You Break

Every piece on their side of the board looks exactly the same.

Mixed in among them are the ones you must not take.

You find out which is which only after you have taken one.

Get it wrong, and it isn't your opponent who pays for it. It's you.

Outread, Outbluff, Survive

There is no way out of this room that does not run across the board.

Only those who read it right see morning.

store_data.about_the_game:
Feranidus is a top-down sandbox RPG about raising creatures and building a party around them. You start at your base with a sword, a pickaxe, an axe, and a single egg.

FEED IT. WATCH IT CHANGE.

You feed your creatures elemental Drives: Ember, Frost, Tide, Spark, Gale, Terra. Which you feed decides what they turn into, what skills they unlock, and their play-styles. Colors shift, features grow in, the silhouette changes as you're feeding them.

Six base species branch into more than fifty visually distinct evolved forms.

REACTIONS ARE THE COMBAT

Fights are real-time and you are in them, moving and dodging and swinging. Your creatures fight beside you as real bodies. The depth is in the setup.

Chill something, then burn it. Soak it, then shock it. Every element does something to every other one, so your party is really a set of tools you picked on purpose. Explore combinations to find which synergies and team comps work best.

THE PARTY IS THE BUILD

Over a hundred skill books to teach, six elements to combine, pure or hybrid, skill-trees, and unique weapons.

Construct your build and theory-craft the best itemization from a pool of over 100 accessories that both you and your creatures can equip.

Three class sets: Bulwark, Strider, and Wildcaller. Each shapes how you fight without ever locking you into a class you had to pick before you understood the game. Wildcaller lets you take direct control of your creatures.

GO FURTHER OUT

Nineteen sub-biomes, each with its own species, drops, and enemies. Nine bosses that test whether your party actually works.

Traversal is the gate and your creatures are the key. Flight, swimming, clearing boulders, and hazards. The map opens up because of something you raised.

BRING SOMEONE

Take on the world with just your creatures or invite up to 3 friends for online co-op. Same world, same base, same hunt.

AND WHEN YOU WANT A QUIETER DAY

There is a base to build, a garden to keep, and mini-games. Unwind with farming, crafting, racing, sparring, and creatures to reincarnate into something stronger.

store_data.about_the_game:
TAKE THAT SHOT

Ever wondered what would happen if a basketball had to climb a ridiculous obstacle course?

Take That Shot is a physics-based 3D platforming game where you control a basketball and try to make it all the way to the top. Bounce, roll, launch yourself into the air and find the right angle to overcome a constantly changing series of obstacles.

But getting to the top won't be easy.

BOUNCE. ROLL. FLY.

The course is packed with all kinds of obstacles designed to mess with your momentum. Launchers send you flying, platforms throw you in unexpected directions, jumps test your timing, and every bounce can send you somewhere you really didn't expect.

Master your movement, control your momentum and figure out how to get through each section without falling all the way back down.

CLIMB TO THE TOP

There is only one way to finish the course: up.

Every section brings new challenges and new ways to fall. Learn the course, improve your movement and try to make it further than your last attempt.

One bad bounce can ruin everything.

BRING YOUR FRIENDS

Don't want to suffer alone?

Jump into co-op and climb together with your friends. Work your way through the course, help each other reach difficult sections—or get in each other's way.

You can bounce into your friends, knock them off platforms and send them flying while everyone races to be the first one to reach the top.

Sometimes teamwork is the fastest way up.

Sometimes your friend is the obstacle.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your Legacy: Generations is a life and economy simulator about building a future through work, education, financial decisions and family. Begin with limited resources, decide what matters to you and shape a life whose influence continues long after the first generation.

Choose your direction. Pursue qualifications, enter a career, start a business, invest in property or combine several paths as your circumstances change. Every opportunity costs time and money, and every decision contributes to the person—and family—you become.

BUILD YOUR LIFE

• Study for qualifications and pursue careers across a wide range of industries
• Balance work, routines, health and personal needs
• Navigate opportunities, setbacks and changing circumstances
• Make choices that shape your personality, relationships and future options

MASTER YOUR FINANCES

• Manage cash, savings, debt and superannuation
• Rent a home or enter the property market
• Purchase residential, commercial and industrial investments or aspire to buying an island!
• Track mortgages, rental income, repairs and changing property values
• Build businesses, improve their performance and decide where the profits go

CREATE A LASTING LEGACY

A successful life does not end with retirement. Choose an heir and continue the family story through a new generation. Pass down wealth, property, earned traits and the lasting consequences of earlier decisions.

Each generation begins from the world left behind by the last. Careful planning can create opportunity, while unresolved debts and difficult choices may become part of the inheritance.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE

Your Legacy: Generations is designed as a thoughtful, single-player simulation without reaction-based inputs or time pressure. Pause to review your position, consider your options and return to your life whenever you are ready.

There is no single definition of success. Build wealth, serve your community, create a business empire, focus on family—or attempt to balance it all.

Your town. Your choices. Your legacy.

store_data.about_the_game:
Seal the Sector

It's your job to contain the unpredictable Electro-Blob that has returned from Laser Ball (2018).  This angry massive blob of ten-billion watts of raw electricity has escaped once again and it's raw power and completely random direction, speed, and size make no two games the same!

To beat each progressively more difficult level, you must contain the Electro-Blob in a 20% or less area of the arena but cutting lines across the sector.  Section it off at 80% or more and you advance to the next level and score any bonus points based on true 'risk vs reward' scoring mechanics.  It's really simple really as the less section or boxes you make to get hit your 80% goal, the more points you score.  The smaller section you pin the Electro-Blob in, the more bonus points you score.  

The Electro-Blob is the featured foe, but hunters also will ensure that you aren't sitting idle to plan your next move for more than a few seconds at any given time.  They patrol the arena, moving along the border and along any new lines you've made.  Touching one of these hunters doesn't end your life, but will instead make things even harder by spawning a brand new golden Electro-Blob into the unsealed arena near you!

Section 80 is a retro action game inspired by classics I've played as a child on my classic Commodore 64.  There simple aren't enough games like this on Steam, and this was created and developed to bring back this kind of electric fun to a whole new population of gamers today!

store_data.about_the_game:
BOOKED is a cozy first-person library game about finding misplaced books and returning them to where they belong.

Step inside a warm and welcoming library filled with colorful shelves, themed collections, and more than 100 different books. Books have been left in the wrong places, and it is up to you to explore the library, find them, and work out which shelf each one belongs on.

Look at the covers, recognize each series, and slowly bring order back to the library. There are no monsters to fight, no time limits to worry about, and no pressure to rush. BOOKED is designed to be a relaxing experience where you can simply enjoy organizing, exploring, and discovering the different books scattered throughout the library.

FEATURES

• Find and organize more than 100 books
• Discover multiple original book series, each with its own theme and cover art
• Explore a cozy library at your own pace
• Match misplaced books with their correct shelves
• A relaxed, pressure-free gameplay experience
• No combat and no horror — just books, shelves, and satisfying organization
• A short and cozy experience made for players who enjoy sorting, collecting, and tidying up

Every book has its place.

Can you put them all back where they belong?

store_data.about_the_game:
Muritura is designed to invoke discovery. You might get a little lost along the way, but with clever thinking, a limited (but potent) tool set, and some serious scurrying you can overcome the challenges that await. After the relative comfort of the Forest, the world opens up letting you explore your own path. There are no quest markers out there, but you will find the world has plenty to say about what happened if you listen closely.

Combat

Fight or flee from foes.

Customize

Customize your fur pattern, house, and attire.

Explore

Use your tools to explore.

Inventory

There is little to no inventory management to deal with in Muritura. There are no questionably useful resources filling up your limited inventory slots or rapidly outdated, green rarity swords to scrap. Your sword is useful from the moment you get it until the end of the game.

Difficulty

With seven difficulty options ranging from Story Mode to Challenge Mode, there's sure to be one that's just right. Changing the difficulty only determines how many mistakes you can make before fainting. Enemies do not get more spongy.

Made By Humans

No AI was used at any stage in the creation or conception of this product.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build by day. Defend by night.

Cowboys vs Orcs is a farm-defense action game playable solo or in online co-op for up to four players.

During the day, gather resources, grow crops, care for animals, craft equipment, and build the defenses that will keep your farm standing. When night falls, orc warbands march from the north, smashing through anything between them and your farmhouse.

Your goal is simple: protect the farm through 100 increasingly dangerous nights.

Build a Working Farm

Chop trees, mine ores, plant crops, and turn raw materials into the supplies your farm needs.

Breed cows and chickens, collect their produce, ride cattle across the farm, and craft specialized harnesses that let your animals haul resources, operate machinery, and manage supplies.

Prepare Your Defenses

Design your own defensive line using fences, gates, spike barricades, palisades, log ramparts, bastions, weapon platforms, and mounted guns.

Buildings remain between nights and retain damage, so every battle leaves its mark. Repair weak points, improve your production, and rethink your layout before the next army arrives.

Fight Escalating Orc Armies

Start with simple melee weapons and work your way toward revolvers, hunting rifles, shotguns, automatic weapons, Gatling guns, bombs, and bazookas.

The attacking force grows every night—from a lone orc on the first night to a final army of 10,000. Orcs attack players, tear down blocking defenses, and advance toward the farmhouse. If the farmhouse falls, recover what you can, rebuild, and prepare to fight again.

Farm Alone or Together

Create a persistent farm and play by yourself or invite up to three friends. Resources, discoveries, buildings, animals, and campaign progress are shared, allowing your group to divide the work—or create agricultural chaos together.

Farm. Build. Automate. Arm the livestock. Survive the night.

store_data.about_the_game:
Facelet is a roguelike deckbuilder played on a scrambled puzzle cube, all about lining up colors and getting paid for them.

Twist the cube, hand it in, and score every pattern that lines up on the face. Stack Algorithms that read the cube in different ways, take Parities that trade a handicap for a bonus, and bank enough to clear the next Depth. You do not have to solve the cube. You have to make it pay.

THE CUBE IS THE HAND

You get four hands and five twists per Solve. Every twist moves several faces at once, so every pattern and every card in play changes with it. The game pays for pairs, lines, diagonals, Ls, blocks, crosses, a clean face if you can get one, and much more.

  • 100+ Algorithms, each scoring the cube in its own way

  • 30+ Parities that pay you for a handicap

  • 20+ Mods granting permanent upgrades for the current run

  • 20+ Specials, stickers you place on a single facelet

  • 20+ Tools, single use, for the hand that isn't working

  • Cases you open for a card you did not plan for

  • 9 bosses, each with a rule that changes the cube itself

YOU DON'T HAVE TO SOLVE IT

If you can solve a cube, Facelet pays extremely well for it. If you can't, a face that is half one color still scores, and most of the deck is built for reading the cube rather than solving it. Six Depths, three Solves each, and the target climbs the whole way.

BOSSES THAT BREAK THE CUBE

Every third Solve is a boss, and they do not just raise the number.

  • One grows your cube into a 4x4 for a single Solve.

  • One strips it down to a 2x2.

  • One turns the lights off until you turn each layer.

  • One gives you a single hand and takes the rest.

  • Many others you will find while playing.

A sheet that fills in with new cards and rules run after run.

Run stats and a full card collection to study between runs.

store_data.about_the_game:
One coin. One name. Forever.

It's raining. You're in a back street you probably shouldn't be in.

There's a man standing there.

Stay a bit... don't be afraid.

Five minutes

That's how long this takes, and it isn't pretending otherwise.

No combat. No puzzles. Nothing to fail.

Just listen to this strange man.

Relax, there's a fire to stand near. A radio you can turn on. A stool, if you'd rather sit.

One wall is covered floor to ceiling in post-it notes — a name on every square.

The man hands you a pen.

Your name will go up, with a number that belongs to nobody else.

Why it costs a coin

I'm a solo developer, and I'm building a bigger game called SCRAWLERZ.

This is a way I'm paying for it — one coin at a time, from people who stopped.

The wall is the receipt.

The small print

Your name stays on the wall for as long as you own a game copy in your library.

If enough people stop, this might end up as the longest list of names on Steam....

But that part isn't up to me.

store_data.about_the_game:
Neon Bastion is a single-player tower defense game about building adaptable defense networks on open terrain. Place towers freely, read enemy layers, and time abilities and run-defining choices across a 20-mission neon campaign and replayable challenge modes.

BUILD THE LINE YOUR WAY

Place towers on buildable off-path terrain instead of fixed sockets. Shape overlapping fields of fire, use hardpoints, and adapt as pressure arrives across multiple routes without blocking the enemy path.

READ THE THREAT, BREAK THE LAYERS

Enemies advertise distinct armor, shielding, speed, support, and disruption roles. Match visible threats with the right counters, change targeting priorities, and use Flux Gates when timing matters more than raw damage.

COMMIT TO A DEFENSE NETWORK

Choose from 15 tower chassis. Each chassis develops through three exclusive Tier III branches and two Tier V capstone states, creating different jobs instead of a single linear upgrade ladder.

COMMAND THE BATTLE

Lead one of six commanders, trigger tower and commander abilities, choose Protocols during a run, and spend Overdrive at the moment it can change the outcome.

DEFEND A TWENTY-MISSION CAMPAIGN

Fight through 20 authored missions across 10 sectors, then return for Endless, Boss Rush, Daily, Weekly, Lockdown, challenge-code runs, and Bastion Lab play. Difficulty settings from Story through Apocalypse let you choose the pressure level.

KEEP LOCAL CONTROL

Use windowed, borderless, or fullscreen display; remap controls; scale interface and text; tune contrast, effects, flashes, screen shake, sound, and game speed; and review local records and compatible deterministic replays.

store_data.about_the_game:
HELL IS A NINE-CIRCLE TOUR

You are a doom metal band. The venue is Hell. Twenty-seven gigs stand between you and getting off this stage — three fights per circle, nine circles deep, with a boss waiting at the end of each one.

VESTIBULE is a roguelike deckbuilder about building a band, stacking riffs, and hitting hard enough to kill things that are already dead.

STRIKES, NOT TURNS

Every fight gives you a set number of Strikes to work with — four, most runs. Between them you play cards: riffs that buff your members, utility that keeps you alive, embers that pay for all of it.

Then you Strike, and every member swings at once — one multiplier cascade of cards, Riff Chains, artifacts and pedals, all stacking into a single number.

BUILD THE BAND

Eighteen musicians across nine roles — guitarists, a drummer, a synth player, a vocalist, and a few things that aren't technically people. Ten keywords define how they play, and they stack: FRENZIED, BLASTBEAT, DISSONANCE, DIRGE, ANCHOR, TRICKSTER, and more.

Only the third fight of each circle — the boss — has a real trick up its sleeve. The Drifter survives its own death, once. The Devourer heals off every card you play. Lucifer gets two full health bars.

SIXTEEN RIFF CHAINS, NONE OF THEM LABELLED

Certain cards, played in the same Strike, chain into each other for a real multiplier spike. The chains aren't listed anywhere in the UI — you find them by playing. (There's a toggle if you'd rather just be told.)

THE DESCENT

Nine circles, Dante's own, three fights each: Limbo, Lust, Gluttony, Greed, Anger, Heresy, Violence, Fraud, Treachery. Then Lucifer — two phases, 6,660 HP — waiting at the bottom. About one run in a hundred sees him dead. He's meant to be a wall.

Between fights: a shop, a descent choice, and if you've got the Stash for it, a trip from the Dealer — special items, each one a gamble on a one-fight buff that can just as easily go bad.

FIVE DECKS, FIVE STAKES

Five starter decks, each a different way to play: Standard's balanced and chain-dense, the Shredder is pure aggro, the Chaos deck reshuffles itself at random every single run, the Engineer builds around card copies, and the Survivor gives every member a second chance before they go down. Beat one, unlock the next.

Climb the Stakes and the whole thing gets meaner — more enemy damage, pricier shops, no heals between fights — until Demonic drops you to three Strikes a fight instead of four.

THE MUSIC IS REAL

The soundtrack is doom metal, recorded rather than assembled. Real riffs, written for the circle you're standing in.

EARLY ACCESS — LAUNCHING OCTOBER 2026

Vestibule is in active development. Everything above — the band, the decks, all nine circles, Lucifer — is built and running. What's left before launch is balance, polish, and whatever more playtesting turns up.

Cut Kush. Bounce scissors. Make cash.

Ganja Ricochet is a chaotic 3D pinball-pachinko game built around physics, timing, strategy, and progression. Launch your scissors into the arena, cut plants, trigger chain reactions, build massive combos, and send buds through multiplier lanes to maximize your harvest.

Master 4 Unique Arenas

Face 4 powerful Boss Plants designed to test your aim, timing, equipment, and ability to create high-value chain reactions. Learn their challenges, find the right angles, and cut your way to victory.

Ganja Ricochet combines pinball physics, pachinko chaos, satisfying progression, and strategic build choices in a colorful and replayable experience.

Cut deeper. Bounce farther. Build the ultimate Kush empire.

  • Fight across 14 battlefields with different terrain, pressure, and tactical rhythms.
  • Shape each single-player roguelite run with battlefield upgrades and army synergies.
  • Keyboard-and-mouse controls with interface support for 12 languages.

store_data.about_the_game:
Core Panic! is a co-op game about one hungry machine and people who keep it moving.

You mine. You haul. You shove piles of ore across the floor with your own body. The Core eats fuel and it never stops eating: so someone has to dig ahead, someone has to carry, and nobody has time to do it calmly.

Everything you do makes noise, and noise is what wakes the things living in the rock. Mine fast and you get rich; mine loud and you get company.

  • 1-4 players, couch or online

  • An endless underground, generated as you push into it

  • Physics you can feel: every rock, every pile, every shove

  • Reach the Pod, cash in what you dragged back, and go again

store_data.about_the_game:
Your cursor is gone. In its place: a chunky wooden baseball bat that follows your mouse (or your controller stick) like a very violent balloon.

In front of you, on a tee, sits a potato. It has googly eyes. It has a little speech bubble that says "I am a potato."

You have ten seconds.

SMACK IT. Every hit stacks damage - 40%, 300%, 900%, and there is no cap. Chain your hits for a combo multiplier. Then hold the button to wind up a MEGA SWING, let go at full charge, and launch that spud so far into the sky it starts yelling about destiny.

Distance in feet is your score. That's it. That's the leaderboard.




Once it's airborne, the potato becomes a screaming yellow comet with opinions: "I HAVE BEEN CHOSEN", "WITNESS ME!!", "MOM GET THE CAMERA", "THE SKY TASTES BUTTERY" - over two dozen one-liners, hollered mid-arc.

The sky is littered with randomly scattered coin clusters. Thread through them and they're yours. Miss them and think about your choices. Coins buy upgrades, upgrades buy more feet, more feet buy more coins. The loop closes with an audible click.

Down on the ground, a distance sign every 100 feet keeps score with over sixty potato puns, because someone had to say SPUDNIK, taterhawk, get forked, holy mash!, and no gods no mashers out loud.




  • BATTLE (10 seconds) - Move the bat with your mouse or stick. Tap to smack and build damage %. Land the bat's very tip for a SWEET TIP. Keep the chain alive for a combo.
  • CHARGE - Hold to wind up. Cross 95% and the bat screams FULL POWER. Spend a SLOW-MO charge to bullet-time the wind-up if your nerves need help.
  • LAUNCH - Release. Launch between 25 and 55 degrees for a NICE ANGLE bonus. Whiff entirely and the bat whistles through empty air. Smack it backwards into the wall behind home plate and you earn a hearty WRONG WAY and a game over.
  • FLIGHT - Hands off. Watch it soar, bounce, glide, collect coins, and shout.
  • SPUD SHOP - Spend the loot. Come back angrier.




  • PRECISION - Longer bat reach. Hit the thing you meant to hit.
  • POWER - Swing harder. Bigger launch.
  • GLIDE - Aerodynamic spud. More hang time, more sky, more coins.
  • BOUNCE - Rubbery turf on landing. Boing. Boing. Boing.
  • COMBO - Rapid hits stack a fatter multiplier.
  • OVERTIME - +1 second on the clock per level. Ten seconds was never enough.
  • SLOW-MO - Consumable bullet-time charges for the wind-up.




  • Your mouse is the bat. No aiming reticle, no click-to-swing menu - one input, zero tutorial, instant understanding.
  • Uncapped damage. 1,500%+ is genuinely reachable. The potato is not okay.
  • A pure distance leaderboard. One number, in feet. A global Steam leaderboard plus your own personal top 5 runs with the damage you dealt on each.
  • 32 Steam achievements - from Chip City to Moon Mash (30,000 ft) to Wrong Way, Champ and Nailed To The Plate, for the player who let the whole clock run out and did absolutely nothing.
  • Runs last about 30 seconds. "One more" is not a marketing claim, it is a structural inevitability.
  • Controller support - stick-driven bat and full menu navigation on an Xbox-style pad. Typing a custom leaderboard name needs a keyboard; on Steam your persona name is used automatically.
  • Hand-drawn-look 2D, drawn entirely in code. Chunky ink outlines, sunset gradients, googly eyes with real blink timing.
  • Comfort options - screen-shake toggle, a flashing-FX toggle for photosensitivity (kills the launch flash and speed lines), separate master, SFX and music volume, windowed/borderless/fullscreen, vsync and FPS cap.
  • Runs on anything. Tiny download, no launcher, no account, no online requirement.


There is a bat. There is a potato. There is the horizon, and the potato is going to meet it.

"I am a potato." - the potato, moments before takeoff

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into the ultimate miniature workshop.

Take old, forgotten, rusted diecast cars and turn them into head-turning collectibles. Diecast Car Restoration brings the relaxing, detailed, and highly satisfying world of scale car restoration and customization straight to your workbench. Unbox dusty finds, strip them down to raw metal, apply brilliant custom finishes, and assemble your dream garage one miniature build at a time.

Key Features:

  • Complete Disassembly & Restoration Mechanics

    Every project starts with a story. Unbox dirty flea-market finds or forgotten attic treasures. Carefully unscrew chassis rivets, pop out interior pieces, detach windows, and separate body panels. Strip away decades of rust, oxidized metal, and cracked original paint using specialized tools and chemical baths until you're left with a clean canvas.

  • Advanced Customization & Paint Workshop

    Unleash your creative potential with a full suite of custom workbench tools:

    • Surface Prep: Sand down body lines, apply smooth primers, and polish metal surfaces.

    • Paint Studio: Spray factory-accurate classic shades, custom metallic coats, gloss finishes, or two-tone paint schemes.

    • Decals & Livery Designer: Apply precision scale stickers, racing stripes, flame graphics, and custom sponsor decals to give your builds a unique personality.

  • Aftermarket Part Swaps & Upgrades

    Don't just restore—customize! Swap stock factory components with a massive lineup of aftermarket parts. Change up stance, fit custom wheel setups, adjust body kits, add custom exhausts, and swap interior details. Whether you're aiming for a factory-mint original look or a aggressive custom build, the choice is entirely yours.

  • Build Your Dream Collection Wall

    Your hard work deserves a display. Bring your finished diecast models into your personal home garage room. Customize your showcase wall with modular shelving, dynamic spotlighting, themed backdrops, and organized display cases to highlight your growing diecast empire.

  • Immersive Scale Diorama Studio

    Take your custom creations beyond the display shelf. Design, build, and decorate fully interactive scale dioramas! Construct miniature neon-lit city streets, vintage restoration garages, underground parking lots, or scenic mountain passes. Arrange your vehicles, adjust lighting angles, and use the built-in Photo Mode to capture stunning high-resolution shots of your collection.

  • Relaxing Gameplay & Satisfying Progression

    Enjoy a meditative, stress-free simulation loop with realistic audio feedback—from the click of tiny parts fitting into place to the steady hiss of the airbrush. Complete restoration contracts, unlock rare diecast models, expand your tool catalog, and become the ultimate scale automotive craftsman.

store_data.about_the_game:
Descend through a shifting pixel-art dungeon, swap colors to break enemy defenses, and choose whether to kill or stun your way through a ruined world divided by rival crowns.

Every crown leaves a stain.

The Ink was created to heal a dying world. Frogs gave it renewal. Mushrooms gave it memory. Then their rulers fought to own it—and the cure became a living catastrophe known as the Long Spill.

From the village of Frogshroom, descend through the buried reservoirs where that disaster began. Battle strange enemies, uncover sealed histories, and decide which crown—if either—deserves your loyalty.

Master Color-Changing Combat

Swap between red and blue to counter enemy defenses, navigate dense projectile patterns, and create openings with precisely timed stuns. Dash through danger, perfect your reloads, and defeat numbered enemies in order to earn greater rewards.

Choose How You Fight

Enemies do not always need to die. Develop your stun abilities and attempt a nonlethal descent—or embrace destruction and deal with the reputation you leave behind.

Dungeon inhabitants can also be rescued, ignored, or killed. The Frog Court and Mushroom Crown will remember your decisions.

Every Descent Is Different

Explore procedurally assembled rooms filled with shifting enemy combinations, secret chambers, treasure, breakable environments, quests, and increasingly dangerous challenges. The deeper you travel, the more aggressive the dungeon becomes.

Build Your Champion

Collect Ink, coins, equipment, and permanent upgrades. Unlock new playable characters, weapons, hats, and pets, then shape a build suited to your preferred style—whether that means overwhelming firepower, perfect movement, or mastering the stun system.

Features

  • Fast top-down pixel-art combat

  • Red-and-blue color-switching mechanics

  • Lethal and nonlethal ways to clear encounters

  • Twelve dungeon floors across four distinct regions

  • Challenging bosses and hidden depths

  • Procedurally assembled rooms and varied enemy archetypes

  • Frog and Mushroom reputation paths

  • Quests, permanent upgrades, characters, weapons, hats, and pets

  • Secret rooms, flawless clears, ordered eliminations, and difficult achievements

  • Multiple difficulty settings, including Impossible Mode
store_data.detailed_description:
Descend through a shifting pixel-art dungeon, swap colors to break enemy defenses, and choose whether to kill or stun your way through a ruined world divided by rival crowns.

Every crown leaves a stain.

The Ink was created to heal a dying world. Frogs gave it renewal. Mushrooms gave it memory. Then their rulers fought to own it—and the cure became a living catastrophe known as the Long Spill.

From the village of Frogshroom, descend through the buried reservoirs where that disaster began. Battle strange enemies, uncover sealed histories, and decide which crown—if either—deserves your loyalty.

Master Color-Changing Combat

Swap between red and blue to counter enemy defenses, navigate dense projectile patterns, and create openings with precisely timed stuns. Dash through danger, perfect your reloads, and defeat numbered enemies in order to earn greater rewards.

Choose How You Fight

Enemies do not always need to die. Develop your stun abilities and attempt a nonlethal descent—or embrace destruction and deal with the reputation you leave behind.

Dungeon inhabitants can also be rescued, ignored, or killed. The Frog Court and Mushroom Crown will remember your decisions.

Every Descent Is Different

Explore procedurally assembled rooms filled with shifting enemy combinations, secret chambers, treasure, breakable environments, quests, and increasingly dangerous challenges. The deeper you travel, the more aggressive the dungeon becomes.

Build Your Champion

Collect Ink, coins, equipment, and permanent upgrades. Unlock new playable characters, weapons, hats, and pets, then shape a build suited to your preferred style—whether that means overwhelming firepower, perfect movement, or mastering the stun system.

Features

  • Fast top-down pixel-art combat

  • Red-and-blue color-switching mechanics

  • Lethal and nonlethal ways to clear encounters

  • Twelve dungeon floors across four distinct regions

  • Challenging bosses and hidden depths

  • Procedurally assembled rooms and varied enemy archetypes

  • Frog and Mushroom reputation paths

  • Quests, permanent upgrades, characters, weapons, hats, and pets

  • Secret rooms, flawless clears, ordered eliminations, and difficult achievements

  • Multiple difficulty settings, including Impossible Mode
store_data.short_description: Descend into a shifting pixel-art dungeon where color is your weapon. Swap between red and blue, master fast top-down combat, and choose whether to kill or stun your enemies as rival Frog and Mushroom crowns fight for control of the living Ink.

store_data.about_the_game:
BUILD A COLLECTION THAT WORKS FOR YOU

In The Archive Project, you play as a young Archivist summoned to a city striving for renewal. Travel across different worlds, open booster packs, and collect new cards to complete your Album, fill the Archive Hall, and help the city grow. Every discovery expands your collection and becomes a lasting source of progression.

Set in a gothic fantasy world, card collecting meets idle strategy: develop your city, improve your cards and combine several permanent systems to build an increasingly powerful economy.

OPEN, COLLECT AND PERFECT

Discover hundreds of illustrated cards across many sets. Every pack contains six cards, and every acquisition can join your collection as one of five variants: Normal, Shiny, Full Art, Gold or Cosmic.

- Complete the cards, families and variants of each set.

- Automatically turn true duplicates into Dust.

- Earn XP, Gems and Orbs as your collection grows.

- Inspect your cards in detail and select favorites to personalize your profile.

DEVELOP YOUR CITY

Your city is the heart of your progression. Upgrade six buildings up to level 20 to increase production, strengthen collection rewards and gain access to new systems.

Improve the Mine to generate more Gold, expand the Archive, unlock further opportunities through the Portal, and invest in the Workshop, Research Center and Manor.

TURN YOUR ALBUM INTO POWER

Every step forward in the Album improves your overall progression. Complete families, gather the variants of each set and earn permanent bonuses that can amplify your Gold, Dust and future pack openings.

Your collection is never just an inventory: every card can contribute to your economy and your next strategic decision.

SHAPE YOUR CARDS IN THE WORKSHOP

Use the resources you have accumulated to customize and strengthen your collection:

- craft new cards and premium variants;

- permanently improve their Power and Gold production;

- inscribe or reroll their effects;

- convert Gems and Orbs into higher-tier resources.

CHART YOUR PATH THROUGH MORE THAN 300 TALENTS

Develop a vast constellation dedicated to Gold, Dust, Cards, Workshop, Expeditions and the Monolith. Choose your priorities, unlock new rings of talents and shape your progression around the strategy you want to pursue.

ASSEMBLE YOUR EXPEDITION TEAMS

Send your cards on missions with different durations and difficulty levels. Your team’s Power determines the quality of the outcome and the rewards earned, including Gold, Dust, XP, Gems, Orbs and others resources.

Your cards are never consumed. They remain part of your collection while contributing to your expedition strategy.

CURATE YOUR OWN MUSEUM

Forge and collect relics inspired by the game’s different worlds. Every relic has its own rarity, quality, prefixes and suffixes, creating distinct combinations that influence your economy.

Display up to nine relics, optimize their bonuses and dismantle the ones you no longer need to recover Relic Fragments. Trophies earned through achievements also have their own dedicated exhibition space.

AWAKEN THE MONOLITH

Select sixteen cards from your collection and build a complete composition. Rarities, families, sets and variants can work together to activate bonuses and resonances that influence your entire progression.

Create multiple compositions, save your presets and adapt the Monolith to the goals you are pursuing.

A DEEP, INTERCONNECTED IDLE PROGRESSION

In The Archive Project, every system feeds into the next. Card packs expand the Album, the Album strengthens your economy, the city opens new possibilities, and your cards gain further purpose through the Workshop, Expeditions, Museum and Monolith.

Track your journey through detailed statistics, unlock achievements, personalize your profile and patiently build an archive that reflects your own strategy.

store_data.about_the_game:
Aeterna: Shattered Legacy is a retro-style fantasy RPG inspired by classic top-down role-playing games.

Begin in the small village of Spring Haven, helping its residents, exploring the surrounding wilderness, and taking on simple quests. Before long, it becomes clear that the peace is temporary.

Explore towns, forests, ruins, dungeons, and other locations while talking to NPCs, completing quests, fighting enemies, uncovering hidden interactions, and piecing together the history of Aeterna.

Features

  • Classic top-down exploration

  • Turn-based combat

  • Side quests and optional story content

  • Hidden interactions and secrets

  • Towns, ruins, forests, and dungeons to explore

  • A dark fantasy conflict shaped by warring kingdoms, forgotten magic, and demonic power

Some quests are small and personal. Others begin to uncover a much larger conflict involving ancient kingdoms, forgotten magic, demonic power, and forces that have been waiting far longer than anyone realizes.

Customers from around the town will approach needing you to fix their beloved items that holds stories within. Items ranging from microphones, pocket-watches to plush toys with secrets inside. It is your duty to fix them and make those happy once more.

  • Variation of customers

  • Items to be fixed with different tools

  • Crafting to be able to use sources

  • Every asset is hand drawn and thought carefully

  • Easy on the eye and replayable

  • Fantasy and steampunk themed

store_data.about_the_game:
Basic info:

Two hands. One table. Ten fingers. Ready to Fart.

Take turns pulling, the wrong one goes off in your face and costs you a life.

You get three.

Last one sitting wins.

You get to see the amount of fart fingers based on the amount of glowing beans so pay attention, might prove to be helpful later. One bean per finger, and the glowing ones are the farts.

Count them.

That's the only honest information you're ever going to get.

Then the hands slam shut, the fingers open back up, and the beans are gone.

Items:

At the end of every round everyone gets something. You can see what everyone else is holding, so pay attention.

Anytime:

Milk - Life back. Six is the max lives. Drink it whenever, it's not that kind of item.

During turn only:

* Hot Sauce - Rub it on any finger. The fart on that finger does 2 lives damage instead of 1. You can pull it too, so don't forget where you placed it. If it isn't a fart finger, it deals no damage.

* Nail Clippers - Skip your turn entirely. Cowardly. Effective.

* Gas Mask - Eat the next fart for free, no damage. Hot sauce included.

*Can only be used before you make a selection during your turn, be mindful of the order you use your items in.

Five at a table:

Host a game, send the room code, done. Or invite people in off your Steam friends list.

Nobody around?

Bots will sit in. They use items, they play the odds, and

they will absolutely hot sauce a finger and then pull it themselves.

Also in there:

  • Pick your own character. Everybody picks their own.

  • More than one map to play in.

  • There's a setting for the middle finger to blur it if needed.

  • Adjustable Hand Color via the color wheel in the settings menu

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome Aboard!

You are the newest recruit of the crew! Your job? Take charge of a massive, chaotic cavern and organize thousands of scattered riches into their rightful spots. Clear the clutter, restore order, and prove you’ve got what it takes to be called a true pirate.

Bring Order to the Chaos

From stacks of coins to rare gems, rum barrels, weapons, solid gold bars and more — handle everything a pirate captain could ever dream of hoarding. Every single piece of loot belongs in its own dedicated place.

A treasure worthy of Blackbeard

The sheer scale of the loot is enormous, but don't let it intimidate you. There’s no rush here! Take your time, enjoy the process, and tackle the vault at your own pace.

Unleash the Power of the Seven Seas

You won't have to do it all with bare hands. Unlock powerful skills to speed up your organization and maximize your efficiency.

Key Features

  • Visual Satisfaction: Pirates love chaos... as long as it’s on someone else’s ship! Experience the relief of turning a messy cave into a flawlessly sorted masterpiece.

  • Immersive Atmosphere: Live the pirate life while you work — Sip on fine rum, unwind to atmospheric seafaring music and enjoy a warm cavern environment.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ashfall Command is a real-time strategy game about building a fortified base, commanding specialized military forces, and launching coordinated attacks against an enemy doing the same to you.

Build your base across an isometric battlefield and decide how to use limited space and resources. Position missile launchers, anti-air defenses, bunkers, and other military assets where they can protect one another—and where losing them won't cripple your ability to fight back.

When it's time to attack, choose your forces, identify targets, and commit them to the operation. Launch long-range missile strikes, deploy Marines behind enemy lines, and coordinate attacks designed to overwhelm defensive positions. Once the order is given, the battle unfolds in real time through cinematic battlefield presentations that keep you close to the action without demanding constant unit micromanagement.

But the enemy is planning too.

Incoming attacks can interrupt your own operations, forcing your defenses to respond while missiles descend and enemy troops enter your territory. Anti-air systems intercept incoming threats, bunkers engage invading forces, and the base layout you designed becomes part of the battle itself.

COMMAND THE BATTLE

  • Build and defend your base — Place military structures and defenses across terrain where positioning matters.

  • Plan coordinated attacks — Select forces, choose targets, and decide how much of your arsenal to commit.

  • Strike from above — Launch missile attacks against key enemy installations while defensive systems attempt to intercept them.

  • Deploy ground forces — Send Marines into hostile territory by dropship to attack targets from inside the enemy base.

  • Prepare for retaliation — Enemy attacks can arrive while you're managing your own base, turning defensive preparation into a critical part of your strategy.

  • Command instead of micromanage — Make the important tactical decisions and watch your orders play out through cinematic real-time combat.

Every launcher you lose reduces your ability to strike. Every defensive position you neglect creates an opening. Every force you commit to an attack is a force you may need somewhere else.

Build the base. Plan the attack. Survive the response.

Take command.

Take command.

store_data.about_the_game:
There is one needle hidden somewhere inside the haystack, and there are 1,000,000 pieces of hay standing between you and it. Your only objective is to find it.

There are no tools, no upgrades, no hints, no shortcuts, and nothing that makes the job easier. You search through the hay piece by piece until eventually, somehow, you find what you are looking for. You might get lucky and finish quickly. You might spend hours searching the wrong place. There is no way to know.

You can attempt the challenge alone or bring up to 5 friends in online co-op. More players means more people searching, more progress being made, and more people to blame when nobody can find the damn thing. The game keeps track of how much each player has searched and how long the suffering has lasted.

The needle is real. The challenge is possible. Nothing is stopping you from finishing it except the haystack itself.

Good luck.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build your own industrial base among the stars. Begin with a frontier space station, explore unknown regions of space, and develop your fleet and production network.

Deep Space Idle: Frontier Era is an idle management game centered around space exploration and industrial development. Even when you are away, resource production and research continue to progress. Return to plan your next steps and gradually expand your territory.

Explore and Develop

  • Mine minerals and harvest gases, build your own space station, and establish a stable resource supply chain

  • Manufacture ships through blueprints, unlocking blueprints for industrial ships, archaeology vessels, combat destroyers, and eventually Titans

  • Discover a wide variety of ship equipment, ammunition, and boosters

  • Research technologies to improve your industrial production capabilities

  • Recruit NPCs to form a legion and assemble your fleet

  • Venture into intense warzones and claim valuable loot

  • Explore ancient ruins, uncover the legacy of the Precursors, and discover the glory of civilizations long past

  • Explore the starmap, complete trials, and obtain valuable resources from wormholes

  • Manage production queues and automate your industrial processes

  • Continue accumulating resources and progress while you are offline

Single-Player at Its Core, Alliances as an Extension

The core gameplay can be played offline. Plan your mining, manufacturing, and combat progress at your own pace while exploring the starmap and gradually developing your territory.

Alliance features provide additional online interaction, including joining or creating an alliance, completing alliance missions, and working together to build an alliance star city. An internet connection is required for alliance features.

For Players Who Enjoy

Idle progression, resource management, space exploration, industrial production, technology unlocks, and slowly planning and building your own interstellar empire.

Thank you for supporting independent development.

store_data.about_the_game:
What kind of game is this

The Return of Illunes is a text-driven, hardcore turn-based roguelike RPG. Pick a class and subclass at your base, recruit companions into a party of up to four, and descend into the dungeon. At every fork you choose a node — battle, elite, shop, rest, trader or adventure event — going deeper until a boss blocks the floor. When you fall, the run ends, but relics, class unlocks and permanent upgrades carry into the next one.
The on-device AI writes the story, the dialogue, the lore of your loot, and the verdict on any action you type in yourself. Art, music and every number stay handmade and rule-bound, so the AI expands the experience without ever touching the balance.

The big one: an AI lives inside the game

A full language model ships inside the game and runs only on your PC. No internet, no servers, no subscription, no token fees. Every feature works on a plane.
The AI writes each run's story and content on the spot. Go down the same dungeon twice and you will never get the same run.

What the AI creates — content that exists only here

  • Run Bible — goals, threats, boss hints and the mood of this run, written fresh. "A misty manor ruled by the swamp puppeteer."
  • Synergies (3–5 per run) — run-defining rules like "fire attacks inflict bleed" or "crits reset cooldowns", new every time.
  • Oaths — brutal bargains like "no healing, but +30% attack", woven by the AI.
  • World Mutations — "enemies explode on death", "shops half price, no resting" — twists that bend the whole board.
  • Subclasses — "Silent Butcher", "Priest of the Ash Scripture" — practically endless variants.
  • Gear, relics and skills — names, lore and derived skills authored by the AI. No loot drops twice. Numbers and rewards are set by the game's rules.
  • Enemy loadouts — the same goblin arrives with a different skill set, redesigned for your party and threat level.
  • Battle and exploration narration — every turn's outcome and every node's scene, described live.

Free action: type what you want to do

If it isn't on the menu, write it. "Cut the chandelier loose." "Set the cobwebs on fire with the torch." The AI judges your action as ordinary, clever or game-changing, narrates the result, and the verdict changes the actual outcome of the fight. Sometimes ingenuity beats the numbers.

Game systems

  • 4 classes × 3 subclasses + AI-generated subclasses — practically unlimited builds
  • Party of up to 4, turn-based — auto/manual switching; combos, synergies, oaths and mutations interlock every turn
  • Branching node dungeon — battle, elite, shop, rest, trader, adventure events; a boss on every floor
  • Threat system — the more game-changers you pull, the more the world watches you
  • Meta progression — permanent upgrades, relic vault, class unlocks, achievements
  • On-device AI models for English, Korean and Japanese; other UI languages use the English AI

What makes this AI different

  • Fully offline — nothing leaves your machine
  • One purchase — no subscription, no token fees
  • Every generated line passes a check before it is shown

store_data.about_the_game:
Turtle Soup World is a lateral-thinking mystery game built around yes-or-no questions. You begin with a strange story that looks simple but hides crucial details. Explore locations, inspect objects, talk to NPCs, and ask the Turtle questions to eliminate wrong possibilities and reconstruct the complete truth behind each event.

A deduction adventure that begins with "yes" and "no."

Start with the "soup surface"

First understand the story as it is told and remember every ordinary-looking detail. The real clue is often hidden in the part of the narration that is easiest to overlook. The truth may also involve facts never mentioned in the soup surface.

Ask the Turtle

Ask questions that can be answered only with "yes," "no," or "yes and no." Confirm important facts and gradually narrow down the possible truth.

Explore the scene and find clues

Freely explore the place where the story happened. Watch for changes in the environment, suspicious details, and things that may have been missed.

Talk with NPCs

Learn about relationships through conversation and observe how each person reacts. Hidden information can emerge from only a few words.

Highlight important dialogue

Pay attention to specially marked lines of dialogue. They may contain the key information needed to move your deduction forward.

Investigate objects in the scene

Examine objects in the environment, connect scattered clues with confirmed facts, and piece together a more complete story.

Organize clues and submit your theory

When you believe you are close to the truth, organize the clues and submit a complete theory. The system evaluates how closely your answer matches the real story; reach 80 points to pass the current story and reveal the true "soup bottom."

Choose your deduction method

The game supports cloud-based large language models. Enter your own API key to connect with one instantly. This option lets the game run smoothly even on low-spec computers and usually makes deduction faster. Cloud models may incur a small fee. If you prefer your own local large language model, open the game's ai_runtime/models folder and replace the .gguf file with your own .gguf model file.

廊下は浸水し、ドアは開けられない。頼れるのは卓上のチャット画面だけ——応答できる生存者は3人。ぶっきらぼうな設備管理、丁寧すぎる医務官、返信の短い観測技師。そして地上管制は、今日も「救助隊は編成中」と繰り返します。

4回線が同時に流れる

会話は1本ずつ読む紙芝居ではありません。機関・医務・観測・地上管制の4回線が作中時刻で同時に進み、読んでいない回線には未読が積もっていきます。誰の話をいつ聞くかも、あなたの采配です。

夜ごとの電力配分

主電源は失われ、予備電源は減り続けます。夜が来るたび、限られた電力をどの区画に厚く配るかを決めてください。医務を守れば機関が軋み、機関を労れば数字が安定し、観測に回せば——外の海の音が録れます。配った電気は、翌朝の会話と数字に返ってきます。

言葉ではなく、記録で

「変わりないです」と届いた朝も、消費電力の数字は増えている。証言を【観測ログ】【見取り図】【時刻】と突き合わせると、少しずつ食い違います。噛み合わない箇所は【矛盾】として確保され、証拠になります。イベントログ、アーカイブ、前任者の書き込みが残る見取り図、そして自分の私記——通信士の卓にある道具は、全部あなたのものです。

結末は6種類

集めた証拠の数と最後の選択で、物語は6つの結末に分かれます。1周は1〜2時間。周回するたび、初日から画面に出ていた数字の意味が、違って見えるはずです。

特徴

  • 4回線同時進行のチャットADV——返事を待たずに物語が進む
  • 夜ごとの電力配分が、会話・数字・ルートに反映される
  • 証言と記録の照合で「矛盾」を確保する証拠システム
  • 結末6種類＋実績10種
  • CRTモニタ風の画面表現とドット絵UI

store_data.about_the_game:
No Man's Idle is an idle/incremental game themed around space exploration. You start on an unfamiliar planet, begin by harvesting surface resources, then gradually unlock technology and upgrade your ship, warping across the universe until you finally reach the Galactic Center.

Core Gameplay:

  • Relaxed Idling: Manual click collection and auto-collection run side by side. Check in anytime to collect your rewards, and keep accumulating resources even while you're away.

  • Resource Prospecting: From Carbon and Oxygen to Ferrite, Sodium, and Cobalt... progressively discover and unlock new planetary resources and push past collection thresholds.

  • Three Tech Systems: Personal tech strengthens your clicks and efficiency; planet tech (Planet Development, Ancient Ruins) deepens your hold on the current world; ship tech (Hyperdrive, Warp Coil, Pulse Engine, and more) decides how far your journey goes.

  • Random Planet Exploration: Lush, Desert, Toxic, Frozen, Scorched, Radiation, Exotic, Dead, Ocean, and Swamp planets generate at random, complete with special traits like Resource-Rich zones, Ancient Ruins, and Extreme Climates.

  • Warp Mechanics: Spend warp fuel to jump between star systems. Success rates decay as distance grows — fuel management, efficiency trade-offs, and a little luck all come into play.

  • Ultimate Goal: Accumulate light-years traveled, edge ever closer to the Galactic Center, and complete this idle journey across the stars.

Features:

  • Supports five languages: Simplified Chinese, English, Español, 日本語, 한국어

  • Multiple save slots with auto-save and local backup/restore — your progress is always safe

  • Pure idle gameplay, friendly to short sessions, with no forced online requirement

store_data.about_the_game:
A small presence can change the feel of an ordinary day. Qingyan settles into a corner of your desktop with a book, a quiet breath, and a long road ahead. In My Desktop Cultivator, her journey toward immortality unfolds alongside the familiar rhythm of your own days.

A Companion at Your Desk


Find her a comfortable spot, and let the day unfold. Qingyan reads, stretches, and rests in her own time. When you have a moment, a gentle click is enough to say hello. You needn't watch over her every minute. However far her cultivation takes her, the companion at your desk is the one you first met.

Watch Her Cultivation Grow


With the game open and Qingyan in view, each stretch of reading or meditation adds a little to her cultivation. The overview lets you follow those small gains as they gather. When she tires, she rests; when the requirements are met, she breaks through into the next realm on her own. There is room for both effort and quiet in a life of cultivation.

60 Seconds of Enlightenment


Sometimes, an ordinary stretch of practice brings a moment of insight. Take 60 seconds to follow the drifting lights as white orbs reveal their colors. Left-click to absorb the green ones, right-click to clear the red. A few small choices fill this brief pause before you return to your day, with Qingyan beside you.

Spirit Roaming


Pick a place and a length of time, and let a wisp of Qingyan's spirit wander through distant mountains and rivers. In the roaming scene, a tiny figure steps in place; Qingyan herself stays at your desk. Once the journey is complete, look through the materials and discoveries it has brought home. Little by little, that faraway world becomes familiar.

Collected Memories


The manuals and artifacts in your collection have stories to tell. Turn to the album for glimpses of the days you have shared. A newly found book, an unexpected treasure, a familiar view: together, they become a history that belongs to you both. Some moments seem small until you find yourself glad to remember them.

Wandering Merchant


Now and then, a completed Spirit Roaming journey brings a visitor with treasures of their own. Browse the wandering merchant's exclusive manuals and artifacts, and trade spirit stones and the matching regional materials for something that catches your eye. The things you brought back from afar find a new purpose.



There is a long road ahead, and no need to hurry. Make a little room for Qingyan, and see what the days bring.

store_data.about_the_game:
War has raged across the galaxy for millennia. Play as space elves, dwarves, humans, or undead in a dark fantasy universe where war never ceases.

Core features:

  • An RTS where you can create thousands and tens of thousands of units without breaking your PC

  • 4 factions, each with a unique aesthetic and playstyle

  • Terrain matters. Hills give better vision and range, forests better defense, occupy buildings and ruins with your infantry to keep them alive or dig trenches to hold the line.=

  • Online PvP and PvE

  • Grand Campaign. Move your divisions on a strategic map and fight the most important battles and assign other commanders to fight the rest (or fight them all if you wish)

  • 2 Story Campaigns. Play as the URRS, a dystopian human civilization, battling for control of ancient tech or as the Starlit Stewards, elves who use dark magic to torture and twist beings into beasts of war, as they battle to take what they believe is theirs

  • Map Editor

  • Campaign Editor

  • Unique base building mechanics where you gain resources by building hubs across the map to control territory. Each hub has a limited amount of building space around it and eventually simulates cities across the map

The Factions

  • The United Revolutionary Republican Systems. An authoritarian regime that relies on huge masses of infantry followed by heavy tanks and vast amounts of artillery. They wield no magic trusting in the blind loyalty of their troops and the explosive power of their ordinance to win the battle.

  • The Starlit Stewards. An ancient elven race who believe they are meant to be the true rulers of the galaxy. Corrupted by jealousy they have turned to dark ways using magic to torture and mutilate theirs, and other races into slaves and horrifying beasts that they force into battle. 

  • The Stoneborne Strongholds. Dwarves. Enslaved by the Starlit Stewards long ago they freed themselves after they  discovered evil powersources that require the burning and torturing of souls to function. Now as pirates and dwarven kingdoms they use toxic gasses, soul-fire, and superheavy landships to choke and crush all before them.

  • The Grim Sovereign. It is not known who or what the Grim Sovereign is, only that it is a being even more ancient than the elves. Its priests raise up masses of bones to flood over enemy positions while grim stone-like statues and hovering altars stalk across the battlefield firing blue plasma over their enemies.

store_data.about_the_game:
THIS IS THE BATTLEFIELD

A 7x7 grid split into two areas.

The 5x5 main zone in the center is where games are won: only the cards there count toward your score.

The out zone is the ring surrounding the main zone, and it's where you make the strategic plays that can turn the game around.

FLIP TO WIN

Use your monsters' arrows to steal your opponent's cards.

Whoever controls the most monsters in the main zone at the end of the game wins.

FORGET WALLS OF TEXT

There are no written effects on the cards.

All you need to look at are the cost, attack/defense, arrow positions, and abilities.

No more memorizing cards or spending hours reading.

Learn the rules, then put them into play.

EVERY ELEMENT HAS ITS OWN ABILITY

There are 6 elements: Fire, Nature, Earth, Water, Electro, and Darkness, with more colors on the way.

Each element has a special ability you can use to pull off devastating combos.

Build multicolor decks to unleash their full potential.

BUILD YOUR DECK

Sixty cards, up to four copies of each monster, and 30 blocks.

Build with the cards you already own and mix colors however you like.

LEARNING CURVE

The game itself is simple: a couple of matches is all it takes to get the hang of the basics.

Learn to use each element on its own.

Then focus on building combos, mastering positioning, and deckbuilding, and finally start thinking 2–3 turns ahead.

HOW SETS AND MONETIZATION WORK

Buying the game instantly unlocks the entire first set: every card, every copy, with nothing to grind for and no restrictions. Future sets are sold separately and unlock the same way.

There are no random packs and no in-game currency. Nobody gets a better deck by spending more, because everyone who owns a given set has the exact same card pool. What you bring to the match is your strategy.

Cosmetics such as card backs, holographic effects, and much more will be available for purchase in the future.

You start with one coin and one plot of land. You plow, plant, water and harvest. You sell what you grow, expand the warehouse and buy pricier seeds: herbs, flowers, roots, vegetables and fruit orchards. You open your shop and serve customers one by one. You hire employees and automate the farm. Then you automate the shop too.

With the experience you earn along the way you buy permanent upgrades on the Legacy tree. And when you're ready, you sell your franchise: you start another one from scratch, with no land, no employees, no shop, no seeds and no coins. The only thing you carry over is your Legacy, and with it the next farm grows far faster than the last.

Your chat works your farm

Streaming? Turn on Twitch mode, type your channel name and that's it: everyone who talks in your chat shows up inside the game with their name over their head, as one of your farmhands or as a customer in your shop. No tokens, no login, nothing to install. Your community gets to watch themselves plow, harvest and shop on your farm... and sticks around to see how they're doing.

Plant and harvest

Unlock herbs, flowers, roots, vegetables and fruit orchards. Every seed has its own rhythm, its own price and its own secrets - and a golden crop is always one harvest away.

Every franchise you sell opens a new catalogue

You never start again with the same seeds. Each franchise sale unlocks a catalogue, and each catalogue changes how the farm plays.

  • Herbs: they sell themselves the moment you harvest them. No warehouse, no shop, no waiting for a customer. This is your engine: small returns, constant cash, and the rhythm you fall into while you plan everything else.

  • Flowers: these don't sell on their own. They go to the warehouse and cross the counter of your shop, and the ones you put on display pull in more customers - sunflowers most of all. You play them thinking about the shelf, not just the price.

  • Roots: one single harvest per planting, expensive and slower than herbs. This is the plant-it-and-go catalogue: fewer clicks, more value per tile, and a reason to walk away and come back.

  • Vegetables: they regrow. One planting gives you harvest after harvest, with one watering per regrowth, until the plant dries out and the tile needs plowing again. They pay off when you stay on top of the farm.

  • Fruit trees: permanent trees in the corners of the plot. No watering, no plowing, they never dry out: the fruit falls on its own and piles up until someone collects it. This is the automation catalogue - you pay a lot to stop touching the farm.

Hire your crew

Recruit employees who plow, water, harvest and run the register while you plan the next expansion. Dress them up in the wardrobe and build a farm that runs itself.

Run the shop

Keep the shelves full: customers walk in with their own tastes, their own moods and their own wallets. Price smart, restock fast and watch the coins roll in.

Brave the weather

Overcast skies, storms and lightning can wreck a harvest... or supercharge it. Magic butterflies and rainbows of fortune bring surprises of their own.

The Night Bazaar

When the sun goes down, spend your tickets at the mysterious roulette and collect amulets that bend the rules of the farm.

Leave a legacy

Complete missions, reach milestones and grow a Legacy tree that makes every new beginning stronger than the last.

Features

  • Twitch mode: your chat's names on your employees and customers, nothing to set up

  • 5 crop families with dozens of seeds, golden variants and secrets to discover

  • Employees with roles and outfits - the farm keeps working while you plan

  • Dynamic weather: overcast days, storms, lightning, butterflies and rainbows

  • The Night Bazaar: a roulette of prizes, tickets and rare amulets

  • A full prestige system: the Legacy tree makes every run stronger

  • Missions and milestones at every step of the journey

  • Interface in English, Spanish, French, Italian and Portuguese

  • Short sessions or long marathons: the farm keeps its own pace

store_data.about_the_game:
Crime Podcast is a series of psychological horror games based on real stories of people who committed evil, became victims of evil, or found themselves in difficult situations.

In Crime Podcast: 1976, you play as Thomas Hayes, a 63-year-old FBI Special Agent who returns home after his final day of service before retirement. He needs to prepare the documents stored at his home for transfer to the Bureau, but evidence he chose to hide away many years ago turns his evening into a real nightmare.

Gameplay

This game is primarily a first-person narrative walking simulator featuring exploration, work, and dialogue mechanics.

Key Features:

  • Based on a real story

  • Survival depends on the player’s actions

  • Atmospheric sound design

  • Immersion through details and environment

store_data.about_the_game:
Are you ready to test your friendships, take down rivals with a single wink, and betray everyone at the table to be the last one standing? Wink Mafia is a ruthless 3D multiplayer party game that blends the social deduction genre with classic board and card mechanics.

Put on your fedoras, light your cigars, and take your seat at the table. But stay sharp—even the most innocent-looking player might be about to hand you a live grenade!

🕵️‍♂️ Secret Roles, Lies, and Betrayal

WINK MAFIA In the core game mode, trust is a luxury you cannot afford. Everyone has a secret identity and their own hidden agenda. Choose your victim when darkness falls, lie through your teeth come morning, and vote out the innocents. If you want to rule the table like a true mob boss, all it takes is a well-timed wink!

🃏 Ruthless Card Battles

Think you are just playing a casual card game? Think again. Rules are made to be bent! Did someone hit you with a +4? Put on your best smirk, slam down your own +4, and pass an 8-card penalty right to the next victim.

🔫 Ever-Changing Deadly Mini-Games

The chaos never stops. Thanks to our dynamic rotation system, each round pulls you into a completely different challenge. One moment you are playing cards with a friend, and the next you are frantically defusing a ticking bomb or racing against the clock in an exploding maze with a bomb on your head.

🎩 Flaunt Your Mafia Style

Expand your wardrobe through unlocked achievements. Customize your shadowy figure with stylish fedoras and iconic sunglasses. Celebrate your victory in style—hold your cigar-chomping mafia cat and give your defeated rivals one last wink!

Key Features:

  • A tense, competitive, and laugh-out-loud multiplayer experience.

  • A diverse and ever-changing pool of mini-games.

  • Integrated Voice Chat support that elevates the table atmosphere.

  • Dozens of unique cosmetics and accessories unlocked via achievements.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your world. Everyone's world.

Brixonia is a persistent multiplayer sandbox where you build, farm, fish, and decorate alongside thousands of other players, all in shared, living worlds that never reset while you're away.

Build anything

Place and break blocks to shape your own world, tile by tile. Build a home, a farm, a shop, or an entire town. Your world stays exactly how you leave it.

Grow, fish, and gather

Plant seeds and harvest crops on your own schedule. Cast a line and reel in a catch. Break blocks and collect resources to fuel your next project.

Craft and customize

Splice and craft new items, discover rare recipes, and gear up with equipment that boosts how you play. No grinding for stats, just tools that make building and gathering smoother.

Decorate and show off

Fill your world with furniture and decorations. Every world is a canvas.

Play together

Join friends, form a guild, and build side by side. Lock your world to keep it private, or open it up to everyone. Chat and hang out. Brixonia is built for playing with people, not against them.

No combat. No pressure.

There's no PvP damage, no death penalty, no grind wall. Brixonia is a place to build and relax at your own pace.
