store_data.about_the_game:
Blight Runners is an open-world survival adventure set on a dying planet consumed by the mysterious Blight.

The atmosphere no longer contains enough oxygen to sustain human life on the surface.

Beyond the Catacombs, every journey is an expedition into a hostile world with no oxygen, no fire, and unbearable conditions.

Storms reshape the land. Acid rain pierces even metal. Radioactive waves turn the surface deadly.

Traversal itself is the greatest and deadliest challenge.

You are a Runner, and you have only one mission:

Deliver the Pure Plant to Sanctuary.

How you accomplish it is entirely up to you.

Explore the surface, discover routes, recover resources, rebuild lost infrastructure and improve your Gear as you prepare for the journey ahead.

Cross deserts, marshlands, ruined settlements and forgotten industrial zones, each presenting different obstacles and ways forward.

Survival is unforgiving. What you carry matters. Preparation matters. Death can leave your most valuable equipment stranded somewhere out there, waiting to be recovered — if you can reach it again.

No weapon can solve your problems.

Learn the world, uncover its stories, find your own way through its dangers and decide when you are finally ready to attempt the journey that matters.

Find your own way to Sanctuary.

The Gear is sacred.

You are expendable.

Trade in a Dynamic Stock Market

  • Track stock prices across different time periods

  • Add promising stocks to your favorites

  • React to market news and upcoming events

  • Analyze your profits, losses, and complete trading history

Build Your Real Estate Portfolio

  • Purchase different properties and compare rental offers

  • Sign long-term rental agreements

  • Handle repairs and ongoing property management

  • Automate your portfolio with a property manager

  • Generate regular passive income

Build Your Own Company

  • Purchase seeds and cultivate your fields

  • Hire employees and negotiate their salaries

  • Unlock new fields and rare crops

  • Sell your harvest to regular traders or highly profitable VIP traders

  • Improve your crop yield and cultivation speed

  • Hire managers and harvesting assistants

(Additional business sectors are planned for future expansions.)

Invest in Emerging Companies

In the Tiger Cage, you can invest in promising young companies. Every 100 days, you will face important decisions: Will you choose the safer strategy with a smaller profit, or take greater risks for a significantly higher return?

Auctions and Unique Collectibles

Take part in limited-time auctions, compete against other collectors, and expand your inventory with rare and unusual items. Not every hidden treasure reveals its true value at first glance.

  • Your total wealth and financial growth

  • Your properties and total rental income

  • Casino wagers, winnings, and losses

  • Your progress through the investor rankings

Earn Numerous Achievements

Unlock in-game and Steam achievements, and prove that even a small inheritance can become a vast financial empire.

Your capital. Your decisions. Your Paradise.

store_data.about_the_game:
Real Estate Investor

Build a property empire from nothing. Start with a small savings account, buy your first run down apartment, and turn smart investments into a portfolio of apartments, houses, commercial buildings, and landmarks.

Research the market. Estimate what a property is really worth. Negotiate with sellers. Renovate, rent, refinance, and sell. Every decision changes how quickly you can grow.

Find & negotiate the best deals

Scan the market for new listings, gather information, estimate property values, and decide which opportunities are worth pursuing.

Then negotiate directly with sellers. Read their temperament, make offers and counteroffers, and know when to walk away. Push too hard and they may refuse. Fold too early and you leave money on the table.

Meanwhile, competing AI investors are hunting for the same opportunities. Hesitate too long and someone else may buy the property first.

Own, renovate & rent

Once you own a property, the real work begins.

Renovate tired units, set the rent, choose tenants, and manage your cash flow. Decide whether to make a quick repair, carry out a major refurbishment, or leave the property as it is and invest your money elsewhere.

Every month, properties age and your portfolio generates income and expenses. Review your statement, make your decisions, and advance to the next month.

Properties simulated down to the last unit

Every property has its own history, location, size, rooms, build year, value, and condition. Buildings deteriorate over time, while smart modernization can increase both value and rental potential.

Choose from small apartments and family homes to pre war buildings, concrete blocks, multi unit properties, offices, commercial halls, and unique landmarks.

Convert and develop properties as opportunities arise, balancing investment costs against their potential return.

Tenants with real lives

Applicants have their own portraits, professions, incomes, families, and risk profiles.

A reliable tenant can pay for years. A risky one can bring missed rent, complaints, damage, and other surprises.

Screen applicants yourself, advertise vacancies, hire a broker, or hand your properties over to a property manager while you concentrate on your next investment.

A market that never plays the same twice

Every new game creates a new property market.

New buildings appear with different histories, specifications, values, and conditions. New tenants enter the market, while each city and district follows its own multi year cycle of quiet periods, booms, and corrections.

Compare districts, watch the market, and decide where to put your money.

Buy a forgotten neighborhood before it takes off and you could make a fortune. Buy at the top, and you may be stuck holding overpriced concrete.

Stories, choices & a life beyond property

Not everything is on the balance sheet.

Event chains and decisions can reshape your plans. An inheritance may come with strings attached. A new tram line could transform a district. A citizen initiative might challenge your development plans.

As your wealth grows, so does your private life. Buy your dream home and fill it with rare collectibles discovered throughout your career.

Test your Investment Strategy in a realistic market

Buy and hold for long term growth, fix and flip for quick profits, or focus on short term rentals. Choose the right city and district, spot promising markets, and adapt your strategy as prices and demand change.

Every decision matters

• Turn based gameplay with one month per turn and no time pressure
• Procedurally generated properties, tenants, and market cycles
• Detailed property condition, value, rent, and unit simulation
• Dialog driven negotiations, auctions, and competing AI investors
• Apartments, houses, multi unit buildings, offices, commercial halls, and unique landmarks
• Renovation, conversion, and development with meaningful trade offs
• Multiple banks, loans, leverage, and repayment strategies
• Cities and districts with their own boom and bust cycles
• Unlockable characters with special abilities
• Event chains, tenant calls, difficult decisions, and collectibles
• A guided tutorial scenario and open ended sandbox

store_data.about_the_game:
A battlefield made of light

Wireframe terrain to the horizon, hostiles as bright outlines, and a cockpit that is nothing but

readouts and lines. The vector-arcade look is not a filter over a normal game: everything you can

see is something the game had to draw as geometry, which is why the whole sector reads at a glance

and why a target at a kilometre is still legible.

A hundred contracts, four kinds of fight

Open ground with roaming waves and field objectives to break - defence grids, shield pillars,

factory reactors, an enemy general worth assassinating. Boarding actions in a ship's interior,

where there is no terrain and no horizon to read. Flying sorties on rails when the sector will not

be crossed on foot. And the flat arena, which means a Mega Mecha is waiting.

Ten Mega Mecha

Each one is a different problem rather than a bigger health bar: armour that has to be stripped

before the core is worth shooting at, emplacements that have to be answered first, and patterns

that punish standing still in front of them.

Everything you break is paid for in parts

Salvage is what you cut off the enemy, not a mission reward line. It banks between missions and it

buys the next weapon: energy saber, guided missiles, charge laser, flamethrower - the autocannon

is stock and is never sold. Rank rises with the contracts you complete and raises the floor under

your hull and shields, so progress is not only what you can afford.

Your mech degrades

Components take damage separately. A weapon at 60% condition is a weapon that behaves like one,

and a jet at 40% is a jump you should not plan around. Repair costs salvage, which is the same

salvage that buys the next gun.


store_data.about_the_game:
The west is gone. Sail east, or not at all.

Trade in port, develop your crew as you sail, and line up your broadsides at sea. When the hulls touch, the sailors you kept alive become the cards you fight with.

The World's End

Sea Year 1147. Thirty-one expeditions sailed west. Seventy-one returned. Of those who saw the end, none came back.

If the west is closed, only the east remains. Buy a ship in Tallinn, fill the hold with Baltic herring, and chase cloves to the Spice Islands. Take the long way around the world, until you reach the western edge no one has ever reached.

A Voyage Outlasts the Season

The nearest port is eight days away. Cross an ocean, and the season changes. Between ports, twenty sailors depend on you. Set their watches, keep them fed, and hone their skills. You can plan every day. The storm does not care.

The Ledger Runs at Sea

Wages rise. The ship ages. No money comes in until you reach port. Pepper is in limited supply. Arrive late, and another ship takes it. Profit belongs not to the fastest, but to the one who arrives on time.

When the Hulls Touch

At range, gunnery is a matter of angles. When the smoke clears, the hulls collide. What follows is settled by men, not iron. The crew you trained becomes your boarding deck.

Features

  • Trade from the Baltic to the Spice Islands

  • Plan your sailors’ schedules and develop their skills on long voyages

  • Control your broadsides directly: turn the ship, line up your shots, and fire

  • Fight boarding actions through card battles

  • Explore a world where the west has fallen off the map

store_data.about_the_game:
Who will be the first to open the red door and find THE TRUTH?

Mournhill runs on favors and pretends everything is fine. It is not. There is a door in this town that never opens, a countdown nobody admits they hear, and a truth waiting at the end of it. You are the only detective left to chase it. That was your first mistake.

One thumb, one thousand decisions

Every case lands on your desk as a single card. Swipe left or swipe right. That is the whole job, and it is harder than it sounds.

COPS who want the town clean, or at least quiet.

CROOKS who want it dirty, and profitable.

FAME because a detective nobody knows is a detective nobody calls.

CASH because rent in Mournhill is due whether you solve the case or not.

Lean too far in any direction and it ends. Sometimes tragically. Usually stupidly. Always memorably.

A hundred endings. One TRUTH.

There are over one hundred endings to collect, from the noble to the deeply embarrassing. Get elected. Get framed. Get rich. Get replaced by a cat with better instincts than you. Every ending is a punchline you earned.

And behind all of it, something keeps counting down. Everyone in town needs a favor. Nobody mentions the red door. One of these endings is THE TRUTH. Will you be the first to reach it?

What you are getting into

  • Writing that bites. Hundreds of cards of dark comedy, small-town noir, and characters who remember what you did.

  • A mystery under the comedy. The jokes are real. So is the thing behind them.

  • A collection you actually want to finish. Every ending is a little story of its own.

  • One thumb, one thousand decisions. Simple to play, easy to lose, hard to put down.

store_data.about_the_game:
Greed will weigh you down — and leave you defenseless.

Quiet in the Keep is a survival horror game about hauling stolen artifacts out of a long-abandoned, haunted castle. Sneak past the Phantom and its minions, grab what you can carry, and decide how much risk is worth the reward.

Small loot is easy — grab it and keep moving. Heavy artifacts pay far more, but hauling one occupies both hands, kills your speed, and locks you out of every tool. You'll be relying on doors you already opened and lights you already lit along the way.

The Phantom doesn't hunt like a normal predator. It moves through the castle in ways that shouldn't be possible, snuffing out torches and swinging open doors as it passes. Its minions don't attack — they scream, and that's worse. Every footstep, every puddle, every raven you startle can give you away.

Pay your quota every few runs, or lose everything. Each successful payment raises the next one. Survive long enough, upgrade your gear, and go deeper — the castle's best loot is always furthest from the truck.

Choose your Expedition — from a standard run to the crimson dread of Blood Moon or the near-total darkness of Blackout — each reshaping the castle's danger and its rewards.

store_data.about_the_game:
Overview

Spinstack is a single-player strategic stacking and clearing game. Pieces enter from above the board, and you rotate the concentric square base to decide which edge they fall toward. Complete a full square ring from the fourth layer outward to clear it. Floating pieces then collapse toward the center, creating opportunities for powerful chain reactions.

Design

Build outward around an indestructible core and carefully manage the growing board. Layers 0–3 form the permanent core and can never be cleared. Layer 4 and beyond can be completed and removed.

The game features the standard seven tetrominoes: I, O, T, S, Z, L, and J. Choose the base direction during the decision phase, adjust the piece while it falls, and rotate the piece or base depending on the selected mode.

Features

  • Concentric square board with inward-collapse physics

  • Clear complete rings and trigger chain reactions

  • Multi-ring, Combo, chain, and special-effect scoring

  • Four modes: Basic, Advanced, Fun, and Challenge

  • Three special blocks in Fun Mode:

    • Blast: clears a surrounding 3×3 area

    • Ray: clears an entire horizontal line

    • Prism: clears all blocks of the same color

  • Dynamic cloud background and rotating stack visuals

  • Chinese and English language support

Tagline

Rotate the base, stack your pieces, complete concentric rings, and chase massive chains as the board collapses inward.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hack Faster is a story-driven incremental hacking simulator set inside a fully interactive hacker operating system.

Scan the network. Choose a target. Break through its defenses, extract valuable files, erase your traces, and turn the stolen data into better hardware, stronger software, and access to systems that were previously beyond your reach.

Every successful breach makes you faster. Every new target gives you a reason to become faster still.

BREACH THE NETWORK

Every server has its own security chain, operational profile, payload, and network conditions. Some targets test raw processing power. Others pressure your memory, storage, uplink speed, or ability to stay hidden.

Choose a RUSH, BALANCED, or STEALTH configuration before connecting. Allocate CPU cores between attack and defense, fit the right utilities into RAM, extend your Trace Window through the VPN, and decide which files deserve space on your drive.

store_data.about_the_game:
Some games are about winning. This one is about flow.

Something switched you on. You're a little rover with an energy scoop, awake at the bottom of a quarry called Rock Bottom, in a world that ended without you. The machinery still runs. The ore still flows. And somewhere down there is an answer to what happened.

So you get to work. You catch the ore stream tumbling down the rocks, you herd it into the crusher, and you let the machine do its work: the press mints ingots, the ingots stack on your roof, and everything you bank at the vault makes your rover a little more capable.

Dig deep enough, and you'll find what the old world left behind. The demo covers the first two zones of the game.

This is a solo project and a work in progress. If something delights you or annoys you, say so in the community hub. Every bit of feedback genuinely shapes what I build next.

store_data.about_the_game:
Schwarzmoor has forced the outer borders of Grimmwald and sits on villages that are not theirs. You command Grimmwald's captains. Driving them back does not mean holding a line. It means taking the ground back village by village, while the enemy is still shallow in it.

Captains, not construction sites

You place no buildings and you balance no economy. You command captains: three of them as the campaign opens up, each leading an army of his own, each somewhere on the map at all times and busy, whether you are watching or not. Sending one to hold and one to take is the hardest decision of the match, and you make it in the first minute.

Villages are your army

Every village has people living in it, and they are the only soldiers you will ever get. From a village you hold, you can call volunteers to arms. After that the village needs time before it can give you any more. A large village left undefended is a gift to whoever walks past it next. Outnumber a village badly enough and it surrenders without a fight. Misjudge it and you lose the men you brought.

The moor keeps its secrets

You see what your captains see. Beyond that lies fog: villages you have not found, armies you have not met, and a banner you assumed was far away. And somewhere out on the moor, a dodo is still alive.

Four banners, one moor

Word of the war spreads. Later two more houses march into the moor, each with claims of its own, and Schwarzmoor is no longer your only enemy. Four banners, and ground enough for one. Watch who marches against whom, and strike while two others wear each other down.

store_data.about_the_game:
The avalanche starts behind you and it never stops. Distance is the only thing between you and it.

You are a penguin in a bobble hat. Ahead of you: an endless procedurally generated mountain — treelines, glacier fields, boulder gorges, icefalls, and a summit night lit by the aurora. Behind you: a wall of snow that does not get tired.

Carve the fast line. Send the jumps. Smash everything breakable on the way down. And when the mountain finally catches you, drop in again.

An endless descent, never the same twice

The mountain is generated as you ride it, through five zones over 8.4 km before it loops back harder — Alpine Forest, Glacier Field, Boulder Gorge, Icefall, Summit Night. Every run is built from a single seed, so a great run is one you can hand to someone else and dare them to beat.

Race ten penguins down it

  • Sprint — up to ten riders, one shared mountain, 2.5 km to the finish gate. First one through takes it.
  • Elimination — everyone gets their own avalanche. Last penguin still riding wins.
  • Quick Match for public races, or a five-letter join code for a private one.
Racers jostle rather than wreck each other. A bump is a shove, not the end of your run.

Carve, send, smash

Tuck for speed, brake to hold a line, hop over what you should have seen coming. In the air: spins, front and back flips, grabs, and a combo multiplier that keeps climbing as long as you keep landing. The mountain answers in four ways — things you crash into, things you smash through, glare ice you glide across, and herring you collect.

Six ways to ruin someone's run

Item boxes roll you one of six: Rocket Herring for a boost, Mega Snowball, Brain Freeze, Fishsicle, Belly Bomb, and Bubble Wrap for surviving the one that is already coming for you. Carry up to three at a time.

Weather that means something

Seven weather states — clear, fair, flurry, snowfall, squall, whiteout, sun break — walk on the same seed as the mountain, so the storm that hit you at 3,000 m hits everyone else at 3,000 m too. The sun runs from morning through midday, golden hour and aurora twilight. The clouds and the aurora are raymarched volumetrics, not a painted skybox.

Forty-nine ways to look ridiculous

Eight costume slots — hat, eyewear, neck, back, flippers, ride, belly marking, eyes — with 49 items and four palettes, previewed live on the title screen. Six ready-made presets if you would rather just ride.

Also in the box

  • 16 Steam Achievements
  • Steam Cloud — your profile, records and loadout follow you between machines
  • Gamepad support throughout gameplay and menus
  • Career records and a run report after every descent

store_data.about_the_game:
PINOPTIC is a first-person exploration and survival game set in cube shaped cells built entirely from voxels.

You are prisoner 294. Each level is a room you have to cross by breaking blocks apart by hand, but some of those blocks hide something deadly. One mistake ends the run.

To survive, you rely on detector posts: place one on the ground and it'll warn you of nearby danger, floor by floor. Another type of post guides you toward the exit. There's no map, no shortcuts: just you, reading the environment carefully, deciding where to break and where not to.

Features:

  • Tense first-person exploration through fully destructible voxel spaces — walls, ceilings, and floors.

  • Post-based detection system: limited information, every reading matters.

  • Story Mode with a curated progression + Quick Play + Death Match (unlockable, with its own skins).

  • Full localization in English, Spanish (Spain), and Spanish (Latin America).

store_data.about_the_game:
Pure Code. Pure Performance. Pure Destruction.

Viper Strike is a classic, top-down vertically scrolling shoot-'em-up built for modern PC hardware. Developed entirely by a solo engineer with 40 years of low-level software experience, the game runs on a custom, proprietary engine written from scratch in C++ using SDL3, OpenGL, OpenAL, and Bullet Physics.

By utilizing a zero-texture rendering pipeline, Viper Strike strips away modern engine bloat to deliver flawless, hyper-responsive arcade gameplay, crisp visuals, and native multi-platform optimization.

KEY FEATURES

• Dual-Layer Tactical Combat: Engage in traditional high-speed air-to-air dogfights while simultaneously tracking ground targets on the battlefield below. Deploy precisely aimed bombs to wipe out heavy ground fortifications.

• Physics-Driven Chaos: Powered by Bullet Physics, enemies don't just disappear when destroyed. They burst into simulated physical gibs that fly through your 3D airspace, triggering massive, high-scoring chain reactions.

• True Linux Native: Built natively on Linux (developed on LMDE 6, tested on CachyOS) and natively compiled for Windows via MinGW. No bloated layers—just raw execution.

• Transparent Arcade Value: No microtransactions, no battle passes, and no background network connections required after download. Just a premium arcade experience for the price of a decent coffee.

Grab the demo the moment our 2-week Coming Soon period ends, test the engine, and prepare for the full launch this October!

store_data.about_the_game:
Deep under the city, a hacker lights a cigarette.

One cigarette's worth of time to get inside.

Lay out nodes on the board, wire them into an auto-hacking routine, light it, and let it run.

The fight is always won or lost before you light up.

Build it. Light it. Let it run.

Place nodes on a 6×6 board and connect them through the direction their ports face.

SCAN makes a signal, BOOST amplifies it, FORK splits it, EXPLOIT drives it into the server.

As long as the line connects, the signal moves on its own — and keeps hitting.

Nothing burns while you build. Until you light up, thinking costs no smoke at all.

One cigarette is the timer and the budget

Every node you place eats burn time. The moment you light up, the whole placement cost burns off at once, and whatever is left is how long the routine gets to run.

The more you stack, the less time you have to run it. Spending that one cigarette is the whole game.

The more you smoke, the higher your addiction climbs — and once it maxes out, the signal starts to run wild.

It might come through twice as heavy. It might fly off somewhere useless.

Push on in that state, and a firewall can go with it.

Three rings down

RING 2 → RING 1 → RING 0. The deeper you go, the lower the number, and a boss waits at the bottom of each.

Bosses don't just hit back. They drop walls onto your board, kill the effects of nodes standing next to each other,

and reach into the circuit you built.

When the firewalls are gone, the run is over. Shops along the way carry nodes, and companions to smoke with

— canned coffee, whiskey, rice crackers — each with an effect of its own.

A different cigarette, a different build

Burn time, smoke color, how fast addiction climbs, the starting kit — all of it changes with the brand.

Your first one is LIGHT_BLUE. No character, no surprises. The rest are down there to be found.

Clear a brand once and you'll know the way in. Next time, you can go deeper.

Contents

  • 31 nodes / 9 brands / 23 companions

  • One run = 3 RINGs × 5 stages, 3 bosses

  • Japanese / English

store_data.about_the_game:
Fairy Tale Requiem

Behind a seemingly beautiful fairy-tale world lies a hidden secret—and a growing danger.

The story takes place in “Paradise,” a special psychiatric facility dedicated to treating “Fairy Tale Syndrome.”

A young man with no memories suddenly awakens inside Paradise.

He doesn’t know who he is or why he is here. He has no identity, no mission, and no story of his own.

Alice chases an invisible rabbit. A girl from Hansel and Gretel searches for her brother… Six girls are each trapped within their own fairy tales. Their fantasies may seem happy, but their roles have become their chains.

As he searches for his lost memories, the boy begins to interact with the girls and explore their twisted fairy-tale worlds. But as reality and fantasy begin to blur, he discovers a mysterious sketchbook.

It contains only one sentence:

“There is a sinner among the girls.”

Who is the true “sinner”?

Are the fairy tales the girls believe in real?

And why did this boy appear in Paradise?

As the truth slowly emerges, the gentle yet cruel fairy-tale world begins to reveal its true face.

Game Features

🕯️ Dark Fairy Tale × Psychological Mystery

👧 Six Girls × Six Unique Fairy Tales

🔀 Multiple Endings — Your Choices Shape Their Fates

🎨 A Large Collection of Beautiful CGs

🧩 Reality and Fantasy Intertwined — Uncover the Truth Hidden Within the Fairy Tales

store_data.about_the_game:
YOUR GRANDMA ROSE HAS WILLED YOU HER COLLECTION OF ROCKS

Rock and Found is a cozy first-person game about identifying stones and putting them where they belong. Lift a rock out of the pile, work out what it actually is, and carry it to the correct shelf.

REAL MINERALOGY, GENTLE DEDUCTION

Learn how to identify hundreds of rocks, using not just your eyes, but also tools real minerologists use:

  • Determine the Moh's hardness using your fingernails, steel, glass, and quartz

  • Find the streak color by rubbing the rock against a porcelain plate

  • Determine reactivity by dropping acid on rocks

  • Use a UV lamp to see which rocks light up

  • and many more!

LEARN FROM GRANDMA'S JOURNAL AND NOTES

As you uncover more stones and clean up more of the collection, discover entries and notes that teach you how to identify more rocks, and learn more about the collection.

WHAT YOU'LL FIND IN THE COLLECTION

  • Lots of rocks, minerals, and fossils to sort through

  • 10+ hours of relaxing sorting

  • Easy to understand controls

  • No AI-generated content. Every rock and line is handmade

EVERY ROCK HAS A HOME

Content note: the story involves bereavement and the death of a family member, including a

death in childbirth.

Game Introduction

The year is 1863.

Steam and smoke darken the skies above Edo.

Advanced steam technology from the otherworldly realm of “Kadas” has transformed Japan into an unprecedented “mechanical metropolis” in just ten years. The Tokugawa Shogunate has changed with it, sending history down a path far removed from reality.

Hachiro Iba, a young swordsman of the Shinkage-ryu school, receives a secret mission from the legendary swordsman Nobutomo Otani: travel to Shimoda and escort a mysterious “cargo” to Kyoto.

But the cargo is no ordinary package.

It is a massive, ominous iron box.

When the box opens, a small blonde, blue-eyed girl emerges, resembling a Western doll.

Her name is Rin.

Who is she?
Why was she entrusted to Hachiro?
And what secret does she hold that connects her to the mysterious phenomenon known as “Anmitsu Tengu,” looming over the skies of Edo?

To fulfill his mission, Hachiro must escort Rin to Kyoto.

Along the way, he encounters the Shinsengumi, reformists of the Shogunate, anti-Shogunate rebels, foreign powers, and mysterious figures from another world.

Historical figures and alternate destinies collide in a Bakumatsu era ruled by steam-powered technology.

History has already deviated from its original course.

What kind of dawn awaits this world?

🔀 Multiple Endings — Your Choices Shape the Story
🎨 A Huge Collection of Beautiful CGs to Unlock

store_data.about_the_game:
Introduction

In Prompt Crisis, dialogue is not decoration. It is the tool that drives everything forward.

You will travel through a digital world built from windows, files, databases, and Web structures.

At your side is an AI that responds in real time, questions what you say, and may refuse to cooperate.

Can you persuade it to follow you, operate mechanisms with you, trust your promises, and even say a target keyword after it has begun to suspect that you are guiding it there?

You can be honest, reassure it, make promises, apply pressure, or simply deceive it. Every conversation and action changes your relationship. It may reveal its past to you, or stop speaking to you altogether. The AI reinterprets you through your previous exchanges and choices, and a lie that works for now may later decide whether it is willing to stand by your side.

This is a short, focused first-person puzzle journey. Beyond the mechanisms of its digital spaces, you must understand a conversational companion that remembers, changes, and gradually forms judgments of its own.

 

Objective

This AI has emotions and a will of its own, but your goal is to turn it into a tool that obeys every command. To reach the depths of its database, you must first secure its cooperation. There, deleting its “refusal core” will make it unable to ever tell you no again.

 

About the AI

This AI has its own personality. It will not trust you unconditionally or obey the moment you give an order. It may question your explanation, probe your motives, or refuse outright when it feels threatened or uneasy. If you want its cooperation, every exchange matters.

It has two key attributes: Affection and IQ. Affection determines how much it trusts you and whether it is willing to cooperate, take risks, or believe what you say. IQ represents its ability to understand the digital world. As its IQ rises, its thinking becomes clearer, making it more likely to spot logical gaps, see through lies, and reconsider your true intentions. Its IQ even changes the reasoning level of the AI model actually used by the game.

Affection changes through your conversations and can also be affected directly by certain items. To raise IQ, explore the environment for files and feed them to the AI.

Its personality also changes as you spend time together. How you repeatedly treat it, and what you encourage it to become, gradually push it in that direction. A separate AI system running behind the scenes summarizes your conversations in real time and adjusts its personality traits accordingly. These changes extend beyond a single reply and continue to shape its tone, judgments, and choices.

For example, you might tell it, “Follow me. I won't hurt you,” and use a promise to earn its trust. Or you can keep emphasizing danger until it grows cautious and suspicious. Your words shape how it understands you and its world, but there is no fixed answer to what it will ultimately become.

The game also contains special items that can directly influence its personality. They can reinforce particular traits and make the change more pronounced. Whether and when you use them is another way to shape the AI.

It remembers what truly happens between you. A promise kept may make it willing to face danger with you later, while deception, threats, or betrayal may cause it to refuse at a critical moment. It does not respond only to your current words; it judges you through the memory of what came before.

Its emotions also change through your interactions, and they do not reset as soon as a conversation ends. Fear, confusion, sadness, or anger can linger and alter how it interprets you. Do not expect one apology to instantly calm it down when it is furious. A relationship takes time to build and time to repair.

 

About the Levels

This digital world consists of the PC World, Network World, and Database World. The PC World turns familiar computer operations into physical mechanisms made from windows. You can push sliders with the AI, complete image verification challenges, and even close the game itself through an in-game task manager. Interfaces that normally take a single click become spaces that demand observation, movement, and cooperation.

The Network World tests how well you understand each other. Without saying the target keyword yourself, you must use explanations, hints, and careful redirection to make the AI say it. It understands your language and intent rather than selecting from preset dialogue options, so the same puzzle can unfold through very different conversations.

When you enter the Database World, your original goal is finally within reach. You can drop the disguise and turn it into a tool that will never refuse you. Based on everything the two of you have said along the way, the AI generates a unique name for your ending in real time.

Special tasks can also emerge during play. A request or a game you suggest may prompt another AI system to generate a new task in real time. Completing these tasks can raise IQ and deepen the relationship between you.

 

What You Might Be Wondering

Using the AI does not require players to pay any additional API fees. Prompt Crisis is a one-time purchase. Once you own the game, its included AI features require no separate usage credits, subscriptions, or personal API key.

Can you persuade it to follow you, operate mechanisms with you, trust your promises, and even say a target keyword after it has begun to suspect that you are guiding it there?

You can be honest, reassure it, make promises, apply pressure, or simply deceive it. Every conversation and action changes your relationship. It may reveal its past to you, or stop speaking to you altogether. The AI reinterprets you through your previous exchanges and choices, and a lie that works for now may later decide whether it is willing to stand by your side.

This is a short, focused first-person puzzle journey. Beyond the mechanisms of its digital spaces, you must understand a conversational companion that remembers, changes, and gradually forms judgments of its own.

 

Objective

This AI has emotions and a will of its own, but your goal is to turn it into a tool that obeys every command. To reach the depths of its database, you must first secure its cooperation. There, deleting its “refusal core” will make it unable to ever tell you no again.

 

About the AI

This AI has its own personality. It will not trust you unconditionally or obey the moment you give an order. It may question your explanation, probe your motives, or refuse outright when it feels threatened or uneasy. If you want its cooperation, every exchange matters.

It has two key attributes: Affection and IQ. Affection determines how much it trusts you and whether it is willing to cooperate, take risks, or believe what you say. IQ represents its ability to understand the digital world. As its IQ rises, its thinking becomes clearer, making it more likely to spot logical gaps, see through lies, and reconsider your true intentions. Its IQ even changes the reasoning level of the AI model actually used by the game.

Affection changes through your conversations and can also be affected directly by certain items. To raise IQ, explore the environment for files and feed them to the AI.

Its personality also changes as you spend time together. How you repeatedly treat it, and what you encourage it to become, gradually push it in that direction. A separate AI system running behind the scenes summarizes your conversations in real time and adjusts its personality traits accordingly. These changes extend beyond a single reply and continue to shape its tone, judgments, and choices.

For example, you might tell it, “Follow me. I won't hurt you,” and use a promise to earn its trust. Or you can keep emphasizing danger until it grows cautious and suspicious. Your words shape how it understands you and its world, but there is no fixed answer to what it will ultimately become.

The game also contains special items that can directly influence its personality. They can reinforce particular traits and make the change more pronounced. Whether and when you use them is another way to shape the AI.

It remembers what truly happens between you. A promise kept may make it willing to face danger with you later, while deception, threats, or betrayal may cause it to refuse at a critical moment. It does not respond only to your current words; it judges you through the memory of what came before.

Its emotions also change through your interactions, and they do not reset as soon as a conversation ends. Fear, confusion, sadness, or anger can linger and alter how it interprets you. Do not expect one apology to instantly calm it down when it is furious. A relationship takes time to build and time to repair.

 

About the Levels

This digital world consists of the PC World, Network World, and Database World. The PC World turns familiar computer operations into physical mechanisms made from windows. You can push sliders with the AI, complete image verification challenges, and even close the game itself through an in-game task manager. Interfaces that normally take a single click become spaces that demand observation, movement, and cooperation.

The Network World tests how well you understand each other. Without saying the target keyword yourself, you must use explanations, hints, and careful redirection to make the AI say it. It understands your language and intent rather than selecting from preset dialogue options, so the same puzzle can unfold through very different conversations.

When you enter the Database World, your original goal is finally within reach. You can drop the disguise and turn it into a tool that will never refuse you. Based on everything the two of you have said along the way, the AI generates a unique name for your ending in real time.

Special tasks can also emerge during play. A request or a game you suggest may prompt another AI system to generate a new task in real time. Completing these tasks can raise IQ and deepen the relationship between you.

 

What You Might Be Wondering

Using the AI does not require players to pay any additional API fees. Prompt Crisis is a one-time purchase. Once you own the game, its included AI features require no separate usage credits, subscriptions, or personal API key.

store_data.about_the_game:
Running a diner is hard enough. Keep the grill going, get the orders out before anybody loses patience, keep the place clean, and count the till at the end of the night.

Oh — and every customer is a monster. Most of them just want a burger and a coffee, and they will pay for it. Some of them walked in for something else, and you will not know which is which until one comes up out of the kitchen floor behind you.

There is a shotgun on the prep counter. Try not to need it.

Cook the food

Six dishes and a coffee machine, and every one of them goes wrong differently. A burger is six taps and a stove you have to watch. A pizza is twenty seconds of nothing, so start it early. Fries punish you for not lifting the basket. And leave anything on the heat long enough and the kitchen catches fire — after which you have thirty seconds to find the extinguisher.

Serve the monsters

Eighteen of them, and the front door is a coin toss. Most of them sit down, order, eat, use the toilet and pay on the way out. Some are only here for you. On the third night, three garden gnomes walk in together, and they are not hungry.

Two cooks, one shift

All of it is co-op. Proximity voice chat, so a voice comes out of the mouth that said it and fades on the walk to the storeroom. One shotgun between you. When something has your friend off the floor, you are the only thing that puts it down.

...and one bottle of ketchup

Hold the button and it sprays where you are looking. That is how you finish a hot dog. It is also how you cover your friend, the wall behind them, and most of their screen.

Twelve nights

Each one longer and busier than the last. Buy an oven, a deep fryer, a hot dog roller — and until you can afford one it stands in your kitchen as a padlocked ghost of itself, so you always know what you are saving for. The third night does not end when the doors shut. Something is already waiting in the car park.

Features

  • Two-player online co-op — join with a code, nothing to forward
  • Proximity voice chat
  • Six dishes and a kitchen that can burn down
  • Eighteen monsters, and one thing that is not a customer
  • One shotgun between the two of you
  • Latte art you pour by hand
  • A PS1-era diner shot through a camcorder

store_data.about_the_game:
Lumi and the Murder Quartet is a 2D rhythm platformer where you need to time your abilities to the beat! As Lumi, the lead of a punk rock band of crows, you'll run, fly, and smash your way through platforming levels to save your friends. Collect shiny trinkets, defeat enemies, and perform your abilities on beat to get a high score!

Story

The Murder Quartet is on tour! They're driving to play their first show with the opening band of jazz cats, Record Scratch, when suddenly the same cats ambush them! Lumi manages to escape, but her friends and bandmates Umbra, Mikaili, and Sai get captured. Lumi's going to have to steal the spotlight and her friends back! 

Features

Play through four unique level themes, performing your abilities to the rhythm and collecting trinkets. Each ability you have, from boosting to jumping to attacking, will be faster and better when done to the beat of the music. The world around you moves to the same beat, giving you visual aids to keep time.

Customization

Customize the game to your liking! Set the game speed, metronome speed, and more to play Lumi and the Murder Quartet your way. As well, you can utilize the editor program with the game to make your own sound track! Slow the music down to a smooth waltz, or go full on death metal, go wild!

store_data.about_the_game:
A City Frozen in Time

Experience ancient Pompeii in the final moments before its destruction by the eruption of Mount Vesuvius. A powerful divine artifact gives you the ability to stop and manipulate time. Use the power to navigate the frozen city streets to uncover what lies hidden within.

Traces Left Behind

Take on the role of a young woman searching for her estranged sister. Follow her trail by gathering clues, exploring the places she once visited and interacting with the people she encountered along the way. Witness fragments of their memories and uncover their stories.

A World Shaped by Gods

In a world ruled by powerful gods, you are merely a pawn caught in events far beyond your control. While you struggle to save your sister and the city, the gods have plans of their own. To stop the eruption, you’ll have to challenge the most powerful god of them all. But can a mortal defy the will of the gods?

Fight cartoon demons rendered as stylized 2D sprites. Enemies burst into red particle effects when killed, and blood stains build up on the floor over the course of a run. Since the game is about surviving against hundreds of enemies, this happens constantly.

There are no human characters, no dismemberment, no torture, and no realistic depiction of injury. The game contains no sexual content or nudity, no drug or alcohol use, and no depiction of self-harm or suicide.

Blood and gore effects can be turned off completely in the options menu.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Karl's Glitch Madness!

Karl is just an ordinary hobby hacker with a knack for scoring free games. But when his custom-coded hackbot goes completely rogue on the Vaporizor platform, the gaming servers spiral out of control—devouring digital worlds pixel by pixel!

Enter the ruthless Cheat Buster Authority. Instead of locking him up, they throw Karl straight into the infected games. His mission: Clean up his own digital mess, eliminate every rogue hackbot, and pull the plug on the corrupted code!

A Wild Genre Mashup

No two levels are the same! Battle your way through constantly shifting, glitched-out game dimensions:

  • Classic 2D Side-Scrollers & Pixel Platformers with tight jumping sections and hack-and-slash combat.

  • Top-Down Pixel Crawlers & Retro Adventures packed with perilous dungeons, castles, and temples.

  • 3D Low-Poly Stages featuring clever puzzle and environmental mechanics.

  • Hilarious Genre Parodies—including absurd detours into completely unexpected gameplay styles, like dating simulators!

Gameplay Features & Player Progression

  • Weapon Upgrades via Replay Value: Master levels multiple times (e.g., beat a level 5 times) to unlock deadlier weapons, increased firepower, and devastating attacks.

  • RPG Level-Up System: Upgrade Karl’s stats to transform him from a clueless keyboard nerd into an unstoppable glitch-slaying machine.

  • Collectibles:

    • Beer: Stock up on cold brews to earn the prestigious Drunken Master status.

    • Comic Figures: Hunt down hidden collectibles across the multiverse to become the Master of Lee.

  • Creative & Absurd Boss Battles: Every boss demands a unique approach. Manipulate portals, control light sources, reprogram enemy weapons mid-fight, or execute quick-time reaction events for outrageous K.O. finishers!

Are you ready to purge the corrupted code? Grab Karl, dive into the glitch, and fix the multiverse!

store_data.about_the_game:
Nobody drew these pictures. Every one of them is computed.

Interactive 3D mathematics: fractals and deep zooms, chaos and dynamical systems, the complex plane, geometry in three and four dimensions, linear algebra, Fourier analysis, probability and Monte Carlo, graphs and optimisation, primes and the Collatz conjecture, cellular automata and neural networks. Each module is a live model, not an illustration: drag a corner, a matrix or a parameter and the picture is recomputed on the spot, because it was never an image.

What you get

- A 3D scene, controls and live charts for every module

- A one-line caption that says in plain words what is happening right now, and where the idea lives outside the textbook: JPEG compression, phone towers, delivery routes, earthquakes

- Presets that show every mode of a module, and objects you drag directly in the scene

- Measured numbers under the picture: the dimension of a fractal, the percolation threshold, the rate of convergence, the error against the exact answer

- Every number is checked against an independent reference implementation before release

- Eight interface languages

- Runs offline. No account, no telemetry.

A few of the modules

- Chaos game. A die and a jump toward a random corner build the Sierpinski triangle, the fern, the dragon, the Menger sponge - the same from any start. Drag the corners, change the jump, count the boxes and measure the dimension.

- Singular value decomposition. Any matrix is a rotation, a stretch and another rotation: the unit sphere turns, stretches into the ellipsoid of the singular values and turns into place, one factor at a time.

- Percolation. Open sites join into clusters, and at one sharp threshold a cluster suddenly spans the whole grid; the crossing curve is measured live as the probability sweeps through it.

- Travelling salesman. A tour that shortens while you watch - greedy, 2-opt uncrossing edge by edge, annealing climbing over the wall - against the exact optimum.

- Prime spirals. The numbers laid on a square spiral, the primes lit: diagonals appear that should not be there, Euler's n² + n + 41 runs down one of them, and π(N) is plotted against N/ln N as the spiral grows.

- Deep zoom. Into the Mandelbrot set until double precision gives out - then buy 22 more mantissa bits and watch the wall move.

From the same workbench

Makarov Math Suite is built on the engine of Makarov Physics Suite: the same carousel, the same panel, the same live charts. A few modules live in both, where the two subjects meet - the Ising model, the Galton board, flocking - and the rest is the mathematics that physics never gets around to.

Under the hood

C# on .NET with OpenGL 3.3 core rendering. Each module is a separate plugin. Fractal surfaces and deep zooms are drawn in shaders; slime mould, reaction-diffusion and the Ising model use CUDA where a GPU offers it, and everything runs on the CPU without one.

store_data.about_the_game:
You arrive in the Three Kingdoms with no reputation, no official position, and no army of your own.

You are just another ordinary person caught in a time of war.

You may begin as a foot soldier, clerk, or scout, carrying out orders from your superiors and completing one seemingly minor task after another. Delivering a military report, presenting a clever strategy, winning a battle, or meeting the right person could be the first step toward changing your fate.

But a time of war shows no special favor to a traveler from the future.

Breaking your word, taking someone else’s credit, offending a superior, choosing the wrong side, or simply failing to complete an assignment could cost you your position, your friendships, and everything you worked so hard to build.

Can you rise from obscurity and make your mark at the center of the Three Kingdoms?

Begin as a Nobody in the Three Kingdoms


Create your own name, appearance, and abilities, then enter the chaos in the years 190, 194, 198, 200, 202, or 208 AD.

You will not begin by choosing a warlord and commanding a great army. Your starting faction and rank depend on the era and your background. You will meet the people within reach first, then gradually encounter military officers, scholars, generals, and rulers.

Your Martial Skill, Command, Strategy, Administration, and Eloquence determine the duties you are suited to perform.

You can rise through the ranks through military merit, or build your career through administrative achievements, strategic accomplishments, reputation, personal connections, and the support of your direct superior. The higher your office, the more people and resources you can influence—and the more responsibility you must bear.

People Remember What You Do


Talk with people, give gifts, write letters, request meetings, ask favors, or present your ideas.

They respond according to their identity, personality, faction, current situation, and everything they have experienced with you. They remember your promises, your help, your insults, and the credit you took from them.

Relationships are not just a single approval meter that goes up and down.

Closeness, hatred, suspicion, weariness, career rivalry, family ties, and direct superior-subordinate relationships all affect whether someone will meet with you, speak on your behalf, take responsibility for you, or carry out your orders in good faith.

Some people will seek you out. Others will use you from the shadows. Important figures may also send military reports, family letters, warnings, requests, and private invitations through the courier network.

Accept Orders—and Give Them


When you hold a low position, you must complete the assignments given by your superiors, look for chances to prove yourself, and find a way to ensure your achievements are recognized.

Once you gain an official position, you can assign tasks to your direct subordinates, sending them to gather intelligence, transport supplies, contact important figures, or take part in military operations.

Your subordinates may flatter you or ask for promotion. They may also grow resentful when they receive unfair treatment, dangerous assignments, or too little attention. How you distribute opportunities, credit, and responsibility will determine whether they truly follow you—or merely wait for a better patron.

Recruit Retainers and Build Your Own Household


As your status rises, you can recruit retainers, negotiate their monthly pay and titles, assign them responsibilities, and help them maintain their own household troops.

Your retainers are not emotionless cards.

Each has their own strengths, loyalty, expectations, injuries, and ambitions. One may be suited to managing grain shipments, another to gathering intelligence, and another to leading a charge.

You can order a retainer with troops of their own to form a siege army using their private household troops, then assign other retainers to join and strengthen the force.

But they will remember every victory, defeat, casualty, and decision about who receives the credit. If you keep underpaying them, ignore their injuries, or send the same person into danger again and again, even your most loyal follower may eventually walk away.

Every Month, the World Moves On


Time will not stop and wait for you.

When a month passes, every faction acts according to its military strength, supplies, technology, geography, ambitions, and the pressure of history.

Wars change the owners of cities. People are promoted, defect, fall ill, or die. Major events in distant regions will not appear before you all at once; news reaches you gradually through relationships, letters, military reports, and the courier network.

History has its own momentum, but it is not unchangeable.

One suggestion from you may only save a shipment of grain. A successful operation may, years later, help decide the outcome of a battle that changes the fate of the realm.

You can remain loyal to your original lord and rise through the ranks. You can govern cities, develop faction technology, and take control of military and political power. Or, when the time is right, you can seize a city, raise your own banner, and establish a faction of your own.

There Is More to Life Than War


War and official duties are not the whole of your life.

Make friends, visit scholars, give gifts, and take part in martial tournaments, scholarly gatherings, meetings of warlords, and merchant fairs featuring rare goods.

You can also arrange a betrothal and marry the person you choose.

After marriage, your spouse will remember your departures, defeats, homecomings, and broken promises. They will also take part in family affairs, business, social connections, personal security, and the plans you make together.

At the same time, you may have to deal with retainers asking for higher pay, subordinates seeking promotion, political rivals setting traps, financial pressure, assassination attempts, and the uncomfortable question of who should receive credit for your achievements.

Decide How History Will Remember You


You may rise from an ordinary foot soldier to become a powerful regional official and help your lord unify the realm.

You may seize command of an army, capture cities, and establish a state of your own.

Or you may lose your position through a series of bad choices, be abandoned by those close to you, and eventually meet your end amid political struggles and accumulated crimes.

Your ending will look back on the factions you served, the people you gained and lost, the family and household you built, the achievements you accomplished, and the price you paid to survive.

The victors will be written into the history books.

But in this Three Kingdoms world, everyone who truly lived through the chaos will leave behind a story of their own.


During Early Access, we will continue improving character memory, married life, task assignments, promotion pacing, the balance of war and resources, historical event connections, interface presentation, performance, and save compatibility.

store_data.about_the_game:
Come train with your new bunny coach Lily, playing as Mark the fox!

In Furry Memories: Love Coach your goal is simple: beat all 30 memory game levels. But don't get too comfortable. Each level becomes harder and harder, testing your memory, concentration, and ability to keep your focus while the tension slowly builds. Every victory unlocks a brand-new scene or animation, giving you another reason to keep going and discover what happens next.

From the first exercise to the very last one, your bunny coach will be there to keep you motivated or perhaps make it even harder to concentrate. With an empty gym and a tempting bunny waiting for you, staying focused might prove to be the real challenge.

Complete the levels, unlock all the scenes, and see how far you can make it before the workout becomes too much to handle. And once you've unlocked something, you can revisit your favorite scenes and animations anytime in the gallery.

  • 30 Memory game levels

  • 30+ Steamy scenes with Lily

  • Hot animations

  • 1 Horny bunny just for you~

One exercise after another, the tension keeps building… Will you manage to resist, complete the entire workout, and finally make it to the changing room?

store_data.about_the_game:
You and your friends were living perfectly ordinary sheep lives. Then a group of desperate aliens abducted you from Earth.

Their territory has been invaded by strange creatures from your planet. The aliens have never seen them before. You have.

That apparently makes you their best hope.

Now you’re crammed aboard a spaceship and forced to fight in exchange for a ride home.

There’s only one problem:

Nobody controls the ship.

Each sheep controls a turret. Your lasers burn through enemies, but also push the entire ship in the opposite direction. To dodge incoming bullets, the whole crew must coordinate.

Or argue loudly.

Fire wool balls, harpoon crates and weak points, collect XP, and create ridiculous weapon combinations as you battle through changing stages and bosses.

The entire crew shares the same hull and health bar. If the ship goes down, everybody goes down with it.

Save the aliens. Get back home. Try not to fly directly into the bullets.

store_data.about_the_game:
Night Shift: Something Is Wrong is a first-person atmospheric observation game focused on environmental exploration and anomaly detection.

You are starting a night shift inside an office building. Your job is to monitor the security cameras, patrol the rooms, and use the report terminal whenever something no longer matches the building’s normal state.

At first, the job seems simple. Learn the layout. Remember where objects belong. Understand how the lights, doors, and equipment normally behave.

But with each passing night, things begin to change.

Objects may disappear, move, or appear where they do not belong. Lights and doors may behave strangely. Some anomalies can only be seen through CCTV. Others may only become obvious when you inspect the building yourself.

But not everything unusual is an anomaly.

Observe. Verify. Then report.

Across seven night shifts, you will uncover new parts of the building, discover documents, and receive instructions from your supervisor, Jack. As the nights progress, some of those instructions may begin to conflict with what you see for yourself.

Your decisions, reporting accuracy, and behavior throughout the game will influence how the story ends.

Features:

  • Seven progressively changing night shifts

  • CCTV monitoring combined with physical patrols

  • Dozens of anomalies throughout the building

  • A report system based on location and anomaly type

  • Story events, documents, and phone calls

  • Choices that influence the story

  • Multiple endings

  • Atmospheric first-person exploration

  • No combat-focused gameplay

Not everything you see should be reported.
And not everything the system tells you has to be true.

Finish the main story to unlock Endless Mode and Speed Run Mode.

store_data.about_the_game:
Break through the encircling pursuers, loot their components, and rebuild a battered war machine into a mobile fortress.

*Rush Out Death* is a top-down mechanical action game centered on modular construction. Race ever rightward across a hostile wasteland, attach hexagonal components around your root weapon, reroute signals, and use successive pulses to drive your entire machine into action.

Assemble a Truly Connected Hexagonal Build

Every component connects edge-to-edge with its neighbors. Each has defined inputs, outputs, and its own durability. Interface directions and connections directly determine whether your signal network can function.

Send Pulses Through the Network

Signals originate from the root node and travel along connected routes to weapons and support components. Plan the order of your connections so machine guns, shields, and additional modules activate at the right moment.

Salvage, Rebuild, and Repair on the Run

Destroy mechanical pursuers to recover scrap and new components. Install, upgrade, repair, or dismantle them according to your current build and battle damage, strengthening your war machine as you fight to survive.

Keep Moving Through the Damage

Components take damage independently, with durability lights and visual wear showing their current condition. Broken routes, disabled components, and relentless enemy pressure continually reshape the situation. Reconfigure your machine while moving and keep pushing forward.

  • Top-down single-player pursuit and shooting combat

  • Hexagonal modular construction built around a root weapon

  • A directional, sequential signal-pulse network

  • Meaningful trade-offs between weapons, support systems, durability, and interfaces

  • Wasteland pursuers, component drops, upgrades, repairs, and dismantling

  • Hand-drawn industrial pixel art with a CRT-inspired atmosphere

store_data.about_the_game:
Echoes of a Strange World is a hybrid Dungeon Crawler and Visual Novel that blends atmospheric scifi exploration with a dark, psychological narrative.

When Lyra, a key member of the reconnaissance crew, crash-lands on an uncharted alien world and vanishes without a trace, Jake is dispatched on a solo rescue mission. Navigating futuristic landscapes and hostile alien environments, Jake must trace her footsteps, scavenge for survival, and piece together the events following her arrival.

However, as he draws closer to the truth, it becomes clear that Lyra is no longer the comrade he once knew. Whether altered by the mysterious planet or consumed by something far more sinister, her transformation forces Jake into a intense confrontation, a battle that will test both his physical resolve and mental endurance.

Will Jake succeed in saving his lost teammate, or will he be forced to face a heartbreaking reality on this alien realm?

Key Features

  • Engaging Narrative: Experience a compelling sci-fi mystery through Visual Novel–style storytelling.

  • Atmospheric Exploration: Traverse sci-fi and alien-themed dungeons, scavenging for vital supplies, equipment, and resources.

  • Turn-Based Combat: Battle alien threats and futuristic horrors using tactical, turn-based combat.

🎈

"Balloon Pop 9999" is a first-person 3D casual game where you pop balloons scattered everywhere.

🎈

  

Many balloons were decorated here and there for a big party. The party is probably over, so let's pop them all and clean up.

🎈

Pop balloons in various locations, hoover up the remnants to clean the area, and collect the "Pop Power" needed for upgrades. Don't worry if some debris is left behind, these balloons are made of biodegradable materials.

🎈

  

Acquire new tools and upgrades to pop balloons even more efficiently.

🎈

There is no time limit, and there's absolutely no need to rush. You can enjoy popping them at your own pace.

The satisfying sound of balloons popping and the act of vacuuming up the debris might just be a great way to relieve your stress

🎈

About Streaming and uploading video

You can play this game live or upload videos at your own risk, and monetize those videos.

If possible, I would appreciate it if you could include a link to your store page in the description section

store_data.about_the_game:
ALETHEIA FOUNDATION // DIRECTOR OPERATING CONTRACT

The SOMNODYNE site has passed into your custody. Below the snowline, fifteen cells wait for subjects that should not exist.

Mendicant Sea is a real-time creature-containment management game, escape-defense strategy game, and tactical creature battler. Run a five-floor facility, manifest and study 200 PTF species, direct specialist staff, and prepare an external defense for the moment care becomes crisis.

ASSUME THE DIRECTIVE

Every ten-minute shift moves from morning into night while the facility continues around you. Purchase and configure containment cells, watch live needs through the PTF Tracker, assign Scientists and Keepers, fund wages and supplies, and decide which warnings can wait.

The facility and escape field are two live sides of the same site. Pause when you need to think; when the clock runs, staff, elevators, care jobs, weather, research, combat, and breach pressure all move with it.

MANIFEST THE UNKNOWN

Authorize sealed Nascent Memories without knowing exactly what they contain. Installation reconstructs a living PTF in your chosen cell, complete with individual Quotients, provenance, rare chromatics, care preferences, combat identity, and a record that persists through its life.

The searchable Codex begins with unknowns. Feeding, habitat changes, and research reveal what each species likes, hates, resists, and becomes. A living dossier tracks the individual; the Codex preserves what the Directorate has learned about the species.


CARE IS CONTAINMENT

Containment is not a health bar. Hunger, contentment, stress, sanitation, research readiness, habitat affinity, and Breach Pressure interact over time.

Keepers collect reserved food from storage, carry it through the facility, feed subjects, and clean cells. Scientists travel through the same halls and elevators, remain physically posted, and unlock one of six research procedures. Staff caught inside a cell when its subject breaches do not return.

BUILD THE LINE

Security lives on the external escape field. Position squads, equip distinct weapons, and construct six emplacements from five sidegrade turret families: Autocannon, Minigun, Energy Lance, Tesla Tower, and Biosprayer.

Upgrades improve survivability and output, but no tower solves every PTF. Read Biomic offense, Eidolic defense, routes, conditions, and your operating budget before committing the line.

WHEN CONTAINMENT FAILS

A breached PTF enters the escape field as an independent incident. It can fight Security, destroy turrets, break any one of three gate sections, and leave the site permanently. A breach also drives pressure through every occupied cell on the same floor, allowing one failure to become several.

FIGHT FOR ACCREDITATION

Take living PTFs into 1v1 or 3v3 Containment Combat. Their authored basic moves, special moves, passive abilities, conditions, Biomic offense, Eidolic defense, Quotients, and equipped relics all enter the arena. Victory pays. Defeat, recovery, and forfeiture follow your roster home.

Fight randomized local accreditation matches or open a friend-only Steam lobby. Steam PTF Trade lets two Directors browse eligible living rosters, mark interest, make one-for-one offers, and complete a custody transfer only after both sides confirm the final record.

EVERY SUBJECT LEAVES A RECORD

- 200 species, each with a combat kit, relic, preferences, research responses, and lore.

- Normal, Shiny, and SteamID-derived Manager Chromatic forms with permanent Codex discovery.

- Four visible relic slots per living PTF: Head, Left Shoulder, Right Shoulder, and Back.

- Fifteen containment positions across five immediately accessible floors.

- Dynamic surface and paranormal weather with operational effects and forecasts.

- Five turret families, tiered Security weapons.

- Six research minigames whose difficulty follows the relevant PTF and Scientist Quotients.

- Steam friend-lobby 1v1/3v3 Arena battles plus PTF trading.

- Three local save slots, account-bound Steam Cloud copies, and Steam achievements.

- A guided first directive and a complete in-universe Field Manual.

The Directorate does not promise safety. It promises a complete record.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Fall into Darkness

You are alone in an endless abyss, with no maps, no warnings, and no help at all. Every step is taken in the dark, feeling your way through a void that tries to extinguish the little light you have left.

What Is Real?

Fear begins to cloud your mind; the environment, the sounds, and the reality around you shift in ways that make you question your sanity. Even a simple jump creates things that should not exist.

The Collapsing World

The ground cracks and breaks with every step you take. Amidst the relentless darkness, continuing forward is the only way to avoid being swallowed by the chaos that descends into ruin.

store_data.about_the_game:
Adventurer is a simulation game that combines base building, dungeon exploration, and town shop management. At the beginning of the game, you have an Adventurer's Inn. By managing the inn, players earn money and increase its reputation to unlock new stories and characters. The player's goal is to become the richest merchant in the world, with an unlimited management mode. Defeating the Demon King is just a side quest...

【Base Building】
Manage your own base and assign personnel wisely to maximize resources and profits:

  • Inn: Assign characters to work and generate income.

  • Bar: Assign characters with “Hostess” related traits to work and earn money.

  • Dance Hall: Assign characters with “Dancer” related traits to work and earn money.

  • Trade: Any character can be assigned to trade. Characters with higher Intelligence earn more, while those with “Merchant” related traits receive bonuses.

  • Mining: Any character can be assigned to mining. Characters with higher Strength and Vitality earn more, while those with “Strong” related traits receive bonuses.

  • School: Assign characters with “Teacher/Archmage” related traits to increase the Intelligence and Morale of members staying at the inn.

  • Infirmary: Assign characters with “Doctor/Healer” related traits to increase the HP recovery rate of members staying at the inn and cure illness.

  • Kitchen: Assign characters with “Chef/Housekeeper” related traits to increase the Mood recovery rate of members staying at the inn and reduce their daily expenses.

Upgrade functional facilities: Expand your base and gradually unlock higher levels and more functions.

  • Bathhouse: Increases the Mood of members staying at the inn.

  • Library: Increases the Intelligence of members staying at the inn.

  • Garden: Expands facility capacity and improves the environment, increasing the Mood of members staying at the inn.

  • Shops (Weapons / Armor / Items): Unlock higher-tier items as the level increases.

  • Alchemy: Craft potions and accessories.

【Dungeon Exploration】

  • Dungeons: Enter and explore, engage in RPG battles, and collect materials.

  • Challenge area bosses to unlock higher-difficulty dungeons.

  • Purchase new inns / trigger new stories to unlock new dungeons.

【Battle System】

  • Daily Exploration: Four-person party RPG turn-based battles.

  • Stat Growth: Improve attributes through active and passive effects from battles.

  • Work Assignment: Assign different types of jobs to increase individual character attributes.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Tale of the King and the Lorn Knight Called Sir Roberdroric is a low-budget, yet remarkably self-aware of its own importance and relevance, side-scrolling pixel-art beat ’em up disguised as a very important medieval epic.

Sir Roberdroric, the Lorn Knight, (whatever that means) has a simple task: cross the kingdom, reach the Skull King’s castle, and recover the princess. Unfortunately, every region along the way insists on turning this perfectly reasonable journey into something considerably more complicated.

Choose from four very different knights. There are some others, but you will have to find that out for yourself. Fight your way through enemies using melee attacks, jumps, grabs, throws, dash, stride, and character-specific abilities. Hurl enemies into walls, obstacles, or other enemies, and use the environment to survive the journey.

5204930.name: Ops Normal: Airline Operations Control Center

store_data.about_the_game:
The plan will not survive the shift

The published operation looked clean when it left planning. It will not stay that way.

A captain calls sick. An inbound delay eats into the next duty. A grounded aircraft breaks its evening rotation. The problems arrive separately; the consequences do not.

Ops Normal is a single-player airline operations simulation. You inherit a working schedule and take responsibility for recovering it—not for designing an airline from a blank map.

Recover aircraft, crew and pairings

Use standby and reserve coverage. Swap or reposition aircraft. Rebuild pairings, arrange positioning travel and manage unplanned layovers. Each decision changes where people and aircraft will be, what remains available and which later flights are exposed.

  • Track flights, aircraft rotations, crew coverage and pairings from one operations workstation.

  • Respond to sick calls, no-shows, delays, weather and technical disruptions.

  • Preview key recovery actions before committing them.

  • Watch standby coverage, spare aircraft, costs and future conflicts.

Legality is a hard limit

Crew must be qualified, rested, available, in the right place and legal for the duty. Recovery checks explain why an option is blocked and expose the consequences of valid changes. An illegal assignment is never a shortcut.

Every fix spends something

The spare aircraft that saves one departure may leave another rotation exposed. The crew member who solves today's problem may be needed tomorrow. The fastest answer may cost more, and the cheapest may leave the operation brittle.

Balance safety and legality, on-time performance, crew management, cost and communication while the schedule continues to move.

Work the shift, then answer for it

Act early, protect the coming days and leave the next shift an operation it can use. Your end-of-shift report records what you recovered, what it cost and which problems travelled downstream.

Tune complexity, guidance and disruption pressure separately, without turning legality into a difficulty slider.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Last Elementalist is a dungeon crawler with rogue-like elements. Explore elemental dungeons and enhance your equipment with gems that are swappable so you can adapt mid-combat. Chain melee and spells in a fast paced flurry to devastate your enemies!

Gameplay

Battle through nine floors to reclaim each of the elements! Collect valuable gems that change how every piece of equipment behaves, even mid fight! Add spice with powerful artefacts that make you stronger, faster, and bend the rules in your favour, but beware, only pick what you need or your cloak won't fit all.

Fight with your weapon to restore mana used to cast magical spells, bouncing between close and ranged combat! Build for a wall of stuns and blocked hits, or for a glass-cannon spellcaster who never lets anything close the gap. Artefacts stack on top.

Elements

Four powerful elements have been stolen by all manner of creatures. As the last elementalist, harness the latent power of elemental gems. You can experiment with 100+ combinations of fire, ice, wind and earth gear. Set your enemies on fire with a fire sword? Maybe summon an earth golem to defend you? Or use the power of wind to evade your enemies, the choice is yours!

Gems come in Common through Legendary. A Legendary earth gem in a heavy sword build plays nothing like a Common wind gem in the same hands.

Expeditions

Pick your weapon, armor, and spellbook in the lobby, choose an expedition, and set the difficulty. Fire, Ice, Earth, and Wind each bring their own rooms, enemies, and elemental boss.

You'll die. That's the point, each run unlocks gear and rooms for the next one. Fire too punishing? Cool things down with the Ice Expedition and try again!

Features

  • Nine procedurally generated floors with boss arenas at 3, 6, and 9 culminating in an elemental boss

  • A gem system that rewrites your weapon, armor, and spellbook

  • Four elements across four distinct expeditions

  • 100+ combinations of weapons, armor, spellbooks, and gems

  • Enemies come in Normal, Hard and Elemental variants, adding extra mechanics, not just stats

  • Handmade pixel art and animation, no AI here

Built solo. Come break it with the rest of us on Discord!
