movies.name: Will It Launch? - Build Your Rocket - Gameplay Overview

store_data.about_the_game:
You are stranded on a planet that is entirely landfill. The only way home is a rocket, and the only material is the garbage.

Will It Launch? is a co-op comedy about engineering. You scavenge junk, drag it back to the pad, and hold it together with duct tape, ratchet straps, bolts or welds. The rocket stands in your yard and grows every trip. When you think it is finished, you crank it upright, strap yourselves into the seats, and someone on the ground fires a flare into the ignition trough.

Then you find out how good your worst joint was.

Scavenge

Nothing useful lies loose. Unbolt a part slowly and safely, cut it free fast and loud, or shove it and hope it does not land on you. Carry the small stuff, drag the heavy stuff, and get it back to the pad in one piece.

Build

Stack oil drums and water heaters, hang a cement mixer underneath as an engine, run a hose from the tank, bolt an office chair to the side. Every part is attached with one of four joiners, and every joiner shows its state from thirty metres away: tape sags, straps go slack, bolts stand proud, welds crack. Twelve strips of duct tape is a legitimate engine mount. It even passes the test.

Test

Pull the shakedown lever and the rocket groans under a fraction of launch load. Weak joints rattle and tape corners lift. Argue about it. Fix it, or don't.

Launch

Crank the rocket upright, strap in, and fire the flare. Joints keep failing all the way up. A successful launch is one where the failures happened to be non-critical. A failed one comes down somewhere nearby, in pieces.

Features

  • Online co-op for 1-4 players with proximity voice chat.
  • Physics-based assembly where every joint carries real load, and nothing fails at random.
  • Four joiners with readable states: duct tape, ratchet straps, bolted brackets, welds.
  • Failures you can watch happen: tape peels, straps snap, welds crack.
  • Playable solo. Better, louder and dumber with friends.

store_data.about_the_game:
Play as a milk flavored cat named Milky and explore a forest in search for different foods to mix with! Milky is a cute item collection game where you must collect all items for a gate to spawn which you then must get to within one minute to move onto the next level! However, beware of the Rats roaming around the forest as they will chase after you!

  • Find and collect different food items within the forest, and Milky will turn into different flavors!

  • When collecting the food, if you pick up the same type of food the points you get will increase for that food item each time you pick it up. It will reset to the original base points once you pick up a different food item.

  • Once all food items have been collected, a gate will spawn somewhere in the forest and you must find it within one minute or you will get a game over.

  • Enemy Rats will be roaming around in the forest, so beware of them! When you get to close to them, they will start chasing after you. They do lose interest in the player once a set amount of time goes by.

  • If you get hit by a Rat, Milky will lose one health point.

  • Health items are provided and will restore one health point, but use them wisely as there are only a few on each level.

  • Lose all your health and you get a game over!

  • To win a level you must collect all items and get to the gate within one minute. There is no end to what level you can climb too, so try and see how far you can go and get the highest score you can!

store_data.about_the_game:
Death is a growth industry

You are not a dark lord. You are a shabby necromancer with a hungry stone, a leaking crypt and a graveyard's worth of untapped inventory overhead. Rest in Profit is a pixel-art incremental about turning other people's eternal rest into a functioning business.

Tap the graves

The crypt corridors run sideways forever, and they are choked with rubble, cursed planks and sealed walls. Each blockage yields to exactly one spell, so pick the right one and open the way. Then set a soul collector under the richest cluster of graves you can find. Souls seep out on their own and drift toward the centre. You never micromanage a single one.

Bounce them for profit

Every soul ends up in the Stone Room, where the runes you set into the wall send it ricocheting before it is absorbed. Each bounce multiplies its value, and every rune trades bounces against worth in its own way. There is no single correct wall. Rebuilding your rune layout when a new one unlocks is where the real thinking happens.

Six faces, six ambitions

Essence buys upgrades from the Power Cube, and each of its six faces governs a different branch of the operation: collection rate, rare souls, spellcraft, the rune network, soul flow and translocation. Spend where your build actually hurts.

The crypt has neighbours

Something down there notices the lights. Incursions arrive in waves, they hunt your collectors, and they will genuinely destroy them. Build shard sentinels, bone barricades and frost snares along their route, and save the Overload for the night it truly matters.

Dig until the numbers stop making sense

Catacombs, Ossuary, Noble Crypt, Cursed Rift: the further you push, the richer the graves and the nastier the neighbourhood. Corridors are generated endlessly from a seed. When the stone is finally full, trigger the Fracture, cash in your Shards and start over faster.

In short

  • An incremental that keeps working while you are away
  • Thousands of souls flowing across the screen at once
  • A rune build worth rethinking, not one optimal answer
  • Endless procedural crypt corridors and four biomes
  • Hand-drawn pixel art and a wizard with a bad attitude

store_data.about_the_game:
PROJECT APEX RC

Small cars. Big racing.

Project Apex puts you behind the controls of high-performance RC cars and challenges you to master fast, technical tracks built for close racing, big jumps, and shaving every possible second off your lap time.

Race across a variety of handcrafted environments, from dusty desert circuits and towering redwood forests to snowy courses, coastal tracks, and nighttime races under the lights. Every track brings its own look, layout, jumps, surfaces, and challenges.

MASTER THE TRACK

RC racing is about more than holding the throttle.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sonucido: Dreams of the Gray God by Daniel da Silva is a turn-based Horror Dungeon Crawler RPG.

Decades ago, Sonucido was a prison dungeon. After this punishment was abolished under the rule of the mage, Sonucido was mostly barren. Weird creatures still lived there, thieves started to use it to smuggle illegal wares.

But something kept brewing in the ancient halls, something old was still waiting there. Nowadays, the thieves avoid it, the council ordered guards to keep the entrances safe. There are rumors that the dungeon is crawling upwards, and is twisting its corridors. Old maps are utterly useless. And then there are the nightmare fuel stories about the creatures. Restless sanguinary atrocities.

Your group decided to explore the dungeon to find something to sell, an artifact, anything.

It's not illegal, just stupid. The city even gives you some equipment in exchange for information when ... if you come back.

  • Constant distress, lose everything

  • Gripping turn-based combat

  • Multiple endings, choices matter

  • Fight atrocities, become one

store_data.about_the_game:
BUILD YOUR FOOTBALL DYNASTY

Take control of a professional football franchise and prove you can build a championship organization from the front office to the field.

Draft Day Sports: Pro Football 27 puts you in charge of the decisions that define a franchise. Build your roster through the draft, free agency and trades. Manage contracts and the salary cap. Hire and develop your coaching staff. Create a football philosophy that fits your personnel, prepare for each opponent and watch your decisions play out every week.

There are no shortcuts to building a dynasty. Finding talent is only the beginning. You need to decide which players are worth investing in, when to move on from veterans, how to keep your roster financially sustainable and whether the players you acquire actually fit what your coaches want to do.

BUILD YOUR ROSTER

Every offseason gives you another opportunity to reshape your franchise.

Scout the upcoming draft class, identify players who fit your organization and decide when to take your shot on draft day. Work the trade market, navigate free agency and negotiate extensions with the players you want to keep.

Contract decisions go far beyond the total dollar amount. Players evaluate offers based on a number of factors. Building the best roster means understanding what matters to the player across the negotiating table.

And with DDS: College Football 27, connected leagues can now import their draft classes directly into Pro Football 27, allowing the players from your college football universe to continue their careers at the professional level.

BUILD YOUR STAFF

A great roster still needs the right people leading it.

Hire coaches, manage your staff and build a coaching structure that matches the kind of football you want your franchise to play. Coaches develop their own characteristics and playbook preferences, making staff decisions an important part of shaping your organization.

PF27 expands staff management with generated coach descriptions, expiring-contract notifications, improved staff behavior and enhanced coach playbook creation, giving you more information and control when assembling your staff.

CREATE YOUR FOOTBALL IDENTITY

Your roster and your scheme should work together.

Build your offensive and defensive approach around the strengths of your personnel. Manage formations, packages and playbooks while preparing for the challenges presented by each opponent.

New package override options provide additional control over which personnel packages are used, while continued improvements to play calling and coach-created playbooks make the strategic side of running your franchise even deeper.

DEVELOP YOUR PLAYERS

Winning isn't only about finding talent. It's about developing it.

The new Advanced Training system gives you more control over player development and how your organization prepares its roster for the future. Decide where your development priorities should be and turn promising players into important pieces of your franchise.

WATCH YOUR GAME PLAN COME TO LIFE

When game day arrives, see the results of everything you've built.

The 2D game presentation has been improved with smoother animations and continued refinements to on-field behavior. Updates to defensive back play, field goals, kickoffs, spikes, overtime situations and play-calling logic make each game a better representation of the decisions being made on the field and in the coaching room.

Simulate games when you want to move quickly or get involved and watch your strategy unfold play by play.

YOUR LEAGUE. YOUR WAY.

Whether you want to take over an existing team, create your own football universe or build a long-running career spanning season after season, Draft Day Sports: Pro Football 27 gives you the tools to play your way.

PF27 also includes a new QuickStart option, improved in-game tutorials and help, expanded customization and mass-edit tools, updated HTML league exports featuring draft results, player traits and team staffs, and numerous improvements throughout league management.

Build the roster.

Hire the staff.

Create the system.

Make the decisions.

Build Your Dynasty.

store_data.about_the_game:
Green Horizon is a relaxing 2D weed-growing and life simulation game about taking over your uncle’s neglected operation and building a new life at your own pace.

After your uncle is sent to prison, you’re left with his old property and the beginnings of a small cannabis grow. What starts as a rough setup slowly becomes a much bigger operation as you grow different strains, earn money, upgrade your equipment, meet the locals and discover more about the town around you.

Grow and manage your crop, complete orders, explore different areas, visit shops and interiors, and talk to characters with their own routines and stories.

As you progress, you’ll unlock new strains, locations, equipment and opportunities, while story missions gradually reveal more about your uncle, the operation and the people connected to it.

Features

  • Grow and harvest different cannabis strains

  • Expand and improve your growing operation

  • Complete orders and earn money

  • Meet and interact with NPCs around town

  • Follow story missions and side jobs

  • Explore shops, interiors and new locations

  • Use your in-game phone for messages, missions and orders

  • Unlock new seeds, equipment and areas

  • Experience a changing day and night cycle

  • Play at your own pace with relaxed progression

Green Horizon is currently in development, and features shown on this page may change before release.

store_data.about_the_game:
WELCOME GUESTS. SHAPE THE ISLAND. BREAK THE CYCLE

You didn't plan on owning an island.

But after an unexpected auction leaves you responsible for a neglected little place somewhere in the Mediterranean, that's exactly where you end up.

I'LL KEEP IT is a first-person hospitality and island management game about taking care of a place that has been left behind. One guest, one repair and one day at a time.

Guests arrive by seaplane with their own plans, expectations and personalities. It is up to you to prepare the island for them, decide what needs your attention and keep everything running throughout the day.

Take care of the island

There is always something that could use your attention.

Clean up neglected spaces, repair broken objects, restock supplies, serve guests and gradually bring cafés, shops, paths and other parts of the island back to life.

You decide what is worth fixing first and how much care you want to put into the little things.

Welcome different guests

Visitors arrive and spend their day exploring the island.

Prepare the places they want to visit, keep an eye on what they need and decide how to organize your time before they move on.

You won't always be able to do everything.

What you choose to take care of (and what you leave for another day) shapes their experience.

Plan your day

Use your planner to keep track of visiting groups, their routes and the places they intend to spend time at.

A day moves from morning through evening, turning every visit into a small management puzzle: what should you prepare now, what can wait, and where will you be needed next?

Make progress that stays

Your work doesn't disappear when the day ends.

Restore neglected locations, improve the island, unlock new possibilities and slowly turn a place that has been deteriorating for years into something that feels alive again.

Some changes are practical.

Others are simply there because you cared enough to make them.

Discover what happened here

The island has a history. And not everything about it is immediately explained.

Meet the people connected to the place, explore its forgotten corners and uncover more of its story as your relationship with the island grows.

What begins as an unusual purchase gradually becomes something much more personal.

Your island doesn't need to be perfect.

It just needs someone willing to KEEP IT.

store_data.about_the_game:
如果能重来一次，高三会有什么不同？

距离高考还有300天。

你重新坐进一间普通的中国高中教室。早读仍然从六点多开始，晚自习结束时已经接近深夜。桌上是没写完的卷子，黑板旁挂着倒计时，同学、老师和家长也都有各自的打算。

这一次，你可以重新决定这一年怎么过。

选择属于你的高三路线

选择主角的性别、物理或历史方向，以及住校或走读身份。

不同路线拥有不同的班级、科目、同学和生活空间。住校生要面对熄灯、洗漱、查寝和室友关系；走读生则要赶末班公交，在深夜回家后决定继续写题还是先睡觉。

计划写在纸上，能不能做到要看你的行动

每周确定自己的主要安排，并选择最想加强的科目。计划不会直接变成属性，而会影响这一周更容易遇到哪些机会。

真正的变化发生在每天的选择里：订正错题、参加讨论、兑现约定、照顾睡眠，或者把有限的时间留给身边的人。没有完成的计划、失约的承诺和没有说出口的话，也会继续留在之后的剧情中。

面对六科学业与一次次考试

语文、数学、英语，以及物理方向或历史方向的三门选科，都有各自的掌握度、稳定性、薄弱环节和考试表现。

月考、一模、二模和高考不只检查数值。复习方法、作息、临场状态和此前积累的压力，都会影响最后的发挥。成绩很重要，但高分并不是衡量这一年是否值得的唯一标准。

同学不是等待攻略的标签

有人曾经是你的同桌，有人和你分班后仍会在校门口等你，有人只是后排那个总在接话的普通同学。

友情、竞争、信任、疏远和喜欢会从一次次具体互动中形成。只有身份与关系真正成立时，感情才可能继续发展；选择友情，也会拥有完整而独立的故事。

从开学走到高考结束以后

故事分为十章，覆盖高三的303个叙事日。从开学、换座、寒假返校和百日誓师，一直走到毕业照、最后一节课与三天高考。

高考结束后，你还会经历查分、正式填报志愿、收到录取结果，并看到学业、家庭、人物关系和个人选择共同组成的尾声。

带着有限的记忆，再来一次

完成一轮游戏后，可以重新回到距高考300天。

你无法记住所有答案，但一些重要的瞬间会留下痕迹。它们可能让你更早发现问题、换一种方式兑现承诺，或者终于说出上一轮没能说完的话。

store_data.short_description: 《高三最后300天》是一款以2020年代中国普通公立高中为背景的横屏互动叙事生活模拟游戏。从距高考300天开始，选择主角的性别、选科方向与住校或走读身份，安排每周计划，在早读、晚自习、考试、宿舍和回家路上作出决定。你的选择会改变六科学习状态、精力与压力，也会影响承诺能否兑现、同学之间如何相处，以及某段关系最终停在友情还是继续靠近。故事将经过月考、换座、寒假、百日誓师、一模、二模、毕业照和三天高考，直到查分、填报志愿与收到录取结果。高分不是唯一答案；通关后重新开始，你还能带着有限的记忆，试着改变那些真正放不下的遗憾。

store_data.about_the_game:
One-line pitch

In 317 CE, the Western Jin has fallen and the northern elite flee south. Found a rising clan in Jiangnan, build its estate, govern the provinces, navigate the Eastern Jin court, and decide what your house will risk for survival and restoration.

Short description

A clan-management and grand-strategy game set during the founding years of the Eastern Jin. Establish your house, settle your people, manage its manor, govern local territory, navigate court politics, and face Zu Ti's expedition and Wang Dun's rebellion.

About the game

Reaching Jiankang does not end the exile. Your people need land and security, your manor needs labour and supplies, and every position you take at court reshapes your relationship with the great clans, imperial authority, and the provinces.

Your story begins in the spring of 317 CE as the head of a rising clan. Choose your family's character, background, political ties, and starting identity, then manage scarce resources as history advances by quarter. Grain, cloth, population, prestige, and political credit are connected. A decision that solves today's crisis may define your house years later.

Found and manage your clan

  • Create a clan head and choose your family's disposition, path, and starting identity.

  • Settle relatives, dependants, and households while maintaining order and security.

  • Develop fields, natural resources, and workshops, balancing labour against long-term growth.

  • Educate and appoint clan members whose lives become part of your wider strategy.

Build a foothold in Jiangnan

  • Read the full theatre map through provinces, regional conditions, and strategic landmarks.

  • Respond to local issues, pay the cost of governance, and establish lasting influence.

  • Deal with displaced people, powerful local interests, shortages, and fragile institutions.

  • Make decisions with visible costs, benefits, time commitments, and risks.

Navigate court and crisis

  • Join court deliberations and choose between great clans, imperial authority, and your own interests.

  • Pursue offices, political credit, and support while living with the promises you make.

  • Back Zu Ti's northern expedition with grain, troops, political cover, or members of your house.

  • Follow a continuous historical campaign from 317 to 324 CE, meeting named figures and facing Wang Dun's rebellion and its aftermath.

The game remains in active development. Current content covers 317–324 CE, and systems, balance, text, and presentation may continue to change.

store_data.about_the_game:
Let Big Sister Stay by Your Side

Big Sister is a Live2D companion desktop pet game. Once launched, she settles into a corner of your desktop and quietly keeps you company while you work, study, browse the web, or take a relaxing break.

There are no complicated objectives and no need for constant attention. Place her wherever you like and add a little warmth to every moment you spend at your computer.

A Lively Live2D Companion

Big Sister blinks and breathes in real time, while her hair and clothes move naturally with physics-based animation. Her head and eyes follow the direction of your cursor, making every glance feel a little more alive.

Place Her Your Way

  • Move Freely: Click and drag the character to place Big Sister anywhere on your desktop.

  • Resize Freely: Hover over the character and use the mouse wheel to adjust her size.

  • Clear and Complete: The character remains fully visible at different sizes, with optimized edge clarity.

Companionship Without Distraction

Transparent areas around and within the model allow mouse clicks to pass through, so Big Sister will not get in the way of your normal desktop activities. Switch between always-on-top and normal window modes in the settings to suit whatever you are doing.

Right-click the character or use the system tray icon to open the quick menu, access the settings, or exit the game at any time.

Simple, Practical Settings

  • Always-on-top and normal window modes

  • Simplified Chinese and English interfaces

  • System tray quick menu

  • Automatic saving of your preferences

Whether you are focusing on work, settling in for a study session, or taking a short break, Big Sister will stay on your desktop and quietly keep you company.

store_data.about_the_game:
The year is 1596. The Spanish Empire stands at the height of its power—and on the brink of crisis. Its wars have drained the royal treasury, its sea routes are under attack, and unrest is spreading throughout its distant colonies.

You are the last heir of a fallen baronial house, left with little more than a noble name, a family crest, and a mountain of debt. With the king’s permission, you gather your few remaining loyal followers and set sail for the New World.

There, among untamed lands, untold riches, and unknown dangers, you must build a settlement, restore your family’s honor, and forge a legacy that will endure for generations.

But something is waiting for you in the New World—an enemy unlike anything Europe has ever known, and one you could never have anticipated.

AN EPIC SINGLE-PLAYER CAMPAIGN

Lead the Spanish through an epic story and fight for the glory of your house, for Spain, and ultimately for the survival of the entire human race.

The campaign is deliberately asymmetrical, imbalanced, and unfair. You will face overwhelming forces equipped with weapons far beyond your understanding. Victory will not come from meeting the enemy on equal terms, but from adapting, exploiting every advantage, and surviving battles you were never meant to win.

Your only hope may lie in a mysterious metal found exclusively within the craters scattered across the New World—sites the enemy guards above all others. The alchemists known as the Theurges have given this substance a name: Ferrocorum.

The Spanish arrived in the New World as conquerors and brought the Aztec and Inca empires to ruin. But to the Supayari, the Spaniards are the natives—and this time, humanity stands on the wrong side of conquest.

AN OLD-SCHOOL REAL-TIME STRATEGY

Ferrocorum 1596 is an old-school real-time strategy game that pays homage to genre classics such as Earth 2140, Warcraft II, Warlords Battlecry, and Knights and Merchants and many others. At the same time, it offers its own unique blend of gameplay mechanics, from managing your economy to commanding large-scale battles.

Outside the Spanish campaign, fight standalone skirmish battles against the AI as any of the three playable factions. Defend the New World as the Inca, lead the Spanish conquistadors, or command the Supayari—the mysterious machine race threatening the survival of humanity.

One of the game’s defining features is the automatic production of units without resource costs. This keeps the battle moving at a brisk pace, reduces tedious micromanagement, and opens up new tactical possibilities on battlefields where entire armies clash.

Ferrocorum 1596 is an old-school real-time strategy game that pays homage to genre classics such as Earth 2140, Warcraft II, Warlords Battlecry, and Knights and Merchants and many others. At the same time, it offers its own unique blend of gameplay mechanics, from managing your economy to commanding large-scale battles.

Outside the Spanish campaign, fight standalone skirmish battles against the AI as any of the three playable factions. Defend the New World as the Inca, lead the Spanish conquistadors, or command the Supayari—the mysterious machine race threatening the survival of humanity.

One of the game’s defining features is the automatic production of units without resource costs. This keeps the battle moving at a brisk pace, reduces tedious micromanagement, and opens up new tactical possibilities on battlefields where entire armies clash.
store_data.short_description: An old-school real-time strategy with automatic, resource-free unit production and large-scale, deliberately unfair battles. Lead Spain through a story campaign, or command the Spanish, Inca, or mysterious machine race Supayari in skirmishes against the AI.

content_descriptors.notes:
Ferrocorum 1596 contains stylized wartime violence shown from a top-down perspective. Human units fight with spears, rapiers, firearms, and heavy mechanical weapons. Combat includes impact sounds, death cries, brief death animations, bloodstains, and bodies that remain visible on the battlefield. The violence is not shown in close-up and there is no dismemberment or exposed gore. Non-combat units, including workers and doctors, can also be killed.

The game includes a command labelled “Suicide,” which instantly kills selected player-controlled units. This uses the standard death animation, sound, body, and bloodstain; self-harm is not otherwise depicted as part of the story.

The game explores themes of war, colonial conquest, and conflict between Spanish and Inca forces within a fictional alternate-history setting. It contains no sexual content, nudity, rape, non-consensual sex, or depictions of alcohol or drug use.

store_data.about_the_game:
INTRODUCTION TO THE GAME

You're just a student in a design class. Your classmates have already left, but you stayed late to finish an assignment. Some time passes, and the assignment is done. You get ready to leave, but you can't, because the main exit is locked, and when you try to use the elevator, an infinite loop begins.

You're trapped inside a computer lab. Find anomalies to be able to escape. Creatures will try to stop you, so survive and run away!

If you encounter an anomaly, go down with the elevator.

If you don't find any anomalies, keep going up.

When you identify the necessary anomalies, the loop will be terminated.

ESTIMATED PLAY TIME

20 - 60 minutes

OPTIONS

Adjust the graphics settings, mouse sensitivity, and other settings can be configured from the options.

store_data.about_the_game:
Gateholt is a 1-4 player co-op horror game about entering cursed places and erasing the marks an evil spirit has left behind. Erase every mark and the spirit loses its hold on the place and disappears. There is just one problem — it will not let you work.

YOUR JOB

  • Scrub away dried bloodstains
  • Wipe out marks carved into the walls
  • Burn cursed objects
  • Release the souls it has caught
  • Seal its coffins
  • And various other purification work

Each task needs a different tool. What you bring is decided before you step inside.

ERASING MAKES IT WORSE

Every mark you erase drives the Demonic Influence down, and the lower it drops, the harder the spirit hunts you. As it falls, servants wake — and lower still, the spirit itself goes on a rampage. In this game, progress and danger are the same meter.

NO TWO NIGHTS ARE THE SAME

Which evil spirit haunts the place, and which servants will wake, you cannot know until the Gate opens. Each servant interferes in its own way — flooding rooms with fog, trading places with the dominant spirit, closing in the moment you look away. What worked last time may not work tonight.

SPLITTING UP IS FASTER

Up to four go in together. Spread out and the work goes faster, but the further you drift from the others, the more dangerous it gets. Your voice only reaches teammates who are nearby — and so do your screams. You can go in alone, too. It just means no one hears you.

IF YOU MAKE IT OUT

Spend your pay on gear, upgrades, and cosmetics. And if you cannot finish, you can close the Gate and walk out. No pay — but you walk out.

FEATURES

  • Online co-op for 1-4 players — solo runs supported
  • Horror without weapons — run, hide, hold on
  • A different spirit-and-servant combination every run
  • Distance-based proximity voice chat
  • Unscripted jump scares and directional 3D audio
  • Hatched art style

Gateholt is in development. Add it to your wishlist to hear the moment it's out.

store_data.about_the_game:
TAKE YOUR SHOT. CHASE THE CUP.

Golazo: Arcade Football Cup is a fast-paced 11-v-11 arcade football game built around responsive play, spectacular finishes and the excitement of knockout competition.

Choose from 16 fictional clubs, step onto the pitch and fight your way to the trophy.

ARCADE FOOTBALL, BUILT FOR ACTION

Forget complicated control schemes and endless menus. Golazo keeps the focus on movement, passing, attacking and scoring.

Build attacks, find space around the penalty area and turn the right delivery into a spectacular finish.

SPECTACULAR GOALS

Create scoring chances and finish them with a variety of attacking techniques, including:

• Headers

• Volleys

• Bicycle and scissor kicks

• Turning finishes

• Long-range shots

• Far-corner strikes

SMART ASSISTED PLAY

Golazo includes gameplay assistance designed to keep matches flowing while leaving important decisions in your hands.

Players intelligently move into attacking positions, selection assistance helps you stay involved in the action, and the Auto-Finish system can turn well-placed passes and rebounds into dramatic first-time attempts.

MASTER THE LOFTED PASS

Send a lofted ball toward an attacker in a dangerous scoring position and give the play time to develop.

When the delivery, positioning and timing are right, your attacker can automatically attack the ball with a header, volley, bicycle kick or other acrobatic finish.

ROAD TO THE CUP

Choose your club and enter the knockout tournament.

Win your matches, survive the pressure of extra time and penalties, and progress through the bracket until only one team remains.

16 FICTIONAL CLUBS

Every club has its own identity, colours, crest, kits and squad.

Pick your favourite and take them all the way to the trophy.

PENALTY SHOOTOUTS

When a knockout match cannot be settled in normal time or extra time, the pressure moves to the penalty spot.

Take control of your penalties and try to beat the goalkeeper when everything is on the line.

MATCH REPLAYS

Relive your best goals and memorable moments with the replay system, including dramatic slow-motion playback.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Golazo supports keyboard controls and compatible gamepads, including common USB and Bluetooth controllers.

Whether you're chasing a quick match or trying to win the entire cup, the focus stays on fast, accessible arcade football.

FEATURES

• Fast-paced 11-v-11 arcade football

• 16 fictional clubs

• Knockout Cup competition

• Extra time and penalty shootouts

• Smart assisted player selection

• Assisted attacking movement

• Auto-Finish system

• Ground-pass, rebound and lofted-pass finishing opportunities

• Headers, volleys, bicycle kicks and other spectacular finishes

• Manual shooting

• Goal replays and slow-motion playback

• Match statistics

• Multiple difficulty options

• Keyboard support

• Gamepad support

• Single-player gameplay

store_data.about_the_game:
A signal from another galaxy

At the end of your first voyage, you chose to stay among your new friends.

Years later, a message comes in: it's from Andromeda, 2.5 million light-years away. A civilization is broadcasting its position.

You hesitate, then you set off.

The journey

From the Orion Arm to the Magellanic Stream, by way of the Shadow Zone, you cross regions of the universe no one has ever reached, all the way to the Andromeda galaxy.

The ship

It's more than a cockpit. Some of its sections are yet to be built.

Behind one of them, an empty room awaits you. It will fill with the keepsakes you treat yourself to along the way, and each one, once on display, will earn you Rare Energy.

Minigames

Somewhere on board, unlockable items hide nine games, each with its own challenges and Rare Energy rewards.

We'll let you find out where.

What you grow

Twelve engines, each more powerful than the last.

A skill tree of 110 nodes across eleven branches, including clicking, production, drones and decryption.

A fleet of drones to assemble and send out to probe derelicts and land on planets.

A forge that turns all your resources, even the oldest, into ingots of fundamental energy, the very thing the aliens are asking for.

What you keep

120 artifacts, each with its own entry.

A few changes of outfit along the way.

…and a couple of things we'd rather let you discover.

And Earth, drifting away

You stay in touch with Earth. With every resource you discover, you send back your readings, and its replies follow you as far as they can reach.

Above all, this game is an odyssey

A space odyssey, driven by an incremental clicker.

You travel at your own pace, though space will now and then spring a few surprises that call for quick reactions.

The road ahead is long, but you'll be equal to it, Commander. Safe travels.

A forge that turns all your resources, even the oldest, into ingots of fundamental energy, the very thing the aliens are asking for.

What you keep

120 artifacts, each with its own entry.

A few changes of outfit along the way.

…and a couple of things we'd rather let you discover.

And Earth, drifting away

You stay in touch with Earth. With every resource you discover, you send back your readings, and its replies follow you as far as they can reach.

Above all, this game is an odyssey

A space odyssey, driven by an incremental clicker.

You travel at your own pace, though space will now and then spring a few surprises that call for quick reactions.

The road ahead is long, but you'll be equal to it, Commander. Safe travels.

store_data.about_the_game:
The World of Postcards

You've accidentally stumbled into a world of postcards. Everything before you feels strangely familiar — those are exactly the design works you created before. You have stepped into the world you made.

Scenes and Text, Shaping Each Other

In this world, words and scenes are not separate. They breathe together, moving as one.

  • Scene changes text: An apple falls from a tree, and the word APPLE also falls from the tree.

  • Text changes scene: You obtain a key, and two doors appear. Find the clues, solve the puzzle, and choose the right door.

Every change ripples through the other. Nothing stays still.

Transform Into a Mouse

Don't forget — you've traveled into the world of computers.

A mouse is indispensable here. By transforming into a mouse, you can defy gravity and move freely, exploring spaces that were once out of reach.

Weapons for Destroying Roadblocks

When night falls, you will acquire a magic weapon that can destroy fragile objects — including text itself.

  • Press F to strike.

  • If F is not pressed within 3 seconds, it automatically resets.

Destroying text changes the environment. Changing the environment rewrites the story. Every choice leaves a mark.

Two Forms: Day and Night

Experience two unique visual styles across two modes:

  • Day: Bright, clear, filled with familiar details

  • Night: Mysterious, atmospheric, where magic awake

This innovative game combines graphic design with gameplay — a love letter to creators and dreamers alike.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sigma Survivor is a bloody pixel-art game where every chest you come across is a pure lottery. Pick your hero and destroy the hundreds of monsters in your way! All your skills fire on their own, but dodging the attacks is still on you. Dive into a story that's anything but ordinary and roam the lands as a Sigma Survivor!

Fight the horde of monsters!

  • Hundreds of monsters at once, and your job is to make it to the end of the round.
  • Dozens of weapons to choose from, from the classics like lightning to one-of-a-kind weapons like the slot machine.
  • Six different heroes, each with a completely different playstyle.
  • Many worlds and levels, each with its own unique enemies.

Every chest is a pure lottery

  • Open a chest and power up your hero, or take the risk and go for more!
  • Chests hide minigames, and beating one hands your hero extra bonuses. There are dozens of them, so you won't run out of thrills!
  • Win the minigame and you get a better reward than the standard one. Lose it, and well... tough luck!
  • Plenty of other casino twists too, like the slot machine or a quick round with the dealer to power up your character.

Died? Start over. This time stronger!

  • Upgrade your weapons, improve and merge items at the blacksmith, learn the elements, master every hero and make them stronger.
  • A shop full of NPCs, and every one of them has valuable bonuses for your hero.
  • Lots of attractions and secrets hidden across the levels!
  • Plenty of achievements to unlock, and a grimoire that keeps every stat from your games as one big summary.

Quick runs for long hours

  • A standard run takes about 20 minutes.
  • Every setting can be tweaked, so the game plays the way you like it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Magic keeps the kingdom alive, but for the past month, shipments of magical crystals have mysteriously stopped.

You are Aster, an Arcane Investigator sent to uncover what is happening to the mines. With Lily, an invisible fairy who lets you read people’s true thoughts, and a newly assembled team of semihuman assistants, you’ll track down corrupted crystals, dangerous curses, and the conspiracy behind it all.

There’s just one problem: Aster’s unusual magic has a very strong effect on his companions. The closer they get to him, the hornier they become, and sometimes the only way to keep the investigation moving is to help them release all that built-up tension.

🧡 Naga

An agile and rebellious cat semihuman who becomes Aster’s first travelling assistant. Naga’s constant dirty jokes, impatience with authority, and bratty attitude tend to get her into trouble, but she is far more capable than her behaviour suggests. When Aster tries to convince her that a maid uniform is necessary for magical protection, she quickly discovers the truth and decides that wearing only the genuinely enchanted parts is more than enough.

🤍 Sumi

An old friend of Naga who joins the expedition in search of stable work. Sumi can be clumsy when placed under pressure, but her extraordinary memory makes her invaluable when dealing with records, clues, and complicated investigations. She also possesses a natural affinity with small magical creatures and, unlike Naga, has absolutely no problem adopting Aster’s proposed maid uniform.

💙 Noko

A sleepy, carefree neko who would usually rather relax than get involved in someone else’s problems. Beneath the oversized clothes and permanently tired attitude, however, Noko possesses an incredible natural resistance to magic. Even Lily struggles to read her thoughts, and when corrupted crystals make an entire mining area impossible to enter, Noko may be the only person capable of getting through.

100+ Fully animated scenes!

Enjoy fully detailed looping animations from start to finish.

Free tempo control during specific sex scenes!

Speed up, slow down, make her really want it. You control when it starts and ends...

And much more!

  • Kinetic Visual Novels: Your decisions shape both your journey and the ending.

  • Pocket sized adventure: Get straight to the point and have fun!

  • No Censorship!: You get to see exactly what you want to see.

  • Gallery: Fill a branched image album as you progress through the story and relive each chapter whenever you want.

  • Smooth Navigation: Click to advance or skip to get to the good parts all in one click!

  • Immersive Audio: Including music, sound effects, and moans.

PLEASE NOTE

  • All characters depicted in this game are over 18 years old, and no real or identifiable minors were used in its production.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Animals Race!

Gather your friends for the ultimate racing and betting party game! In Animals Race, you aren't playing as the animals—you are betting on them. Five racers (Cheetah, Kangaroo, Pig, Penguin, and Turtle) are lined up on the track, but only the players control who moves forward!

Use Your Phone as a Controller!

No need to buy extra gamepads. Animals Race uses a Jackbox-style controller system. Just scan the QR code on the screen, and your smartphone instantly becomes your secret drafting hand!

Draft Cards to Win!

Every round, cards are revealed that move the animals forward. Then, it's drafting time! Pick the cards of the animals you want to support. If your drafted animal finishes in 1st, 2nd, or 3rd place, you score massive points. But beware: animals with more cards in the deck (like the Cheetah) move fast, but slower animals (like the Turtle) reward you with far more points if they win!

Chaotic Checkpoints!

The race track is filled with Checkpoints. When the last-place animal crosses one, a random event is triggered! from sudden Speed Boosts and Slips, to massive Wipeouts and Tornadoes, the tide of the race can change in a single second.

Features:

  • 2 to 6 Players: Perfect for game nights, local couch co-op, or streaming!

  • AAA Arcade Presentation: High-energy announcer voices, beautiful glassy UI, and fast-paced rounds.

  • Strategic Betting: Do you back the fast favorite, or risk it all on the slow underdog for a huge payout?

store_data.about_the_game:
Two cats sit side by side. The left one is correct.

The one on the right is not. His head is swollen. His ears went somewhere and did not come back. He swears his paws were longer this morning, and he has been stretched along a line nobody remembers drawing. The file simply calls him the specimen, and now he is your problem.

You fix him with glass.

Under the panels lies a tray of lenses — magnify, shrink, widen, flatten, swirl, bulge, pinch, shear, ripple, and a void that quietly cancels whatever it covers. You pick one up and lay it on the cat. Slide it. Grow it. Turn it. The cat bends under it, live, as you move your hand. Somewhere in that small space is the exact spot where the swelling meets its opposite and simply stops existing, and when you find it the two cats snap into agreement and the level is over. You will know before the game tells you.

Nothing here can be failed. The clock in the corner counts up, but it is not counting down to anything, and nobody is going to take the cat away from you. Your stars come from moves, not minutes: solve him in par and you get all three, take longer and you still get the cat. The only thing this game ever asks is that you look at him long enough to see what happened.

FIFTY CATS, IN FIVE CABINETS

The first cabinet teaches you to look. The second starts tilting things, and suddenly a lens has to be turned as well as placed. The third cabinet betrays you: one day you open a level and the wrong cat is the one on the left. Nothing is broken on your side at all. Your job is no longer to fix him — it is to reproduce, faithfully, whatever was done to the other one. "We stopped keeping the original," says the note. "This is the original now."

By the fourth cabinet there is more glass on the board than cat. By the fifth you are handed the void, and the void looks back.

Twenty breeds pass through on the way — tabby, ragdoll, chonk, sphynx, and one the file only calls "eldritch". Every one of them leaves whole.

Every level says what it wants of you in one plain line under the panels, and no level withholds anything to seem clever. When a mechanic is new, the game explains it once, in the words of whatever you are actually holding — controller, mouse or thumb.

THE WHOLE CABINET

When you have seen all fifty, you can run them. Fifty cats back to back and a clock that finally means something. Every cat is timed as its own split, so you will find out exactly which one keeps costing you the run, and finished runs go into the records table to be beaten later — probably by you.

BEND YOUR OWN CATS, AND HAND THEM TO STRANGERS

The level editor is the other half of this game, and it does not talk down to you.

There are no sliders and no vocabulary to learn. You drop a ring onto a cat and bend him with it: drag the middle to move it, grab the rim to make it bigger, roll the wheel to bend harder. The cat deforms while you do it, so you are never editing numbers — you are pushing on a cat. From every ring a wire runs down to a slot in the tray, showing the exact lens the player will be handed to undo what you just did. One lamp tells you whether a human being can actually solve this. One number, Room To Miss, tells you how much they are allowed to be wrong. Easy, Normal, Tricky. Name it. Done.

Then send it out.

Publish a single cat or a whole pack of them straight to the Steam Workshop, and anyone who owns the game can subscribe and play what you made. Their levels arrive the same way: one click, and someone else's bent cats are sitting in your cabinet next to ours. Nothing is second-class about them — a level built by a player on their sofa runs the same twelve lenses, the same solver and the same three stars as the fifty we made ourselves.

So fifty is only the number we shipped. The cabinet keeps filling up.

MADE TO BE PLAYED COMFORTABLY

Mouse, keyboard and controller work on every screen, editor included. If dragging is awkward, place a lens with a click instead. Text comes in large and largest, with high contrast and reduced motion for anyone who needs them, and stick speed you can set yourself. The music changes as you go deeper. Two hundred cat facts arrive whether or not you asked for any.

Fifty cats of ours, and as many more as the Workshop can stand. A hundred and fifty stars, three per cat if you solve him clean. Five achievements, one of them hidden. And at the end, a sentence that has been waiting for you the whole time: thank you for looking inside.

Brightness, volume, resolution and keybinds are the keys to every puzzle, and the UI itself can block enemy attacks or strike back.

Even the OS window is fair game. In this game, truly anything can become a weapon or a shield. Perhaps even tampering with the client files could be a hint.

Solve the puzzles of each stage and use every UI and trick to overthrow the ADMIN.

store_data.about_the_game:
1989. Yura Laptev, a student at a technical institute, receives an old television from a mysterious old man. The old man gives one warning: "Don't watch it in the evening. Anyone watching in the evening remains inside."

Yura ignores the warning. In the evening, he turns on the television—and finds himself trapped.

Now he finds himself inside the screen, in a world of static and forgotten television studios. Around him is a labyrinth of abandoned Soviet television studios, once bustling with life. Then the airwaves were shut down. The programs were forgotten. But they didn't disappear—they remained inside. Waiting. Hungry.

Ten Meetings, Ten Choices

Yura understands: to escape, he must go through all the studios. But each meeting is a test. Each presenter plays their own game. Each has their own rules, their own logic, their own understanding of how the world works.

And in every studio, there's a choice. To act or to refuse. To believe or to doubt. To watch or to close your eyes. To join the game or to stand aside.

The wrong choice—and Yura will remain here. To become part of the show. An eternal spectator or an eternal actor.

The Logic of Survival

It's not about strength or dexterity. It's about understanding people. Understanding what they want. Why they're desperate. Where their weaknesses lie.

Every encounter is a puzzle. Sometimes the solution is to act. Sometimes it's to refuse. Sometimes it's simply to look into their eyes and not look away. Sometimes it's to leave, not playing at all.

Every choice has consequences. Every ending tells a story.

Every studio is a place of silent melancholy. Every presenter was once needed. Now they're static.

Psychological horror through dialogue—Characters don't scream or attack. They persuade, manipulate, and play with words. Every phrase can become a trap or a salvation.

GAME FEATURES

A choice system with irreversible consequences — Every decision carries weight. The wrong word, the wrong look, the wrong refusal — and you're trapped inside forever. No second chances in a single playthrough.

Multiple trap endings — Dozens of different bad endings, each showing how you become part of the broadcast. Each has its own logic and horror.

Changing studios and atmospheres — From the silence of static to cardboard sets, from icy walls to sticky floors, from empty chairs to mirrored reflections. Each location creates a new trap.

One night, one story — A complete journey from turning on the TV to either exiting or dissolving into static. A coherent story that can be completed in a single evening and replayed for different endings.

Choices based on understanding — There are no right answers, only logical ones. You must understand why each character is desperate, what they want, and where their weakness lies. The solution comes not from action, but from reflection.

WARNING

The game contains intense psychological horror with themes of imprisonment, manipulation, and loss of identity; scenes of deformation and transformation of the human body, including graphic images of human organs; threats of surgical intervention without anesthesia; scenes of suffocation by steam and suffocation; hanging from a trapeze; tying with ribbons and ropes; death by hypothermia and burns; deformed and disfigured characters with inhuman features; disturbing scenes involving food; characters turning into parts of a television broadcast; themes of oblivion, loneliness, and inability to escape; a claustrophobic atmosphere and a feeling of confinement.

store_data.about_the_game:
Not the baccarat you know. Duel Baccarat is a 3D party game for 2–8 friends around one table. You are not playing the house. You are playing each other.

Two economies run at once. Gold buys bets and items. HP keeps you in the room. Go broke on the felt and you start losing blood. Hit zero HP and you are out, watching from the rail.

How a round feels

  • Bet Player, Banker, Tie, or pairs. You can even bet both sides.

  • Spend gold in the shop: bombs, curses, shields, peek glasses, dummy glasses.

  • Highest stake on that side slowly squeezes the cards.

  • Last player standing wins. If the round cap hits, richest survivor takes it.

Steam lobby or LAN. Fill empty seats with CPU. Hold V to talk.

No real money

Chips, gold, and $ signs are in-game only. There is no cash-out.

store_data.about_the_game:
A dynamic blend of historical 4X turn-based strategy and roguelike discovery!  From prehistory to a futuristic age, grow your empire in a massive campaign that includes multiple playthroughs. Embersong: History Is Yours harkens back to the feel of grand strategy gaming in the '90s while infusing new elements to innovate the genre. Enjoy sprite-based game design fused with modern strategy elements. 

Go beyond just one match with the campaign

Infinite replayability is a hallmark of the 4X genre, and the cornerstone of the Embersong experience as it weaves roguelike elements into the experience! The epic campaign requires five matches to be completed, win or lose. As you guide your early wandering band of explorers into a mighty empire across eight ages (eg, Classical, Medieval, Industrial), you will gather bonuses that accumulate with each playthrough. Your performance in those five matches will dictate the difficulty you encounter in the final sixth match, where you must utilize your built up enhancements as you face off against an overpowered mythical force! With six possible end-game bosses, you must quickly grow your empire and overcome your opponent's unrestrained power. Should you win the campaign, the boss mythical empire is unlocked for future playthroughs.

Face off against the greatest empires of history...and legend

Lead Rome, Egypt, China, Babylon, Greece, Japan, Cahokia, India, France, Mongolia, Venice, or the Inca — each with its own leader, era-specific units, buildings, music, and cultural ambitions.  Many empires have unique play-styles such as Mongolia's single-city rule and Venice's ability to expand by purchasing barbarian settlements and opponent cities. Then play the final match of the campaign against mythical boss empires such as Atlantis, Shangri-La, the Kingdom of Prester John, and the Seven Cities of Gold. 

One of your opponents is not playing the same game as you

Each match, one opponent empire will be designated the Archenemy, and receive multiple bonuses and abilities. This is bad news for you, because the Archenemy has a single purpose: To hunt you down and destroy your fledgling empire! Fend off against your regular opponents that seek to win by domination, science or score victory, as well as a nation bent on only attacking you at every turn.

Late-Game Innovation

Every civilization has an era-appropriate special unit, from the War Chariot that Egypt unlocks in the Ancient-Era, to the Galleass vessels of Renaissance-Era Venice. Embersong takes this approach further by providing each empire (including the mythic ones!) a Future-Era unit that is unique to them. From the Cyber-Ninjas of Japan to the Condor Wing aircraft of the Inca, survival in the endgame becomes fast-paced and like nothing you've seen before!

store_data.about_the_game:
How to Hunt is a 1-4 player physics-based action-adventure hunting simulator set in an open wilderness. After trashing your ride during a camping trip, you and your friends must survive, hunt wild animals and upgrade your gear to unlock new biomes and find a way back home.

Prep for the Hunt

Kick back at camp with your friends, fire up the BBQ, practice your aim on target bottles, and load up your ATVs with heavy firepower.

Small Game, Big Firepower

Stalk rabbits and ducks through the brush, blast them with AK-47s, and stack the physical ragdoll bodies high into your towed trailer.

Take Down Apex Bosses

Face off against massive bears in intense co-op combat, drag the heavy carcasses back using your winch, and pack the meat into cold storage for massive payouts.

Every run follows an active loop of preparation, hunting, harvesting to meet the quota:

Prepare at Camp: Stock up on ammo, purchase dog biscuits from the vending machine, fire up the BBQ, and customize your ATV with towed trailers and winches.

Track & Hunt: Drive out into expansive maps across 5 distinct biomes (Forest, Tropics, Savannah, Antarctica, and Cyber-Pangaea). Use your loyal hunting dog to locate animals, set traps, and use weapons ranging from bats to AK-47s and explosive launchers.

Harvest to Meet Quota: Dead animals turn into full ragdoll bodies. Manually lift and toss small game into your trailer, or use your ATV’s mechanical winch to drag heavy apex predators to meet the target weight quota for each run.

Store & Cash Out: Transport carcasses back to camp, haul the ragdoll bodies directly into the cold storage fridge container, and cash out your delivery to fund your next operation.

Progress & Escape: Earn cash to purchase higher-tier weapons for more effective hunt

Key Features & Game Mechanics

  • Dynamic Ragdoll Physics: Every animal, vehicle, trailer, and winch cable operates on full physics interactions. Careless driving, sharp turns, or high speeds can flip your trailer and scatter your haul across the terrain.

  • Loyal Canine Companion: Your AI hunting dog assists during every phase of the hunt. Feed him treats at camp to enhance his tracking range, direct him to point toward hidden game.

  • 5 Unique Biomes & Apex Bosses: Progress through 5 distinct environments featuring over 20 different animal species. Each biome culminates in a unique apex boss fight - ranging from territorial Forest Grizzlies to amphibious Tropical Crocodiles.

  • Co-op Gameplay & Multiplayer: Play solo or team up with up to 4 players in online co-op. Coordinate roles within your group- have one player drive the ATV, another manage winches and trailer cargo, and others provide rifle cover or set traps.

store_data.about_the_game:
THERE IS A BOX.

It is buried somewhere inside a solid cube of one million blocks. You have two hands and as long as it takes.

Find the Box is a slow, quiet, first-person digging game. No enemies. No map. No inventory. No pressure.

HOW IT PLAYS

- One block at a time – punch blocks to remove them and get closer to finding the Box. There is no faster way. Nobody is rushing you.

- Normal mode – the edges of your vision turn green as you get closer to the box and red as you drift away. Warmer, colder. That is all the help you get.

- Hard mode – no indicators at all. One million blocks, one box, your instincts.

- Your holes stay dug – every block you remove is saved. Quit, come back tomorrow, and your tunnels are exactly where you left them. The box hasn't moved either.

- The clock is running – a timer quietly tracks how long each search takes, across every session. Nothing happens when it ticks. It just remembers.

- Personal leaderboards – your best times in Normal and Hard are kept, so once you've found the box you can start again and try to find the next one faster. Or not.

WHY DIG

Because it is calming. The rhythm of it settles into something close to meditation. Some people play it after work to switch their brain off. Some play it with a podcast on. Some dig in silence and let the dark do its thing.

There is a low, ambient soundtrack and not much else. The surface is bright; the deeper you go, the less you see. It is peaceful right up until the edges of the screen start turning green, and then it is something else.

THE BOX

Exactly one block in the grid is different. It glows. When you break through to it, you will know.

FEATURES

- Single-player, first person

- 1,000,000 fully destructible blocks in a persistent world – dig anywhere, in any direction

- Normal mode with warmer/colder proximity feedback, Hard mode with none

- Autosave – every dug block and the box's location persist between sessions

- Run timer and personal best leaderboards for Normal and Hard mode

- Relaxed, unhurried pace with no fail state. There is nothing that can hurt you down here.

- Low-key ambient soundtrack

- No combat, no crafting, no inventory, no story to read. Dig.

PLAYTIME

As long as it takes. Some people find the box in less than 30 minutes in Normal mode. Some dig for weeks in Hard mode, a little each night. The save makes both easy, and the timer will tell you exactly how long it took – then dare you to beat it.

store_data.about_the_game:
A siege you fight in person

Most defense games leave you watching from above. Here you go down to the wall.

Between waves, you plan

You spend the match's gold on swordsmen and archers, plant spikes, braziers and nets, raise barricades, reinforce the gate and decide where to hide the princess. There is never enough gold: a better sword for you, or two swordsmen for the wall? The window reopens between waves — at a markup.

When the horns sound, you fight

Third-person combat with weight: a sword combo with a finisher, a bow with real draw and arrow drop, block, parry and a dodge with proper i-frames. Nine mana abilities and six buyable weapons that change your cadence, stamina and knockback. On foot or on horseback, by day or by night, in rain or snow.

And the valley answers

Sixteen enemy types, each with a job: rams that break doors, climbers that raise ladders against the wall, infiltrators that go for the back gate, catapults that shell you from range, commanders whose aura pushes their own forward. Nobody knows where the princess is until a scout sees her and word spreads. Kill the one giving orders and morale breaks — the wave routs.

A six-chapter campaign

Your village burns and the road to the capital runs through a taken forest, a river, a snowbound pass and one last siege. You recruit companions who follow you across chapters, choose which way to go, and what you earn on the road shows up in the final battle.

The other side of the wall

You can play the whole siege as the horde. It isn't a separate mode: it's the same match seen from outside. You choose where to set the trebuchet and what to open the breach with, against a defense that buys and places on its own between waves — or against other players.

Your army remembers

Troops that survive a wave get promoted: a name of their own, a stripe and more health. And every piece takes three upgrade levels by aiming at it, so upgrading really competes with buying another.

Relics

At the end of each wave you draft one of three relics from a pool of thirty-six, and none of them is "+10% damage". There are pacts that charge a price you can see, synergies that depend on how you play, and cards that change what you pay attention to. No two runs feel alike.

Three battlefields

  • Keep Valley — meadow, lake, village and harbour below the castle.

  • Winter Waste — snow, long nights and wolves that hunt in the dark.

  • Willow Bridge — a plain split by a river. No stone walls: a palisade outpost, two lines you give up in order, and a bridge you can drop when it can't be held any longer. After that the horde swims across, slow and exposed.

A valley that lives

Day and night cycle, four seasons, rain and snow. Villagers with trades, livestock, deer that bolt, wolves that hunt after dark and a bell in the square you can ring. The castle is fully walkable inside, and the ground remembers where you fought: grass gets trampled, stone gets sooty, blood dries.

Co-op for 1 to 4

Public and password-protected rooms, text chat, tactical map pings and a squad report at the end. Full controller support, remappable keys and eight interface languages.

store_data.about_the_game:
A card-based management game

Where Sinners Sleep is a card-based hotel management game. Every item, employee and guest is represented as a card. To use them, be creative, experiment. Slot cards in different rooms to find unique resolution to your clients' storyline.

Run the devil’s hotel in the early 20th Century

You had no choice. You struck what seemed like a generous deal. Manage the hotel, keep the profits. But the Owner expects regular payment of the following rents:

store_data.about_the_game:
The city is already spoken for

Five rival crews own most of the streets. The police hold the Ninth Precinct.
You have one home turf, a growing crew, and a city full of blocks waiting to
change hands.
Gang Takeover is a real-time, top-down territory strategy game about
fighting for every corner and making the money to hold it. Clear rival
defenders, break their control, claim the block, and turn captured businesses
into the cash that funds your next push. Every expansion creates new ground to
defend — and gives the gangs around you another reason to come looking.

Fight for the block

  • Move through the city, aim, and fight in real time.
  • Push into rival territory, wear down its control, and hold your ground through the takeover.
  • Capture businesses for income, then upgrade the blocks that keep your operation alive.
  • Watch your back, your rivals are coming for you: rival gangs expand, attack, and reinforce their own turf while you make your next move.

Build a crew that can hold the city

Recruit named gangsters with different archetypes, traits, rarities, and field
specialties. Put them to work as escorts, garrisons, or
assault squads. Keep them alive, help them level up, and manage their
loyalty in solo runs — a crew is more than a number on the map.
Spend street cash and respect to climb through seven ranks. Expand your crew
capacity, invest in upgrade tracks, and choose the right mix of weapons,
armor, and vehicles for the streets ahead.

Run the city your way

Solo challenge runs let you start a fresh city while building permanent
reputation, rank upgrades, milestones, and prestige rewards across your career.
Before a run begins, opt into challenge modifiers that make the streets
harder in exchange for more reputation experience. No healing. Relentless heat.
Less crew. No business income. Stack the odds if you want the win to mean more.
Online multiplayer rooms put you in the same authoritative city as
other players:
  • Co-op Crew: share a gang, territory, and victory progress.
  • Rival Gangs: build separate gangs and race to control 75% of the city.
  • Create a private room, join a friend's room by code, browse open rooms, or use Quick Match.
  • Rival matches feed seasonal standings so every takeover can have stakes beyond the current block.

The city does not wait

Timed events keep the map moving and force hard choices. Intercept a
Rival Convoy, survive a Police Surge, clear a Civilian
Uprising, seize a Black Market, exploit a Gang Truce, or use
an Informant Tip to find the rival block that matters most. Cash,
respect, heat, and territory all pull your attention in different directions.

Take the Ninth Precinct

The Ninth Precinct is the city's police-held endgame block. It is visible from
the start, but it will not fall to an underprepared crew. Reach the Kingpin
rank, bring a large healthy gang, surround the station, and put its garrison
down before you can take the block. When the precinct changes hands, the
badges are off the streets — and the city is yours.

How far will your colors spread?

  • Fight through a 108-block city spread across five named districts.
  • Capture and upgrade businesses to turn territory into an economy.
  • Outplay five rival gangs, each led by a named boss with a distinct street strategy.
  • Grow from Corner Hustler to Kingpin through cash, respect, gear, and crew management.
  • Chase solo milestones, challenge-run victories, and permanent prestige rewards.
  • Take the Ninth Precinct and prove you can hold the hardest block in the city.

store_data.about_the_game:
Deal with the Deep is a single-player roguelike deckbuilder. Choose a character and descend into the abyss, progressing through battles, events, shops, and rest sites. Collect new cards and relics, refine your deck, and confront the final boss of each stage.

Turn-Based Card Combat with Range Mechanics

Positioning shapes every decision. Move your character, adjust your facing, and consider attack range. The same card may produce different effects depending on whether its target is within range or too far away. Observe enemy positions and intentions, then use movement to deal more damage or avoid incoming attacks.

Build Your Deck Along the Journey

Choose new cards after battles, acquire relics that can transform your playstyle, and refine your deck through upgrades, card removal, and other events. Each character has a unique starting deck, card pool, and combat mechanics, offering different approaches to deckbuilding.

Manipulate Your Route Chips

Your journey is represented by route chips on a tabletop. Battles, shops, rest sites, treasure chests, and unknown events may all lie ahead. Use tabletop facilities to reveal chip types in advance, reroll unwanted types, refresh shops, or even skip battles.

Different Choices with Every Descent

Routes, enemies, events, rewards, and relics combine to create a different journey each time. Experiment with new card combinations, refine your deck as you descend deeper, and prepare your own strategy for each stage boss.

About the Current Version

Deal with the Deep is independently developed by a solo developer and provided free of charge. It contains a completable single-player campaign, but its balance and Workbench features have not yet undergone extensive testing. The game does not include music or sound effects.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build matter, one bond at a time

Atom By Atom is a minimalist factory automation game where raw elements flow through Matter Tubes and are bonded into precise molecular structures. Your factory surrounds a hungry black hole. It wants specific molecules.

Extract, route, react

Discover elemental clouds in a seeded world, place Extractors, and draw continuous Tube networks. Dividers balance materials between production lines, while automatic bridges let routes cross without mixing. Later, Wormholes connect distant parts of the factory, a unique factory game mechanic.

Structure matters

Every molecule keeps its atoms, bond orders, connectivity, and open valences. A formula is only the beginning: what you feed into a machine determines what can come out.

Start by producing H2 and H2O. Later, unlock machines that cleave, substitute, oxidize, cyclize, polymerize, condense and hydrolyze increasingly complex matter.

Visual markers show unused valences, machine inputs, outputs and moving molecular structures. Exact step-by-step recipes are available when a new reaction is introduced.

Feed the black hole

Complete molecular contracts to advance, unlock new elements and machines and transform a simple extraction line into a sprawling chemical factory. The black hole accepts deliveries from every side and turns production goals into the center of your layout.

Scale your solution

Trace long Tube paths, rotate and flip machines, copy and paste production blocks, and save reusable Blueprints that you can share with anybody. Seeded maps, minimap markers, factory statistics, machine efficiency readouts, portable save codes are just a few of the many functions this game offers.

A must have for any factory game, space and chemistry enthusiast!

Build matter. Atom by atom.

store_data.about_the_game:
A quiet little space that's all yours.

Peel & Place is a cozy decorating game about turning empty rooms into warm, personal spaces, one sticker at a time. Peel, place, layer, and rearrange to your heart's content. There's no score, no clock, and no wrong way to play. Just settle in, take a breath, and make something that feels like home.

🏡 Decorate, your way

Fill your rooms with a huge collection of stickers. Furniture, plants, cozy lighting, and all the little details that make a space feel lived-in. Drag, resize, and layer everything exactly where you want it. Every room is a blank canvas waiting for your touch.

✨ Stickers that come to life

Some stickers aren't just for looks, they move. A flickering candle, steam drifting off a fresh cup of coffee, a cat's tail swishing back and forth... animated stickers add a gentle spark of life to every scene you create.

📸 Capture your favorite corners

Made a room you love? Snap a photo and save the image straight to your computer. Build a little gallery of your coziest creations, share them with friends, or set them as your wallpaper.

🌙 No pressure, ever

No timers. No goals. No way to lose. Peel & Place is made for slow evenings and calm moments, a small pocket of quiet you can return to whenever you need to unwind.

store_data.about_the_game:
In a world devastated by a failed experiment codenamed MARIA-21, the silence of the streets is now broken only by moans, gunfire, and the wind between collapsing buildings. Dmitry Ivanovich Sokolov heads to the heart of the outbreak to find his father, Roman, one of the scientists responsible for the disaster and now a prisoner of a fanatical cult led by Vassily Morozov, a former priest who confuses faith with slaughter.

The journey takes him through hostile territories ruled by both infected and desperate survivors, where ammunition is scarce and every confrontation demands caution. Along the way, unexpected allies appear and disappear, while the fractured past between Dmitry and Roman — marked by reconciliation and rupture — resurfaces with every new discovery.

Explore a decaying world full of environmental puzzles and discover how far a son is willing to go for a father who may never have deserved to be saved. Hollowreach: Wasteland — survival, hard choices, and the search for answers in a world that no longer forgives anyone.

The grid of blocks is your battlefield, and your cursor is your only weapon. Forget clicking—simply hover to destroy.

Master a 10x10 grid of 100 blocks that unlock gradually. Hover over them to deal damage, shatter them, and collect Gold and XP. As you level up, blocks get tougher, and you earn Prestige Points to fuel your next leap.

Key Features:

  • Idle Helper Blocks: Deploy specialized blocks that passively deal damage, generate money, or produce experience for you.

  • 5 Upgrade Categories: Strategically boost your Main Blocks, three independent Idle types, and Mouse Mastery.

  • Prestige: Reset all progress to unlock powerful, permanent upgrades tailored to each category.

  • Block Perks: Every single block has its own unique perk, offering specific boosts to its rewards or damage.

  • Tier System: Face a massive global difficulty spike and full reset. Conquering these tiers drives you toward a true endgame and final completion.

  • Polish & Customization: Track detailed statistics, unlock Steam achievements, and personalize your experience by customizing the background to any color you desire—whether it's a dark mode theme or something completely unique.

The grid awaits. How fast can you master it?

store_data.about_the_game:
Love is Everywhere is a Boys Love visual novel done by Xlyph Bara Games where you will learn how to act in an earthquake emergency and how you could help others.

The game is a fictional story taken place in the 2026 Colombia earthquake to raise funds for the emergency.

All my condolences to anyone affected by the earthquake, stay safe.

This is a story about a guy named Santiago, early morning, he wakes up to an earthquake! and then after it happens he decides to help others becoming a rescue team member,  in this story you'll save Simón a his dog Jovita out of the disaster, let's see how love will make it's way here.

I hope this game teach you  how to approach these kind of situations, but please I encourage you to support the official channels of the earthquake emergency relief to help the affected people with the earthquake in Colombia in 2026, remember, TOGETHER WE ARE STRONGER!

If you liked this game don't forget to leave a review and support the artist

Xlyph could keep creating more Bara games, and why not more Boys Love visual novels.

Check out my other games!

store_data.about_the_game:
No Scope CEO puts you in the founder's chair of an FPS esports team. You recruit the players, develop their strategies and run the whole organization. But once the round starts, you're not the one holding the mouse.

Your players are far more than a few stat lines. How they answer you, what they are chasing and how they hold up under pressure matter just as much as their aim.

FROM FIVE NOBODIES TO WORLD NUMBER ONE

  • Create your org

  • Recruit your roster

  • Set up the practice schedule

  • Define the strategies

  • Land your sponsors

  • Upgrade your facilities

  • Become world number one!

WON ROUND BY ROUND. BUILT SEASON BY SEASON

The better your team knows a map, the further you can move past the standard setups and design your own plays. Tactics not your thing? Let your IGL handle the calls and focus on recruiting, training and growing your org.

WATCH YOUR DECISIONS COME TO LIFE

When the round starts, your players have to live with every decision made before the match.

Follow the pushes, the space they take, the gunfights, the rotations, the plants and the retakes. Sightlines, weapons, economy and utility genuinely shape how a round plays out.

EVERY CHOICE COSTS YOU SOMETHING

Every decision has consequences. Overloading practice can burn your players out, a clumsy statement can drive the fans away, and a losing streak can make your sponsors nervous. Results, morale, popularity and budget are tightly linked: your choices can turn a small org into a benchmark for the scene, or start a spiral that is very hard to stop.

NOBODY REACHES WORLD NUMBER ONE BY ACCIDENT

From the National League to the Continental League and on to the World stage, every tier puts tougher teams in your way. Each one has its own identity, its own stars and its own way of playing. Train your players, make the right decisions, learn from every loss and push past your limits. That's how you climb all the way to world number one.

store_data.about_the_game:
A DARK FANTASY TALE

Within the halls of the Velithian Empire's last bastion, King Nonzhei, driven by desperation and folly,attempted a calamitous ritual to obtain the power of magic. Pursuing this goal was sure to bring about ruin for all living things. 

Before the ritual was unleashed on the land, the four powerful Archfae contained that magic by sealing away the fortress, dooming its occupants and their mad King.

52 years later, a group readies itself to step into the arcane prison to retrieve a powerful artifact stolen by the bygone empire. Can they succeed and escape the halls of the fortress, and can they uncover its darkest secrets?

A DUNGEON CRAWLING ADVENTURE

Sealed Fortress is a dungeon-crawling, turn-based RPG in which you take a party of 3 through the treacherous halls of a castle corrupted by wild magic. 

  • Features handcrafted sprites, environments and CGs.

  • Exploration rewards the careful eye with secrets in a non-linear dungeon with interconnected areas.

  • Facing dangerous monsters, finding treasure and sharing soup together are all part of the adventure!

  • A low numbers, tense battle system that will make you use all the tools at your disposal.

  • Unlock abilities by equipping gear found in the dungeon and create your own load-outs.

  • Planning your strategies and managing your resources are key to survival.
