store_data.about_the_game:
Halloway is a small town with five places nobody dares to visit after dark.

You and up to three other fellow investigators have come to find out what happened there. The buildings have been abandoned. The lights are out. Something is still inside. And it doesn't want you there.

THE DARKNESS ISN'T SAFE


The Halloway Haunting is a first-person co-op horror game for 1–4 players.

Explore abandoned locations, search for clues, solve puzzles, and restore power one area at a time. Every light you bring back gives you somewhere safe to breathe. But the darkness is never far away.

The Wraith is hunting you. It can appear when you least expect it, and when the lights go out, nowhere feels safe.



STAY TOGETHER. OR SPLIT UP.


Play alone, with friends online, or with up to four players in local split-screen.

Working together makes some things easier. Splitting up lets you cover more ground, but it also means you might spend several minutes completely alone in the dark.

IF SOMEONE DIES, THEIR STUFF STAYS BEHIND


When a teammate dies, everything they were carrying is left behind where they died.

The key you need might be sitting on the other side of the room from the thing that just killed them. Someone has to decide whether it's worth going back.

Players who are caught can watch their surviving teammates through their cameras. But if everyone goes down, the investigation is over.

FIVE HAUNTED LOCATIONS


  • Halloway Police Station — Search the offices, bullpen, cell block, and basement before finding a way out through the woods.
  • St. Aldwyn's Hospital — An abandoned hospital evacuated in the middle of a shift. Bring its four wings back online and reach the rooftop before the Wraith finds you.
  • Meridian Bay Aquarium — The exhibits have been left to decay, and the only way out is through an underwater escape tunnel.
  • Halloway Fuel & Market — A deserted gas station on an empty highway. Restore the power, get the pumps running, and get out of there.
  • The Allen-Mercur House — An 1863 mansion haunted by a family's grief. Finish what they started and uncover what happened inside.

NO TWO INVESTIGATIONS ARE EXACTLY THE SAME


Important items, clues, and puzzle solutions change from one playthrough to the next.

The key might be in a different desk. The combination might change. The clues you find might lead you somewhere completely different.

You can't simply memorize the solution. You have to investigate.

UNCOVER THE TRUTH


There is more to the Halloway Haunting than what happened inside these five locations.

Keep your eyes open. Every location contains a hidden secret that reveals another piece of the story... and the horrifying truth behind the haunting.

Complete achievements to earn Challenge Points that unlock new character skins.

INVESTIGATE TOGETHER


  • 1–4 player online co-op
  • Up to 4-player local split-screen
  • Play solo or with friends
  • Five haunted locations to explore
  • Randomized items, clues, and puzzle solutions
  • Unlockable character skins and hidden secrets

store_data.about_the_game:
Fight armies across the ages.

Wargasbord: Battle Simulator is a large-scale single-player battle sandbox where armies from wildly different periods of history collide. Deploy infantry, cavalry, vehicles, artillery, and more, then watch autonomous units fight across terrain shaped by obstacles, fire, explosions, destruction, and the aftermath of battle.

Build ridiculous matchups, experiment with different forces, and see what happens when history gets thrown into a blender.

Work in progress: Wargasbord is still in active development, and the visuals shown are not final.

WWII Infantry vs. Roman Legionaries

Egyptian Archers vs. Swiss Pikemen

Confederate Soldiers vs. M1 Abrams Tanks

Fokker Triplanes vs. Viet Cong Soldiers

and more!

Features:

  • Armies and units from wildly different periods of history

  • Large autonomous battles with hundreds of units

  • Ridiculous cross-era matchups;

  • Fire, explosions, destruction, blood, remains, and battlefield scars

  • Sandbox deployment and experimentation

  • Infantry, cavalry, vehicles, artillery, drones, planes, and other unit types

  • Single-player battles and challenges.

COMING SOON!

store_data.about_the_game:
Policeman from the Future is an adventure game with quest elements set in various time periods. Mass unrest is raging across the globe. During one of these conflicts, a police officer goes missing. Waking up in the city center, the protagonist must unravel the events. Having almost unraveled the enemy's plot, the police officer is transported into a world where he must confront inexplicable phenomena.

What to expect from the game

- Dynamic third-person action

- Quests that, when solved, transport you to different dimensions

- Local residents who will tell you about their problems or give you clues

- Forceful problem-solving methods typical of government officials

- Battles in a modern city, arena, and labyrinths

Quarantine 16 is a casual multiplayer infection game where the goal is pretty simple — have fun and try not to get infected.

Games can support up to 16 players, with humans trying to survive while the infected hunt them down. But infection is only the beginning.

Quarantine 16 is built around different game modes and player-created maps, so every game doesn't have to feel the same.

Build a map. Make a crazy game mode. Jump into someone else's creation. Or just play a quick round with your friends.

🧟 Infection, But Not Always the Same

Play different types of games based around zombie infection. Fight, run, hide, survive, chase, or just try to be the last human standing.

🗺️ Create Your Own Maps

Use the map editor to build your own maps and come up with your own ideas. Make an arena, a maze, an obstacle course, a survival map, or something completely ridiculous.

Then let other players play it.

🎮 Just Jump In

Quarantine 16 is designed to be easy going and easy to play. No complicated learning curve. Get in a lobby, pick a game, and start playing.

👥 Up to 16 Players

Play with up to 16 players in the same game. Bring your friends along or join other players and see what kind of match you end up in.

🎨 Make Your Player Yours

Unlock different cosmetics and customize your character before jumping into a match.

Quarantine 16 is all about infection, custom maps, different ways to play, and having fun with others.

Pick a map. Start a game. Don't get infected.

store_data.about_the_game:
Roulette Strategy Research Lab is a single-player roulette strategy simulator built for experimentation, analysis, and hands-on play.

Play an American double-zero roulette table manually, construct your own betting strategies, and test how those strategies perform across individual sessions or repeated automated simulations. RSRL gives you the tools to move beyond guesswork and examine the actual behavior of a strategy over time.

BUILD YOUR OWN STRATEGIES

Create reusable strategies using BET, WAIT, and conditional IF/ELSE steps. Define what to wager, when to wait, and how the strategy should react after wins, losses, pushes, and specific wheel outcomes.

TEST AT YOUR OWN PACE

Play each spin manually with the animated roulette wheel, advance through a strategy one decision at a time, or use automated testing to evaluate repeated runs without waiting for animations.

ANALYZE THE RESULTS

Track bankroll changes, wins and losses, total amounts wagered and returned, drawdowns, outcome frequencies, and cumulative strategy performance. Compare results across repeated tests to see how a strategy behaves beyond a single lucky—or unlucky—session.

SAVE, REUSE, AND SHARE

Save strategies and session snapshots to your local library. Export strategy files for backup or sharing, then import them later for additional testing and refinement.

TWO SIMULATION MODES

Mode 1 uses independent, identically distributed roulette outcomes.

Mode 2 is an experimental sensitivity model that introduces small, temporary, unpredictable variations. It is designed to explore how a strategy responds when ideal assumptions are disturbed; it is not a claim about any specific dealer, casino, or physical wheel.

LEARN THE TABLE

Integrated guided tutorials introduce the interface, roulette wagers, strategy construction, testing controls, and performance tools. Adjustable interface text, mouse controls, and touchscreen play provide flexible ways to use the lab.

IMPORTANT RESPONSIBLE-USE NOTICE

Roulette Strategy Research Lab is a simulation and research tool intended solely for entertainment, education, and strategy testing. It does not accept or facilitate real-money wagers, award cash prizes, or connect to gambling services.

Roulette outcomes are random, no betting strategy can guarantee winnings or prevent losses, and simulated performance does not predict future casino results. If you choose to gamble with real money elsewhere, comply with all applicable laws and age requirements, gamble responsibly, and never wager money you cannot afford to lose.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hunt Without Leaving What You're Doing

HUNTKEEPER: Idle Trails is a compact idle hunting game whose adventure unfolds along the bottom of your screen. While you work, watch videos, or take care of something else, your hunter keeps following wild trails, tracking beasts, and bringing home rewards.

Every hunt earns you gold and loot. Use them to improve your weapons and equipment, unlock useful skills, and prepare for more dangerous territory. If a stage proves too difficult, return to earlier hunting grounds, build your strength, adjust your setup, and come back for another attempt.

Explore, Improve, and Keep Moving

  • Made for the edge of your desktop: Watch the adventure without giving up your whole screen, and step in whenever you want.

  • Discover distinct biomes: Travel through varied hunting grounds, encounter new animals, and face steadily rising challenges.

  • Build your hunter your way: Upgrade weapons, equipment, and skills to create the setup that works for you.

  • Face formidable prey: Challenge dangerous elite animals and imposing bosses.

  • Chase better rewards: Open chests, find rarer equipment, and make every upgrade feel meaningful.

  • Play at your own pace: Optimize every decision or simply let the hunt continue quietly at the bottom of your screen.

A Small Window for a Growing Journey

The heart of HUNTKEEPER: Idle Trails is watching your hunter grow stronger and finally overcome beasts that once seemed impossible. Choose meaningful upgrades, refine your setup, and conquer one wild trail after another—all from the edge of your desktop.

store_data.about_the_game:
You and your team of dwarves venture into the depths of the mines to mine ore, survive monsters, and meet your quota at any cost.

Crack ORES, load CRYSTALS into the cart, and return before the darkness takes you first. If you don't meet your quota... the big worm will have a reason to stay hungry.

Work together. Take risks together!

Your task is simple in theory:

find ore, mine it, load it into the cart, and escape alive.

Upon your return, the quota is met. The mined ore is sent to the huge worm, who devours it!

Crack, plant, and gather mushrooms!

Mushrooms can give you strength and boost your character. Some mushrooms can be deadly!

It seems... You're not alone in the cave. They might be looking at your back, or they might be looking straight into your eyes.

They could attack at any second, beware of them!

store_data.about_the_game:
THE HOLLOWED ARE COMING.

Death was supposed to be the end.

Instead, it became the beginning.

In Hollow Grounds, you are a bioengineered survivor whose life has been prolonged by an experimental treatment. But the world outside your home has fallen apart. Those who were once human have mutated into horrifying creatures known as the Hollowed.

And they're coming for you.

FIGHT. UPGRADE. SURVIVE.

Each wave brings new enemies, greater danger, and better rewards.

Defeat the Hollowed and use the money you earn to upgrade your armor and strengthen your home. The stronger you become, the further you can push your survival.

Upgrade your:

  • Helmet

  • Chestplate

  • Leggings

  • Boots

  • Home

But don't get comfortable. The Hollowed are always getting stronger.

UNLOCK THE UNKNOWN

Surviving longer means facing more than just stronger versions of the same enemy.

Progress through the game to unlock new types of Hollowed, each with their own abilities and challenges.

The deeper you go, the more dangerous the threats become.

And eventually, you'll have to face something much worse...

FIGHT THE BOSSES

Powerful bosses stand between you and the highest levels of progression.

Learn their attacks, survive their abilities, and bring them down for massive rewards.

Every boss is a test of how far you've pushed your build—and how well you can actually survive.

PROTECT YOUR HOME

Your home isn't just a place to hide.

It's the reason you can keep coming back.

As long as it stands, you survive.

Reinforce it, increase its health, and push it further than ever before. But once it falls, so does your protection.

REBIRTH

Eventually, survival won't be enough.

You'll have to start over.

Rebirth resets your progress, but gives you something far more valuable: power.

Return stronger. Reach higher tiers. Unlock more enemies. Take on tougher bosses.

Every rebirth pushes you further into the Hollow Grounds.

CLIMB THE LEADERBOARDS

How far can you really go?

Compete with other players and climb the leaderboards by pushing your survival, progression, and strength to the limit.

Beat your personal best.

Pass other players.

Reach the top.

How high can you climb?

HOW LONG CAN YOU SURVIVE?

Build your strength.

Upgrade your home.

Unlock new enemies.

Fight terrifying bosses.

Rebirth and grow stronger.

Climb the leaderboards.

And keep pushing further.

The Grounds are waiting.

store_data.about_the_game:
Trade. Fight. Rule the tides.

Tide & Crown is a single-player open-world pirate trading RPG where every voyage is a choice between profit, danger, and power.

Begin with a modest ship and a small purse. Study regional markets, carry goods between distant ports, take dangerous contracts, hunt valuable prizes, and build a fleet capable of changing the balance of power across the seas.

Trade in a Living Economy

Ports produce different goods and depend on merchant traffic to supply what they lack. Shortages raise prices, incoming shipments reshape local markets, and intercepted trade vessels can create opportunities for enormous profits.

Buy where goods are plentiful, sell where they are scarce, or create shortages through piracy and disruption.

Fight Tactical Naval Battles

Naval combat is turn-based and menu-driven. Choose the right ammunition for the target:

  • Round shot breaks heavily armored hulls.

  • Chain shot tears through fast, sail-dependent ships.

  • Grape shot devastates crew-heavy boarding vessels.

Brace against incoming fire, repair damaged systems, switch ships during fleet battles, attempt boarding actions, or flee before your losses become permanent.

Capture Ships and Build a Fleet[

Defeated lone vessels can be captured, stripped of cargo, or resolved through other prize choices. Expand from a starter sloop into a fleet of specialized ships, assign different roles, and recover disabled vessels after costly defeats.

Choose Your Career

Become a respected merchant captain, a feared pirate, or a political power with influence over ports and factions. Accept jobs, smuggle contraband, pursue captain objectives, negotiate with governors, and develop rivalries with recurring adversaries.

Your actions shape faction relationships, regional markets, available opportunities, and the legacy your captain leaves behind.

Survive the Open Sea

Navigate changing winds, manage crew and supplies, and travel through a day-and-night cycle. Dangerous waters conceal hostile captains, naval patrols, whirlpools, legendary ships, and creatures that are better discovered at sea than revealed on a map.

A Personal Pirate Sandbox

Tide & Crown was created from a love of classic trading games and pirate adventures such as Tradewinds and Sid Meier’s Pirates! It is designed to capture that same freedom—then expand it with a deeper economy, tactical fleet combat, evolving rivals, and meaningful career choices.

store_data.about_the_game:
Paracity is a character-driven, party-based heist RPG.

Select your crew of thieves and lead them through a heist in a mansion full of treasures, secrets, and dangers.

You are the master of a thieves’ guild… if you can get anyone to listen to you

Your crew is made up of procedurally generated characters with rich personalities, skills, and personal desires. As you move through the mansion, command each crew member, using their skills to your advantage. Some will fall in line. Some will argue. Every disruption brings risk of discovery. Think quickly to salvage the mission as your best laid plans encounter complications.

Management meets role-playing

As the leader of the guild, your own disposition will determine how your crew responds to you. Managing the actions of four characters will keep you busy. Each character can exercise autonomy: if you leave a crew member to their own devices they may make their own decisions, leaving you to deal with the repercussions.

Emergent story-telling

Your relationships change constantly depending on how you treat the people around you. As you work together, you may find a loyal follower, a friendly rival, or a bitter mutineer. Befriend a guard, blackmail a clergyman, deceive your competitor; the choice is yours… and theirs. Each character’s reactions and choices are procedurally generated based on their unique attributes, so no two stories are alike.

Collect fabulous riches and discover secrets. Forge relationships and overcome dissent. Watch your plans come together like clockwork, or fall apart.

store_data.about_the_game:
Cast your line into the depths.

Deep Fishing is a fishing adventure set around mysterious underground lakes.

The deeper you descend, the less your catches resemble ordinary fish.

Catch strange creatures, collect sealed treasure chests, and decide whether to push deeper for greater rewards or return to base with everything you've earned.

The deeper you go, the stranger it gets

Explore underground lakes, fungal waterways, and crystal-filled geothermal caverns.

Each layer has its own atmosphere, creatures, and dangers, with powerful bosses waiting at the deepest points.

You won't know what's inside a chest until you make it back

Successful catches can reward you with treasure chests of different rarities.

Their contents remain unknown until you safely return to base and open them.

Going deeper means more chances to bring home a huge haul, but failure will cost you part of what you've collected.

Do you return now and secure everything?

Or risk one more layer for a better reward?

Upgrade your fishing gear and descend even further

Use gold and the rewards you bring back to improve your ROD, REEL, and LINE.

Creatures that once pushed your equipment to its limits become more manageable as you grow stronger.

Fish. Return. Grow stronger. Go deeper.

Follow the traces of your missing brother

One reason the protagonist continues descending is the disappearance of his older brother.

Strange clues and increasingly unnatural phenomena await below.

Something unknown lies deep beneath the underground lakes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Solar Imperium is a real-time grand strategy game where the planets are not menus.

Every world you settle is a full globe of hexes, with ore veins, geothermal vents, ice caps, craters and rivers, and every hex is ground you can build on. Lay out mines, refineries and power plants tile by tile, and watch roads form along the routes your cargo actually travels. Then pull the camera back to the star system, and back again to the galaxy, where that colony is one holding in an empire.

It starts much smaller. A Heiron Foundation colony ship came down damaged on a dry world beneath an unknown sun. The survivors have a broken hull and whatever they can dig out of the ground. The galaxy they have fallen into is already occupied, by four powers that were old long before humanity arrived. You are the smallest, newest and weakest power in it.

Build Every World, Hex by Hex

A colony is a place, not a list. Where you put a building decides what stands beside it, and neighbours matter. Power runs on pylons strung back to the capital, and cargo wears its own roads into the ground. A crowded world runs out of clear ground before it runs out of ore, and an Arcology, the first structure to cover several hexes, is how it keeps growing. Survey a world from orbit, send an away party to the surface, and read the terrain before you commit a Colony Ship to it.

An Economy That Runs Out

Iron, Silicon and Sulfur come out of the ground, and they do not come back. Refine them into Alloy, Fuel, Bio-Packs and Consumer Goods, and push on to Core-Crystals and Exotic Isotopes. Give each world a colonial charter, from Mining World to Forge World to Research Enclave, and connect them with trade routes you set in units per minute. When the deposits finally run dry, the empire has to change how it lives, not just where it digs.

Govern Through People

You cannot run every world yourself, and delegating has a cost. Appoint governors to your star systems. Each has a trait that shapes their choices and a salary paid in Influence, and each can be kept as an adviser, given a managed mandate or handed full autonomy. Behind them sits the Council of Houses, four founding institutions with their own agendas, voting on the motions that steer the empire.

Join an Old Galaxy

Every system has a name before you find it. Send Science Ships to scan distant worlds, meet independent enclaves, and open relations with the Veyrun Compact, the Obsidian Hegemony, the Thessic Reclamation and the Korrin Ascendancy. Build trust through embassies and treaties, make rivals, or bring smaller powers under your protection as subjects.

Rivals Who Play Fair

The AI never cheats, at any difficulty. Rival empires pay the same costs, build on real hexes on their own worlds, fuel their own fleets and run out of the same resources you do. Harder difficulties make them more ambitious and more aggressive, not richer.

War, and What Comes After

Press claims, find a justification for war, and choose what you are fighting for, from humiliation to total conquest. Fleets need fuel, supply and dock time for repairs, and pirates prey on exposed trade. Late in a campaign, warships of unknown origin begin to arrive, and they keep coming until someone breaks them. Win by dominion, ascendancy, prosperity or endurance.

Features

  • Every planet and moon you settle is a full hex-tiled globe you can build across.
  • Zoom from the grand strategic map into the worlds and systems that make up your empire.
  • Real-time with pause, at speeds from half to four times normal.
  • A three-tier production chain with finite deposits that run dry.
  • Governors, colonial charters and a Council of Houses to delegate and govern through.
  • Diplomacy with treaties, embassies, rivalries and subject empires.
  • Fleets, war goals, pirates and a late-campaign crisis.
  • AI rivals that play by exactly the same rules as you.
  • Four Houses to lead, up to four rival powers, five galaxy sizes from 8 to 50 star systems, and four difficulty tiers.
  • Four ways to win.

store_data.about_the_game:
The road west is a decision you make forty times


You lead a merchant House out of Ötüken, seat of the Göktürk khaganate, in the
seventh century. Iron and felt go west. Silk, turquoise and Khotan jade come
back — if the caravan does.

Every kilo you load is a kilo of something else you left behind. Gold dust is
worth nine hundred a kilo and tallow is worth twelve, and the animals do not
care which one they are carrying. That single trade-off is the whole game, and
it never stops being interesting, because the market at the far end has an
opinion of its own.

Two ways on, and you take one


At every stage the road forks. A short leg through bandit country, or two days
more along the river. Water you can carry, or water you have to find. What is
on the button is what you get: the distance, the days, whose ground it is, and
whether you have walked it before.

Two hundred encounters wait on those roads, and they are not riddles with right
answers. A flooded ford, a Tang commissioner with a book, a shaman who wants
iron for his coat, a blind singer who knows four hundred lines of the Kagan's
ancestry and will trade all of them for a place at the fire. Each answer costs
something different — days, silver, goods, or what the men think of you.

Paying is quickest. The road remembers that you pay.


When riders come over the ridge you can buy your way out, and it works. It

later, and you can see it coming if you are paying attention.

Your caravan master has a name, a clan and a childhood — a smith's son packs a

its plots, and it keeps the roll of every master who ever went out for it and
what became of him. A journey can end badly without the run ending with it.

Every city has Houses in it already, holding most of what is worth holding.

word offering to buy you out. Come home from a long road and the map has
changed without you.

Three games, played the way they were actually played. Aşık oyunu —
knock the knucklebones out of the scratched circle with a lead-weighted throw.
Üç Taş and Dokuz Taş — three stones and nine, on lines drawn in
the dust, against somebody who is genuinely trying to beat you.

Play for silver or for a share of the load. The yard shuts for days afterwards,
and a master known at every circle on the road gets back in sooner.

  • 12 cities with living markets — glut one and the price stays down for
    weeks
  • Three historical minigames with an opponent that searches rather than
    bluffs
  • A House that persists: base, staff, plots, banner, and a roll of the
    dead
  • Six-language interface: English, German, Turkish, French, Japanese,
    Simplified Chinese

Made to be played on the couch


Native 1280×800, full controller navigation, remappable keys, text scaling from
85% to 150%, and a colour-blind-safe palette — because telling a profit from a
loss should not depend on telling green from red.

Nothing here is invented


The goods moved on this road. The cities are where they were. The games are the
games. The wolf on the banner, the stone men beside the track, the ovoo you
leave silver on — all of it is the seventh century, and none of it is decoration.

The road west is a decision you make forty times


You lead a merchant House out of Ötüken, seat of the Göktürk khaganate, in the
seventh century. Iron and felt go west. Silk, turquoise and Khotan jade come
back — if the caravan does.

Every kilo you load is a kilo of something else you left behind. Gold dust is
worth nine hundred a kilo and tallow is worth twelve, and the animals do not
care which one they are carrying. That single trade-off is the whole game, and
it never stops being interesting, because the market at the far end has an
opinion of its own.

whether you have walked it before.

answers. A flooded ford, a Tang commissioner with a book, a shaman who wants
iron for his coat, a blind singer who knows four hundred lines of the Kagan's
ancestry and will trade all of them for a place at the fire. Each answer costs

store_data.about_the_game:
You have only a single skeletal left hand and perfect pitch. Can you rebuild the soundscape of the entire human world?

Silence reigns in the Forgotten Archive. Once, every whisper, every chord, and every crunch of snow from the human world was preserved here. But one failed magical experiment by the Keeper sent the grand collection shattering into hundreds of sealed jars. Now they lie scattered across the floor, while the Keeper himself has been reduced to a bodiless shadow.

He offers a deal: restore order to his archive, and he will return your second hand. For now — learn to master your craft with your one remaining bony hand.

Hearing is your primary tool

You cannot guess an item by its appearance. Forget about identical models and repeating textures — only your hearing will reveal what is sealed inside.

  • What is that? The gentle whisper of the wind or the soft splash of water?

  • The sound of rain is hard to mistake for the crackle of a campfire, but can you tell the rustle of old paper from the crunch of autumn leaves underfoot by ear alone?

  • The clink of coins, a boiling kettle, the hum of electricity, or the distant sigh of the breeze — every sound exists as a single unique copy and never repeats.

No magic or auto-sorting. Pure honest work

There are no spells here to magically draw items to the shelves. You will have to pick up every single jar, listen to it, and carry it to its proper place yourself. Upgrade your speed and agility to cross the Archive's vast halls faster, but finding the rightful home for every sound is entirely up to you.

Features

  • 🎧 100% Audio Logic: A game where your ears matter far more than your eyes.

  • 🏺 Zero Repeats: Every sound in the collection is unique. No grinding identical items.

  • 🦴 Logical Narrative: Earn back your second hand by restoring order to the mysterious vault.

  • 🎻 Dozens of Categories: From elemental sounds and ancient machinery to refined classical music and futuristic Sci-Fi.

  • 🧘 Meditative Challenge: No rush, just full immersion in your own perception.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the best Halloween party in town — where one of the guests isn't wearing a costume.

Twelve women come to a gothic mansion every Halloween , each dressed as a monster: a vampire, a witch, a werewolf, a ghost… One of them is the real thing, hiding in plain sight, and you have until dawn to work out which — before you miss your one chance to take a genuine monster-girl to bed.

You play the lone male (someone must have given the others some bad directions...) in this blend of social deduction, investigation, and adult visual novel. Work the room at party games to gather rumors about everyone at the table.

Heard a girl carries an unnatural chill? Slip off with her alone and find out if she warms up when her blood gets pumping. You'll stop at nothing to find the supernatural hottie of your dreams!

But every private moment drains the party's momentum... you'll have to keep everyone entertained or your target could slip away early. Pry too hard and the girls close ranks; neglect the party and it dies around you. Read the room and spend your nerve where it counts!

Twelve unique monster-girls, a ticking clock, and a different target every Halloween!

Key Features:

  • 🎃 Social deduction over one Halloween night — find the one real monster-girl among twelve costumed guests

  • 🦇 Sort the Genuine-from the performative

  • 🕯️ Party games for cheap, broad rumors — or get a girl alone to confirm the truth one-on-one

  • 💋 Momentum & Trust resource management: keep the party alive and her friends onside, or get locked out

  • 🔮 A fresh culprit every run — seeded and fully replayable

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a realistic FPV freestyle drone simulator built for real‑world quadcopter pilots. Experience authentic flight behavior, soar across diverse open‑world environments, and practice rolls, yaw flips, dives and other freestyle maneuvers to sharpen your piloting skill within a safe virtual space.

Fully customizable drone and camera systems let you tweak power output, total weight, inertia damping, camera angle, FOV and many other settings to replicate the exact feel of your real‑life quad. Four large‑scale hand‑crafted maps are available for free‑flight training, with buildings, trees and obstacles designed for freestyle trick practice.

Whether you are a beginner getting familiar with stick inputs or an experienced pilot maintaining muscle memory, this simulator serves as your daily training tool. Optimized for mainstream PC hardware, it delivers smooth, low‑latency flight performance on regular consumer computers.

Now in Early Access. We will keep adding more maps, physics profiles and new features, refining flight behavior and overall experience based on community feedback.

store_data.about_the_game:
Remember the days of button phones, burned CDs, computer clubs, the old internet, and endless evenings in front of a CRT monitor?

MEMOLOGY: THE 2000's takes you back to that era and puts your memory to the test.

You’ll face questions about all kinds of things from the 2000s: games, internet culture, music, movies, technology, memes, everyday objects, and events that once felt like a normal part of life.

Every question is more than just a test of memory. After answering, you can read a short story or interesting fact related to what you’ve just remembered.

WHAT TO EXPECT:

  • Questions about 2000s culture and everyday life

  • Images and visual questions

  • Four answer choices

  • A short story or fact after each question

  • A final score at the end of each run

  • Achievements for correct answers and final results

This is not a history exam.

It’s a chance to remember a time when the internet was slower, phones were smaller, CDs still mattered, and half the things around us today already feel like artifacts from another era.

How much of it do you still remember?

store_data.about_the_game:
You start with nothing.
No tools, no fire, nowhere to go. If you cannot make an axe and light a fire before the first sunset, the dark will not wait for you.

A day runs day → dusk → night.
When the sun tilts, the world goes quiet first — animals go home and the screen dims. That is your signal to run back. Without fire at night, you last only seconds.

Seasons change the pressure.
Spring soaks you, summer spreads wildfire, autumn brings the invasion, winter buries you in snow. On the last nights of a season a legendary boss comes — Gaiadon, Noehwang, GreenKing, Pyro.

There is a world under the ground and across the sea.
Dig down with a pickaxe into a cave that is always dark: three times the silver ore, and mushrooms. Lash a raft and sail to outer islands you can never reach on foot, and to tuna in the deep.

76 monsters, 4 seasons, 19 buildings.
The map shows only where you have walked. What you build and where you settle is entirely yours.

And at the end, a name.
Survive 28 days and three invasions, and Gael becomes the ruler of this plain. That name carries into another story.

store_data.about_the_game:
TWO ROPES

Left hand and right hand, fired independently. Hold both and you are on a

pendulum; drop one and you are on an arc; drop the other and you are falling.

Reeling is a zip rather than a nudge, so the line pulls you straight to what

you hooked. Everything else in the game sits on top of that.

ONE AXE, AND THE HEART

A clean cut on the heart kills anything, whatever its size. The window is

small and the difficulty lives in reaching it, not in surviving long enough to

grind something down. Miss the heart and you land a body blow worth a third of

the creature; hacking works and takes three times as long.

BLESSINGS

More than sixty of them, drafted two at a time as a match runs. Every one is a

trade. Lose the ability to reel in and carry double the tank. Throw your shield

like a frisbee and give up the bubble that was keeping you alive. Shrink to a

third of your size and become genuinely hard to hit, including by the aim

assist. Nothing here is a permanent upgrade; the run ends and so does the

blessing.

THE MODES

Holmgang · one against one, first to five rounds, no shelter

Warbands · four a side, Aesir against Jotnar, five minutes

Gjallarhorn · carry the horn and score while you hold it. Everyone in the hall comes for you

The Hunt · up to four, holding a ward against endless waves

Bosses · Jormungandr under the frozen mere, and Fenrir on Lyngvi

Fridr · Alfheim, with nothing hunting you. Eighteen rings and a long way down

SEVEN REALMS

A black forest in Vanaheim. The inside of a mountain in Muspelheim. The rainbow

bridge over the void in Asgard, with the island and Odin's seat at the end of

it. A frozen mere in Niflheim. The bound wolf on Lyngvi. The holm in Midgard.

The long light of Alfheim, where nothing wants anything from you.

WHAT YOU EARN

Titles, ropes, winds, cloaks and crests. Twenty-four titles and forty-one

cosmetics, and not one of them makes you stronger. The rule has held since the

first line of the progression system: rewards are what you wear, never what you

hit with.

HONESTLY

This is my first game made from start to finish as a solo dev. I hope it's worth your time, but if reviews and feedback call for it, I'll continue putting time into the project to make it a game you want to play!

store_data.about_the_game:
Two Worlds. Two Heroes. One Goal.

Lionheart: The Spirit Within is an atmospheric 2.5D metroidvania about a boy trying to rescue his parents by traveling through two interconnected worlds.

Switch between the real world, where you play as a vulnerable boy, and the spirit world, where you become a powerful lion.

The same locations exist in both worlds, but they can look, feel, and play completely differently. Paths, enemies, obstacles and opportunities change depending on which world you are in.

Survive in the Real World

The boy cannot fight his enemies directly. Hide, avoid danger, use stealth, interact with the environment and find another way forward.

The abandoned hospital is only the beginning. The full journey will take you through different locations in the real world, each with its own reflection in the spirit world.

Fight in the Spirit World

As the lion, face corrupted creatures using powerful movement abilities and close-range combat.

Defeating an enemy is not always the end. Cleanse corrupted spirits and save the souls trapped within them.

Solve Puzzles Across Two Worlds

Many obstacles cannot be solved from only one side.

Switch between the boy and the lion, study both versions of the environment and use the differences between the real and spirit worlds to find the solution.

Actions and discoveries in one world can help you progress through the other.

Two Heroes, Two Ways to Play

The boy relies on stealth, intelligence and interaction with the environment.

The lion relies on combat, mobility and supernatural abilities.

Progress requires learning how to use both of them together.

Save Your Parents

The boy's journey begins with one goal: find and rescue his parents.

Their fate is connected to the spirit world and the forces hidden within it. As the journey continues, the boy will discover what happened to them, why they were taken, and what his connection to the lion truly means.

Explore Two Versions of One World

Travel through different real-world locations and discover their transformed counterparts in the spirit world.

Every new place reveals another part of the mystery and new ways in which the two worlds interact.

Welcome to Corporate Corp Incorporated, where your future starts here. Unfortunately.

Corporate Corp Incorporated is a satirical first-person workplace survival RPG/life sim about making it through the workday inside a cheerful corporate machine that would like to remind you that every person counts — especially toward the metrics.

Start each day in the Orientation Corridor, find your assigned workstation, log into QueueFlow, handle calls, manage stress, earn money, upgrade your desk, and chase promotions one absurd title at a time.

Every shift is a balancing act between productivity and self-preservation. Work too much and stress climbs. Take too many breaks and the company may start noticing. Somewhere between call queues, suspicious wellness programs, fake corporate software, and motivational posters, you might even become employee material.

Features planned for Corporate Corp Incorporated include:

- Survive daily shifts inside a satirical corporate office

- Handle call queues, workplace tasks, and fake enterprise software

- Manage stress, money, time, and career progress

- Upgrade your desk with questionable productivity purchases

- Take office-approved breaks, including arcade distractions and wellness activities

- Discover not-quite-approved recovery activities hidden inside the office.

- Play Email Invaders, an in-office arcade game where incoming emails become the enemy

- Meet Quippy™, CCI’s helpful desktop assistant, who is definitely here to improve your experience

- Earn promotions, update your title, and collect increasingly absurd workplace status symbols

- Explore a corporate environment full of cheerful messaging, suspicious systems, and professionally documented nonsense

Corporate Corp Incorporated is currently in development for PC.

Welcome to Corporate Corp Incorporated, where your future starts here. Unfortunately.

Corporate Corp Incorporated is a satirical first-person workplace survival RPG/life sim about making it through the workday inside a cheerful corporate machine that would like to remind you that every person counts — especially toward the metrics.

Start each day in the Orientation Corridor, find your assigned workstation, log into QueueFlow, handle calls, manage stress, earn money, upgrade your desk, and chase promotions one absurd title at a time.

Every shift is a balancing act between productivity and self-preservation. Work too much and stress climbs. Take too many breaks and the company may start noticing. Somewhere between call queues, suspicious wellness programs, fake corporate software, and motivational posters, you might even become employee material.

Features planned for Corporate Corp Incorporated include:

- Survive daily shifts inside a satirical corporate office

- Handle call queues, workplace tasks, and fake enterprise software

- Manage stress, money, time, and career progress

- Upgrade your desk with questionable productivity purchases

- Take office-approved breaks, including arcade distractions and wellness activities

- Discover not-quite-approved recovery activities hidden inside the office.

- Play Email Invaders, an in-office arcade game where incoming emails become the enemy

- Meet Quippy™, CCI’s helpful desktop assistant, who is definitely here to improve your experience

- Earn promotions, update your title, and collect increasingly absurd workplace status symbols

- Explore a corporate environment full of cheerful messaging, suspicious systems, and professionally documented nonsense

Corporate Corp Incorporated is currently in development for PC.
store_data.short_description: Survive the workday in a satirical first-person workplace life sim. Handle call queues, manage stress, take suspiciously necessary breaks, upgrade your desk, endure fake corporate software, and climb the ladder one absurd title at a time.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Narrator is a point-and-click comedy exploration game where curiosity is the entire point.

Explore your surroundings. Click things that look interesting. Click things that don't look interesting. Poke around where you probably shouldn't. The Narrator is paying attention to what you do, and unfortunately for him, you're the one holding the mouse.

He'll react to your choices, remember your behaviour and have plenty to say about the way you decide to play.

There are things to discover, secrets to uncover, and absolutely no reason whatsoever to respect the personal belongings of a man who specifically asked you not to touch them.

BE CURIOUS.

The more you investigate, the more you'll find.

The Narrator may object.

Ignore him.

WHAT TO EXPECT

  • A fully voiced, fourth-wall-breaking Narrator

  • Different reactions depending on what you choose to do

  • Hidden interactions, secrets and ridiculous things to discover

  • A Narrator who remembers your behaviour

  • No combat. No grinding. Just you, a mouse, and a man increasingly concerned about your decisions.

A message from The Narrator:

"I haven't approved any of this."

store_data.about_the_game:
NIGHTMARE HORROR INVESTIGATION

You are sent by the government to investigate a series of strange and unexplained events. What begins as a simple investigation quickly turns into a fight for survival.

Explore abandoned and dangerous locations, uncover scattered notes, investigate the traces left behind by those who came before you, and try to understand what is really happening.

Not everyone you encounter will survive.

Investigate the Unknown

Explore 11 different locations, each with its own atmosphere, dangers, secrets, and events to discover.

Throughout your investigation, you will find notes left behind by people who were there before you. Reading them can reveal important information about what happened and help you piece together the mystery surrounding the events.

Some people are still alive when you arrive. Others are already gone.

And sometimes, what you witness may be far more disturbing than what you find written on a piece of paper.

Explore, Investigate, Survive

Search your surroundings for useful items, keys, ammunition, money, and other resources.

Keys can unlock new areas and allow you to continue exploring deeper into the investigation.

Your resources are limited, so every decision matters. Ammunition, weapons, and medical supplies can make the difference between surviving an encounter and becoming another victim.

Manage Your Resources

Money can be used at shops to purchase essential supplies such as:

  • Ammunition

  • Medical kits

Choose how you use your resources and prepare yourself for what lies ahead.

There are only four weapons available throughout the entire game, making ammunition management an important part of survival.

Different Enemies, Different Threats

You will encounter several types of enemies throughout your investigation.

Some enemies possess unique attacks and abilities, while others present different challenges that require you to adapt to the situation.

Not every combat encounter is the same. Some events involve more than just you and your enemies, creating unpredictable situations where survival depends on what happens around you.

A Dark and Unpredictable Journey

The investigation takes you through environments filled with darkness, rain, thunderstorms, strange events, abandoned locations, and the remains of people who were unable to escape.

There are moments of danger, moments of mystery, and moments where you may question what you are actually seeing.

Some events may even take place in strange dreamlike or nightmare-like situations.

Atmosphere

The game features atmospheric music designed specifically for different situations and locations.

Rain, thunder, environmental sounds, distant events, and carefully placed music help create an unsettling atmosphere as you progress through the investigation.

There are also a small number of sudden scares waiting for you along the way.

Not Everything Is What It Seems

As you investigate, you may encounter situations that don't fit what you expect from a horror investigation.

Some moments are disturbing.

Some are mysterious.

And, on rare occasions, things can become strangely absurd.

Key Features

  • 11 different locations to explore

  • Government investigation storyline

  • Survival horror experience

  • Exploration and investigation

  • Notes and environmental clues

  • Multiple types of enemies

  • Enemies with unique attacks and abilities

  • Four weapons

  • Ammunition management

  • Money and supply management

  • Shops for ammunition and medical supplies

  • Keys and locked areas to discover

  • Combat events with different situations

  • Survivors and story encounters

  • Nightmare and dreamlike sequences

  • Rain, thunderstorms, and atmospheric environments

  • Original atmospheric music

  • Scene-based saving system

  • Dark humor hidden within the horror

  • English voice acting

  • Spanish subtitles available

How Far Will You Go to Uncover the Truth?

The investigation begins with a simple objective: find out what happened.

But the deeper you go, the more questions appear.

Follow the clues.
Read what was left behind.
Manage your resources.
Survive the encounters.
And uncover the truth behind the nightmare.

Your investigation has only just begun.

store_data.about_the_game:
A WEIRD LITTLE TOWN. A CURSED MOON. SETTLE IT AT THE HOOP.

You are a kid with your dad's old basketball. The pigeons want a game. The local gym wants proof. The moon has plans. Unfortunately, you are in them.

JUMPSHOT is a pixel-art story RPG where turn-based battles are basketball shootouts. Explore Mochidama and the strange roads beyond it, meet oddball locals, and take on rivals who have absolutely no business holding a basketball.

PICK YOUR SHOT. FIND YOUR MOMENT.

Choose a layup, midrange jumper or downtown three, then stop the shot meter. Green scores. The tiny gold line is a SWISH. Longer shots bring bigger rewards and tighter timing.

When your opponent shoots, time your block and send it back. Defend, grab a snack or risk one more shot as your HYPE ticks down.

EARN YOUR CLOUT.

Win battles, level up, find gear and stock up on snacks. Take on roaming challengers and story rivals, explore peculiar places and get tangled in the moon's increasingly questionable schemes. Lose and Mum carries you home. Very supportive. Very embarrassing.

WELCOME TO MOCHIDAMA.

  • Turn-based hoop battles with hands-on shot and block timing.
  • A story full of strange locals, rival ballers and a moon in a headband.
  • Exploration, quests, equipment, snacks and character progression.
  • Chunky pixel art, retro text boxes and a synth soundtrack.
  • A single-player adventure controlled with mouse and keyboard.

The classic game, reshuffled. Infinite Chess keeps everything you love about chess and throws the rulebook into a randomizer. No two games are the same: every board is randomly generated with blocked terrain, surprise castle extensions, and new pieces hiding in the wings.

A board that's different every time Choose Small (8×8 / 10×8) or Medium (10×10 / 10×12 + castle wings). Blocked spaces force new lines of attack. Claim neutral pawns on the extensions to summon a Dragon (queen + knight) or Catapult (ranged siege piece).

Chess rules, remixed

Pawns move sideways

kings move up to two squares

Sacrifice a pawn next to a knight to unlock extended jumps

you can promote knight, bishop and rook

An AI worth your time Three difficulty levels, from a gentle beginner to a deep minimax thinker. The AI evaluates material, piece safety, king protection, and the race for neutral pawns, so every difficulty plays smart, not random.

For humans, too Pass-and-play 2-player mode on one screen, full undo, check/checkmate/stalemate and draw detection (50-move rule, repetition, insufficient material), random starting color with an auto-flipping board.

Every game is a new puzzle. Every game is different.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tidy Up the Bookstore is a cozy, relaxing organization‑simulation game.

Step inside a once‑beloved large‑scale bookstore, now fallen into complete disarray. Books have been knocked from their shelves, stacks lie scattered across counters, and every corner is filled with out‑of‑place volumes. Your job is to bring peace and order back to this forgotten shop.

Take your time to sort, position and arrange every book onto its proper shelf. Wander between countless bookcases, locate misplaced titles, and carefully place each one in its correct spot. There are no timers, no stressful objectives and no rushing against the clock.

Immerse yourself in a calm, quiet atmosphere as you work. Watch the bookstore slowly transform from chaos into a neat, welcoming space. Enjoy the deeply satisfying, therapeutic reward of seeing every shelf perfectly organized, one book at a time.

store_data.about_the_game:
Inspired by I Didn't Cheat.

Text Her Back


The bell has rung, and of course this is when your girlfriend starts sending message after message. If you don't want her to get seriously mad, you'll have to hide your phone under the desk and text her back. Just don't let the teacher catch you.

Watch the Teacher


Look around the classroom. Use the teacher's footsteps and voice to figure out where they are. When they're far enough away, look down, type the prompted letters, and send your reply. When they get close, put the phone away immediately and look up like you've been paying attention the whole time.

Expect the Unexpected


Of course, it won't be that easy. A video might suddenly play out loud. A private message might go to the class group chat. You might even fart at the worst possible moment. Sometimes the lecture stops without warning, and the teacher appears somewhere they absolutely should not be.

Teachers may also walk over to check your desk and the cubby underneath. Quickly slide your phone into your sleeve before they inspect it, then try to look innocent.

Can you keep your girlfriend happy, look like the most attentive student in the room, and survive all four classes?

Four Classes to Survive


1. Four increasingly difficult classes
2. Strange phenomena
3. Embarrassing incidents
4. Normal and Extreme modes with lesson-specific time limits

The video shows only the first lesson. As you progress through the levels, the challenge gets much tougher, and even more unexpected events await. Take on the challenge!

store_data.about_the_game:
A District Where Touch Has Become Dangerous


Ombera District is locked down. White response tents cover the old football pitch, movement is restricted on the roads, and fear has left Dr. Odilon Mabeki's eighty-six-bed hospital nearly empty even as people remain sick at home.

As the district's medical officer, Odilon fights to keep ordinary emergencies from disappearing behind the outbreak response. He also insists that families deserve the truth in person, with every patient's full name spoken aloud. Then three women collide with his fragile routine, each carrying her own history, grief, and claim on Ombera's future.

Choose one of three romance routes and decide which relationship Odilon will risk his reputation, duty, and heart to pursue.

Meet the Cast




Tembi Wandi — Widow's Confidant

Tembi is a survivor turned carer, permitted to hold sick children with bare hands when others cannot. Her husband died in Odilon's hospital during the earliest, mistaken days of the crisis. She refuses to blame him, but their shared past returns in public, forcing both of them to confront what happened.



Rokia Diambe — Forbidden by Faction

Rokia owns Radio Ombera and speaks each morning to listeners across the district. Her brother entered the treatment centre and came home in a sealed bag, and she now warns that the centre takes people without returning them. Odilon is the local face of the response; pursuing Rokia means crossing a public divide with consequences on and off the air.



Ilse Rademaker — Hostile Reunion

Ilse is the field coordinator who outranks Odilon inside his own hospital. Years ago, one accurate line in her report changed the direction of his career. Now she has returned with authority over the response and a departure already scheduled, reopening a history neither of them has named.

Key Features


  • Choose one of three distinct romance routes: Hostile Reunion, Widow's Confidant, or Forbidden by Faction.
  • Follow a decisive branch into a complete character-specific romantic arc and ending.
  • Navigate hospital corridors, treatment-centre fences, radio studios, district roads, and public meetings during a health crisis.
  • Confront medical duty, movement restrictions, public distrust, grief, and the politics of physical contact.
  • Each romance route includes three explicit adult scenes, for nine explicit adult scenes in total.

store_data.about_the_game:
You bought a working mine. The previous owner disappeared.

Jharkhand, 2003. You inherited a quarry, a processing plant, a yard, an office, and a set of books that insist everything is perfectly legal. An elephant is still standing at the eastern gate. It is not on the payroll.

MARGIN: Raj Minerals[/b] is a dark management game about production, trading, and the people who come to your window asking for money. By day, you build a mining company. At night, you read the notes of the man who owned it before you.

Build a company that does not choke

Every deposit is its own production line: workers, extraction, processing, and loading. Strengthen the bottleneck, extend the yard, and watch equipment wear. A full yard stops the mine while the bills keep coming.

Trade ore, not an abstract multiplier

You set the actual price of every lot. Cheap goods clear quickly. An ambitious ask turns the yard into a graveyard for working capital. Small sales disappear into the world market, but corporate stockpiles and multi-tonne trades move it: withhold supply, create a shortage, or dump the price alongside simulated competitors.

The cash in the till is not entirely yours

Payroll, maintenance, duties, tax, and loan payments are fixed on their calculation day and placed on a dated calendar. Decide what to settle, what to turn into debt, and how much productivity you are willing to lose for a prettier cash balance.

Every decision has a face

Workers, guards, tax officers, suppliers, and men with no official title arrive in person. Their conversations follow the state of the company and your earlier decisions. Pay, refuse, negotiate, or put the money on one of the suspicious games played at the counter. The humour is black; the consequences are not decorative.

The company follows you home

After work, spend your earnings on personal comforts and examine the former owner's notebook. Night logs, fire reports, and old manifests gradually explain what was uncovered beneath the mine—and why the red eyes on the camera keep getting closer.

  • Six deposits across India, each with an independent production line

  • A volume-based market with simulated competitors and large-trade impact

  • Dated bills, debt, payroll, tax, loans, and currency exchange

  • Recurring visitors, connected conversations, consequences, and office minigames

  • A separate after-hours phase, more than thirty personal purchases, and a supernatural investigation

  • An early-2000s corporate website interface with deliberately rough digital art

A satire about a company that accounts for everything except the cost of a human decision.

store_data.about_the_game:
About the Game

Jewelry Keeper is a cozy first-person organizing simulator set in an elegant jeweler's shop. The month's delivery has been scattered across the floor, and 3,100 rings, watches, necklaces, earrings and more must be placed in their exact marked spots before the doors open.

Every box identifies what is inside, and every display tray carries matching numbered places. Open the stock, read the label, find its showcase and turn a beautiful shop full of chaos into perfect order.

Gameplay

Pick boxes up by the armful, open them in your hand and carry each piece to its correct place. The shop itself is your guide: lettered showcases, engraved category plates, numbered trays and two detailed floor plans help you find where everything belongs.

This shop is organized by number. Thirty rings are thirty different rings, and each one fits exactly one marked place. Complete a tray to earn a skill point and make the rest of the job more efficient.

Make the Shop Your Own

In Cozy mode, work without a clock and unlock ten helpful abilities, including longer sprints, target hints, spotting matches, auto-place, batch grab, quick order and magnet. There is no fail state: nothing breaks, nothing is lost and nothing chases you.

Prefer a challenge? Hardcore mode removes the help, starts the clock on your first step and records your finishing time on a Steam leaderboard.

Features

  • Sort 3,100 pieces of jewelry across one hand-built shop

  • Match every item to one of 3,100 numbered places across 116 display trays

  • Organize ten categories, including rings, watches, necklaces, earrings and bracelets

  • Unlock and improve ten efficiency skills in relaxed Cozy mode

  • Race the clock in Hardcore mode and compete for a faster finishing time

  • Save your progress and return to the same morning whenever you like

  • Steam Achievements, leaderboards and Cloud saves

  • Full controller support plus rebindable keyboard and mouse controls

store_data.about_the_game:
"Downhill Drift" is a racing game that challenges you on an infinite variety of tracks. It offers four track environments, each capable of generating up to four billion unique courses. You can race with four differently tuned cars to take on the challenge. Your goal is simple: drift at the widest possible angles and reach the finish line as fast as you can to earn the highest drift score. Alternatively, switch to Time Attack mode for a pure race against the clock. But be warned—any collision with the walls comes with a severe penatly. Keep in mind, this is no casual game!

Every track you complete will save your ghost car, so you can challenge your own records anytime, or upload the tracks you've discovered—along with your best times—to the Steam Workshop for other players to take on.

We recommend putting on your own driving music for the best experience.

With luck you may perform some fancy moves! (Maybe not luck?)

“Downhill Drift” provides 4 track themes: Sakura Pass, Autumn Rally, Coast Highway and City Expressway. (Sakura Pass is supposed to be the hardest track).

There are also 4 cars with unique handcrafted tunes.

Car No.1: White Tofu. Quick and smooth turning and drifting, but with low engine power.

Car No.2: White Falcon. More engine power but turning is not that quick.

Car No.3: Yellow Hornet. Slightly different tune from the White Falcon in engine power, grip and turning speed.

Car No.4: Black Bear. Born for speed and grip, hard to drift.

One More Thing! There is a Playground map for you to do anything with your car! Burnouts, Donuts, knock over some cones!

There are 2 modes for each theme, Drift Score and Time Attack. Just remember you never want to touch the wall, you will get huge penatly. For both modes you need to go FAST, and SIDEWAYS in drift mode.

If you like any track and want to go for a higher records, you just need to finish it once, it will be permanently saved in your Library, you can Challenge it again anytime. Even better, you will be able to drive with your ghost car, making it easier to find a better corning angles.

Aiming for the 1 Million Score to join the club!

Of course the most important thing is your unbeatable records, “Downhill Drift” uses Steam Workshop to share your records and ghosts to other players around the world, after you subscribed any tracks, you will be able to challenge their ghosts. Whether you beat or lose the battle, you will still earn your own best record in your library, ready for you to challenge again.

Oh, have you tried to Put the pedal to the metal?

Car No.1: White Tofu. Quick and smooth turning and drifting, but with low engine power.

Car No.2: White Falcon. More engine power but turning is not that quick.

Car No.3: Yellow Hornet. Slightly different tune from the White Falcon in engine power, grip and turning speed.

Car No.4: Black Bear. Born for speed and grip, hard to drift.

One More Thing! There is a Playground map for you to do anything with your car! Burnouts, Donuts, knock over some cones!

There are 2 modes for each theme, Drift Score and Time Attack. Just remember you never want to touch the wall, you will get huge penatly. For both modes you need to go FAST, and SIDEWAYS in drift mode.

If you like any track and want to go for a higher records, you just need to finish it once, it will be permanently saved in your Library, you can Challenge it again anytime. Even better, you will be able to drive with your ghost car, making it easier to find a better corning angles.

Aiming for the 1 Million Score to join the club!

Of course the most important thing is your unbeatable records, “Downhill Drift” uses Steam Workshop to share your records and ghosts to other players around the world, after you subscribed any tracks, you will be able to challenge their ghosts. Whether you beat or lose the battle, you will still earn your own best record in your library, ready for you to challenge again.

Oh, have you tried to Put the pedal to the metal?
store_data.short_description: "Downhill Drift" is a racing game with 4 track themes and each can generate up to 4 billion courses with 4 differently tuned cars. Go Sideway and fast for high scores, or choose Time Attack. Wall collisions carry heavy penalties. Any tracks completed will be saved for you to challenge again.

store_data.about_the_game:
Spirit of the Birch is a first-person adventure game with grid-based movement and elements of classic dungeon crawlers.

Story

An ordinary village guy somehow managed to lose the spark of his own mind. Now he must figure out where it went and put everything back in its place.

Explore dense forests, caves, mines, and other mysterious places. Meet strange characters, help them with their requests, search for items, and solve puzzles. Sometimes you'll encounter dangerous creatures that you'll have to fight.

Gameplay

Spirit of the Birch is an adventure first and foremost, rather than a traditional dungeon crawler. Exploring the world, discovering small stories, talking to characters, and solving various problems are just as important as combat.

Look around carefully, find useful items, interact with objects, and figure out how to move forward.

Talk to animals and unusual creatures, help them out, discover new places, and gradually uncover what happened to the main character.

And if you do have to fight — grab whatever you can find nearby and defend yourself.

Features

  • Adventure game focused on exploration

  • First-person view with grid-based movement

  • Elements of classic dungeon crawlers

  • Dialogue and unusual characters

  • Puzzles and environmental interactions

  • Finding and using various items

  • Combat with enemies

  • Fairytale atmosphere with Slavic influences

  • Light humor and a touch of absurdity

store_data.about_the_game:
[Project Information]

Graduation Project 1, Spring 2026

Team: J2M

  • Jong-Woo Kim (2021 Cohort): Team Lead, Game Design  

  • Min-Hyeok Kwon (2021 Cohort): Programming  

  • Hyun-Woo Jin (2021 Cohort): Graphics

This game was developed as a student project through a project-based course offered by the Department of Game Software at Hoseo University.

[About This Game]

  • Escape from a Derelict Space Ward

    Caught in a conspiracy, Victor is taken to a derelict medical facility in space. Following a gravity augmentation procedure, he was meant to be conditioned into a human weapon. But when an experimental black hole becomes unstable, monsters overrun the facility, throwing the secret laboratory into chaos. Awakening amid the disaster with the power to manipulate gravity, Victor must escape a bizarre facility where floors and walls seamlessly connect.

  • When the Floor Ends, the Path Continues

    Vector Quake is a single-player 3D spatial puzzle-action game where floors and walls form one continuous path. Push and flip crates to create new routes, activate mechanisms, and avoid or defeat enemies as you make your way toward the exit.

  • Study the Entire Space to Find Your Way

    Each stage places crates, mechanisms, enemies, and the exit across different surfaces and orientations. Survey the floors and walls, plan your route, then move crates onto switches to activate mechanisms and open blocked paths. Whether you follow the newly opened route or deal with enemies first can completely change how you approach the puzzle.

  • Crates Are Both Tools and Weapons

    Crates are more than obstacles blocking your path.
    They can serve as keys to activate switches, platforms that bridge otherwise unreachable areas, and even weapons capable of taking down enemies.
    Decide where to push and flip each crate to reshape the situation in your favor.

  • Walls Are Part of the Play Space

    The grid does not end at the floor.
    Crates can move across the boundary between floors and walls, while mechanisms and enemies positioned on different surfaces interact within the same space.
    Do not focus on only the surface in front of you. Treat the entire room as a single puzzle board.

  • One Move Can Change the Entire Space

    Moving, pushing, and flipping are simple actions, but a single decision can alter both your route and the battles ahead.
    Consider where each crate can move, what conditions activate each mechanism, and where enemies are positioned as you search for the solution to every stage.

[Game Features]

  • A seamless 3D grid environment where floors and walls form a continuous play space

  • Puzzle-action gameplay that uses crates as paths, tools, and weapons

  • Simple controls built around moving, pushing, and flipping

  • Stage-based puzzles combining switches, exits, special tiles, and a variety of enemies

store_data.about_the_game:
There are two ways out

You blew your first game, and that night they dragged you 'inside'. A broker sits you down at an underground trading table. Every round is a 100-second session — and when it ends, the loan shark takes his cut first. Ten payments and it's over.

  • A 10-round story — three rounds to an act. Every act break advances the story and raises the stakes a full step: swings get wider, the quota jumps, and more of the news turns out to be lies. The final bill has to be made in a single session — playing safe never reaches it.
  • Somebody sits beside you — a three-month veteran shows you the trick. Then his desk is empty. What happened to him lands in Act III.
  • A choice at every act break — take the card or take the cash, go looking for the missing man or look away, and finally: who you walk out with. Your choices set the last round's difficulty and decide which of three endings you get.
  • 100-second markets — scripted sessions where news mixes truth with fakes, and the fakes multiply as the night goes on.
  • Double-edged cards — market cards and Back-Alley Prescriptions (a bottle of soju, broken glasses…): market buffs that blur your screen and smear your numbers.
  • The Back-Alley Exchange — spend Connections (CP) on monitors, informants, seed money and jobs. Permanent progression that survives your death.
  • Easy and Hard — clearing the story once unlocks Hard, where the bill quadruples every round from Act II on: the last night asks for 54 million won. Even a fully stocked Back-Alley Exchange needs luck to clear it. Hard has a fourth ending of its own.
  • Endless mode — if you'd rather it never end. The quota doubles every round; how long you last is the only score.
  • 10 languages supported

The in-game market is a fictional gambling table, not real trading. Nothing here is financial advice.

store_data.about_the_game:
NULL ROUTE is an online asymmetric PvP game of digital infiltration, investigation, and counterplay.

Two players enter the same network from opposite sides.

As GHOST, your job is to infiltrate systems, discover routes, exploit vulnerable machines, recover objectives, and complete the operation before your position is exposed.

As HUNTER, you work from the other side of the network. Analyze activity, follow suspicious connections, narrow down the attacker’s route, and disrupt the intrusion before GHOST escapes.

Every action creates information.

Scanning a machine may reveal the next step, but it can also create patterns your opponent can recognize. A route that looks safe can become compromised. An exposed device can force you to adapt. Progress is not only about moving forward — it is about deciding when to push deeper, when to change direction, and when to disappear.

A NETWORK UNDER PRESSURE

Navigate a procedural network of devices, relays, servers, and protected systems. Use Terminal commands and specialized tools such as NetMap and Scanner to understand the environment and act on incomplete information.

TWO ROLES. TWO PERSPECTIVES.

GHOST and HUNTER do not play the same game.

GHOST focuses on infiltration, access, routing, exploitation, and completing the objective.

HUNTER focuses on observation, investigation, narrowing possibilities, and applying pressure to the attacker’s route.

Both players interact with the same operation from different perspectives, creating a constant battle of information and misdirection.

READ THE SYSTEM. READ YOUR OPPONENT.

NULL ROUTE is built around deliberate decisions rather than rapid-fire action. Success comes from understanding the network, recognizing patterns, managing risk, and anticipating what the player on the other side is trying to do.

KEY FEATURES

  • Online asymmetric PvP between GHOST and HUNTER

  • Terminal-driven digital infiltration

  • Network investigation and trace-based counterplay

  • Procedurally generated network layouts

  • Multiple simultaneous attack and defense pressures

  • Distinct tools and information for each role

  • Minimal, dark desktop-inspired interface

  • Matches built around adaptation, deduction, and tactical decisions

Whether you're looking for a relaxing pastime or enjoy visual puzzle games, Chronime Puzzle: Birds offers a calm and rewarding experience accompanied by soothing music.

• 50 unique levels
• Beautiful steampunk anime-inspired artwork
• Simple and intuitive mouse controls
• Steam achievements
• Relaxing music and atmosphere
• Gradually increasing difficulty
• Casual and stress-free gameplay

store_data.about_the_game:
This game is a book to browse and read.
It consists of a collection of images, pre-generated by artificial
intelligence, that summarize Genesis, the first book of the Bible.
The main themes are as follows: Adam and Eve in the Earthly Paradise,
Noah and the Great Flood, the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah,
the story of the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
Finally, the story of Joseph, Jacob's son sold into slavery,
who becomes ruler of all Egypt.
Each image automatically scrolls across the screen for a
general overview, then a caption appears for you to read.
The goal of the game is to stimulate the reader's imagination for
a spiritual reflection on the origin of the human race, which
originates from a single man, Adam, by the will of God.
It's often said that there's harmony between faith and science, but
Genesis proves the opposite: faith and science follow opposite paths.
Science doesn't explicitly speak of God, nor does the Bible claim to be
a science book.
God transcends the universe and is not subject to the laws of physics.
God creates from nothing, and this fact requires no scientific explanation.
If we then try to justify everything with a rational, scientific
explanation, then we deny the existence of God.
Therefore, we read Genesis not for scientific explanations, but to learn
the truth of the facts, as God relates them through His Word.
When a scientist takes the "chain" of effects and the causes that
arise from them, and retraces this logical sequence, he arrives at making
statements about events that occurred even billions of years ago.
But these statements are plausible hypotheses because of their logic, but
they are not necessarily the truth of the facts as they actually happened.
The truth can only be spoken by someone who is an infallible witness
to what happened.
If someone else, who is not God, were to speak a truth that surpasses or
contradicts the Word of God, then the Bible would no longer be the Word of
God but simply a lie.
Certainly, the Word of God demands its correct interpretation and cannot
be taken literally.
But the authentic interpretation of Sacred Scripture can never affirm
the opposite of what was written in its literal meaning, nor can it deny
the omnipotence of God and then justify a science that is indifferent to
the very existence of God.

Genesis proves the opposite: faith and science follow opposite paths.
Science doesn't explicitly speak of God, nor does the Bible claim to be
a science book.
God transcends the universe and is not subject to the laws of physics.
God creates from nothing, and this fact requires no scientific explanation.
If we then try to justify everything with a rational, scientific
explanation, then we deny the existence of God.
Therefore, we read Genesis not for scientific explanations, but to learn
the truth of the facts, as God relates them through His Word.
When a scientist takes the "chain" of effects and the causes that
arise from them, and retraces this logical sequence, he arrives at making
statements about events that occurred even billions of years ago.
But these statements are plausible hypotheses because of their logic, but
they are not necessarily the truth of the facts as they actually happened.
The truth can only be spoken by someone who is an infallible witness
to what happened.
If someone else, who is not God, were to speak a truth that surpasses or
contradicts the Word of God, then the Bible would no longer be the Word of
God but simply a lie.
Certainly, the Word of God demands its correct interpretation and cannot
be taken literally.
But the authentic interpretation of Sacred Scripture can never affirm
the opposite of what was written in its literal meaning, nor can it deny
the omnipotence of God and then justify a science that is indifferent to
the very existence of God.
